notes.title: Game Update 7.7.1b Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Highlights[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Subscriber Only Log In Rewards[/b][/p][p]From September 9 to December 9, 2025, active Subscribers will notice a new type of Log In Reward named Subscriber Login Tokens. Subscribers who log in at least four times a week will receive these tokens and will be able to redeem them at a special vendor that carries gameplay focused rewards. See details here. [/p][p][b]Feast of Prosperity[/b][/p][p]SWTOR’s annual fall event returns October 7, 2025! A plethora of new rewards are coming to the Feast of Prosperity event. [/p][p][b]Extended maintenance [/b][/p][p]Alongside the below bug fixes, we will also be deploying Game Server Database upgrades which will require an extended maintenance window. Players should expect an estimated downtime of 8 hours. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[Rishi] Sergeant Zaya is no longer missing her head.[/p][/*][*][p]\[French client only] Fixed an issue causing a “Lana accepted the marriage proposal” prompt to appear even if the player is not in a romance with her. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the sorting function on various windows in the game. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various buttons throughout the game that were not being displayed properly. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Large Tooltip not displaying the proper color when the mouse cursor hovers over friendly and enemy NPCs and interactable items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the fonts on the Combat Style Forcer user alignment button to not display correctly. [/p][/*][*][p]UI elements no longer stack on top of one another when a player joins or quits a group while the Activity Window is open. [/p][/*][*][p]The Group Finder UI now correctly shows a lockout when a player logs in on a character with an active lockout.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Missions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Missing crit path missions are now accessible through the Eras tab offering players guidance on what content needs to be completed in order to begin expansion story content.  [/p][/*][*][p]For players who are unable to start Rise of the Hutt Cartel, they can pick up the necessary Ilum missions from the Eras tab.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Knights of the Fallen Empire, Chapter 7] Subtitles and audio dialogue now match as intended. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Seasons[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[Galactic Season] The T7-01 Rugged Customization is no longer missing its Collections Unlock. [/p][/*][*][p]After the weekly reset, the Galactic Season and PvP Season objective trackers will now display the correct amount of completed objectives. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Activity Finder[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[Depths of Manaan] After defeating Stivastin through Activity Finder, players will now be placed in the correct location to receive rewards. [/p][/*][*][p]Selecting the "PvP Challenge" activity, then closing and reopening the Activity Window no longer prevents the group leader from joining the queue for any activities.[/p][/*][*][p]The Arena and Warzone queue lists now display the name of characters properly. [/p][/*][*][p]Scrolling to the bottom of the Solo activities list and then collapsing the "Flashpoints" category will now automatically reduce the list's length rather than making it look as though the list has disappeared.[/p][/*][*][p]The scrollbar will now update properly when expanding and collapsing the Solo Tab within the Activity Window.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Nightfall Operative Glasses no longer hide the hoods of chest pieces that have them. [/p][/*][*][p]The Ascendant Admiral’s Belt is now visible on all male body types. [/p][/*][*][p]The account wide versions of the Customization Control: Hide Head Slot and Crew Member Appearance Authorization items can now be sold to vendors. [/p][/*][*][p]When selecting a song from the Republic Jukebox, the two Holo Dancers that appear are no longer missing textures.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Cinematics[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[Spirit of Vengeance] Fixed an issue that caused Rass Ordo to appear with an incorrect hairstyle.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Basilisk Prototype Venture[/b][/p][list][*][p]The timer for B3-S1 when she is a temporary companion does not count down while players are in an Arena or Warzone.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: SWTOR In-game Events for September 2025
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d49e114a8ac56a033d7fe9919d107e72eb5c429d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally[/u][/b][/p][p]
[b]Date: [/b]September 2 - September 8 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
[b]Requirement:[/b] Level 20+[/p][p align="start"]In the growing shadow of war, swoop fans across the galaxy descend on Dantooine, Tatooine, and even Onderon for the sport’s biggest spectacle—The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally! They’re packing the stands, eager to take their minds off their troubles and cheer their favorite swoop gangs. The bikers are here to take on dangerous challenge courses, show off their piloting skills, and flaunt their souped-up swoop bikes. The thunder of the engines, the deafening applause from the fans, the wind battering their helmets… there’s no bigger rush for these thrill seekers.[/p][p align="start"]Despite their reputation as wild rebels whose makeshift courses disregard local districting restrictions, swoop gangs aren’t a serious threat to anyone--something all true swoop fans know! They just love adrenaline-pounding speed, sweet jumps, and big explosions, and the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally combines all three in one crowd-pleasing package. The biggest gangs on the circuit — Horizon’s Razor, the Pit Screamers, and the Blatant Beks — are ready to show their fans a great time.[/p][p align="start"][b]FEATURED REWARDS:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Swoop Rally Mounts (regular and gold versions)[/p][/*][*][p]Swoop Gang Outfits[/p][/*][*][p]Promotion Droid Mini-pets[/p][/*][*][p]Various Stronghold Decorations[/p][/*][*][p]…and more![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/fc7f3b06444ffd68b3eb61e4f0936797cf88d7a0.png"][/img]
[/p][p align="start"][b][u]Rakghoul Resurgence on Alderaan[/u][/b]
[/p][p align="start"][b]Date: [/b]September 16 - September 22(BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
[b]Requirement:[/b] Level 25+[/p][p align="start"]The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization (T.H.O.R.N.) has issued an official level-2 emergency alert concerning an outbreak of the Rakghoul plague on Alderaan. Quarantines have been put in place to restrict traffic of the plague off-world, but exceptions will be made for individuals with priority clearance.[/p][p align="start"]T.H.O.R.N. is recruiting qualified volunteer emergency responders to travel to affected areas to combat the spread of the Rakghoul plague. More information about the outbreak can be found by checking the News Terminals on the Republic or Imperial Fleet![/p][p align="start"]T.H.O.R.N. wishes to remind you that plague symptoms can be treated if they are identified in the early stages of infection. Whether or not you have travel plans, please consult your nearest trusted medical supply droid and get vaccinated![/p][p align="start"][b]FEATURED REWARDS:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reputation with THORN[/p][/*][*][p]Merciless Seeker’s Armor Set[/p][/*][*][p]THORN Epicenter and Dark Vector Armor Sets[/p][/*][*][p]Outbreak Response Weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Alliance Contact - Doctor Lokin[/p][/*][*][p]Infected Varactyl and Infected Dewback Mounts[/p][/*][*][p]Ferocious Rakghoul Mini-pets[/p][/*][*][p]…and more![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/91fbbe0d726f6ccf5e2af2b01c28fec00c2317ae.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][b][u]Relics of the Gree[/u][/b]
[/p][p align="start"][b]Date:[/b] September 30 - October 6 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
[b]Requirement:[/b] Level 50+[/p][p align="start"]Explore Ilum's contested area in the Western Ice Shelf to uncover the mysterious purpose of the Gray Secant, an enormous ancient Gree starship. Get ready to face a powerful opponent that awaits you at the center of this ancient vessel. Visit the in-game News Terminal located on Carrick Station in the Republic fleet or Vaiken Spacedock in the Imperial fleet to get started on your adventure![/p][p align="start"][b]FEATURED REWARDS:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reputation with the Gree Enclave[/p][/*][*][p]Gree Digitization Cube[/p][/*][*][p]White, Red, and Blue Scalene Armor[/p][/*][*][p]Gray Helix Weapons[/p][/*][*][p]L1-L Defender, L1-L Scout, and Miniature Gray Secant Mini-pets[/p][/*][*][p]Cyan Sphere, Blue Sphere and Red Sphere Vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]…and more![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Game Update 7.7.1 "Flashpoint Resurgence" is now live!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/fb4ca93c07c1d17ec2a4155174ff63c9016f225d.png"][/img][/p][p]Game Update 7.7.1 “Flashpoint Resurgence” is now live! Read below for details about all the content that is available to SWTOR players.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Galactic Season 9 “Flashpoint Resurgence”[/u][/b] [/p][p]Kai Zykken returns with another offer to test a new version of the adrenal boost created by Czerka. The updated Experimental Combat Enhancers will provide even more special buffs upon use when in Flashpoints. Players will be able to make progress through the Free Reward track or the Subscriber Reward track (both tracks are available to Subscribers!) and earn new rewards. [/p][p]A new Galactic Season Flashpoint Resurgence queue has been added to Activity Finder. Every week that Galactic Season 9 is active, this special queue will have 1 or 2 Veteran Flashpoints that match the weekly objectives. [/p][p][b][u]Updates to Activity Finder[/u][/b][/p][p]Improvements to the UI and functionality of the Activity Finder Window have been made that focuses on more support for Combat Styles. Via a new Group Role dropdown, players will be able to choose all roles they are eligible for in the Group tab including the roles from both Combat Styles. Players can now adjust their Combat Styles while waiting for PVE group content. Once the queue pops, the updated Join Window will display the player’s current Combat Style selection and they will need to be sure to match what the Group Finder required role is prior to joining. For convenience, a quick link to Combat Styles and Loadouts has also been added. Players will need to be mindful of the Loadouts they are using and update as needed.[/p][p]Players can now earn the Daily Reward Bonus and Weekly Mission credits even if they do not select every piece of content in the filter.  In the Activity Finder UI players will see two numbers next to each other to explain this information as the following (total available pieces of content // minimum number selected to receive rewards).[/p][p][b][u]Flashpoint Cutscene Skip[/u][/b][/p][p]Players that enter a Veteran or Master Mode Flashpoint via Activity Finder will find that the cinematic scenes will now skip automatically. The cinematics will be replaced with a brief fade to black. In instances where players would typically make a Light or Dark side choice, a default choice will be made for players and Light/Dark points will not be granted. Should players want to experience the cinematics in a Veteran or Master Mode Flashpoint, they can manually walk into the phase.[/p][p]In addition, players who complete the below Flashpoints in Veteran Mode via Activity Finder will no longer need to return to the fleet to complete the access mission:[/p][list][*][p]Athiss[/p][/*][*][p]Cademimu[/p][/*][*][p]Hammer Station [/p][/*][*][p]Mandalorian Raiders[/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]Improvements for F2P/Preferred players[/u][/b][/p][p]F2P/Preferred players will be able to: [/p][list][*][p]Gain access to companion customizations[/p][/*][*][p]Gain access to use Legacy Titles[/p][/*][*][p]Earn Rest XP[/p][/*][*][p]Gain the first Cargo Bay for free[/p][/*][*][p]Use the Hide Head slot[/p][/*][*][p]Withdraw more credits from Escrow when using Cartel Coins[/p][/*][/list][p]Additionally, all account types will have access to all quickbars. 
[/p][p][b][u]Artifact Authorization[/u][/b][/p][p]Any piece of gear under level 80 will not require Artifact Authorization. [/p][p]Level 80 Artifact (purple) or Legendary (gold) gear that will require Artifact Authorization are: [/p][list][*][p]All 7.0 purple gear[/p][/*][*][p]Legendary Implants[/p][/*][*][p]Hyde and Zeek’s purple enhancements[/p][/*][*][p]Grade 10/11 Reusable Medpacs, Stims, and Adrenals[/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]Security Key Update[/u][/b][/p][p]Players who have a Security Key tied to their account will only receive their Cartel Coin grants if they were active in the last 29 days. We will not be removing coins that have already been granted. To add a Security Key to your SWTOR account, go to your account page on our website. All commonly used authenticators are accepted.[/p][p][b][u]Cartel Market Offerings[/u][/b][/p][p]Alongside the Imperial Scout Mount, the Brushback hairstyle customization, Nightfall Operative Glasses head accessory, and Prototype Test Pilot armor set inspired by the Disney+ series [i]Andor[/i]™ have come to the Cartel Market. Read [u][url="https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250819"]here[/url][/u] for more details. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/e6b4b20022a64344013f254feffffd79fef1f87a.png"][/img][i](Brushback Hairstyle)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Character Select Modernization[/u][/b] [/p][p]The character select screen has received improved lighting and a new Depth of Field update that keeps the focus on the player character. Note that these visual updates only apply to the character select screen and not the entirety of the player’s ship. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/20ef85378cdddb4fcbde61f008e6aeca5c60b855.png"][/img][/p][p][b][u]Character Modernization[/u][/b] [/p][p]The face definition and texture smoothing that was implemented in Game Update 7.7 has been added to Rattataki. We are also fixing the Dark Side corruption issues some players saw with skin colors turning overly pale. [/p][p]We have unlocked hundreds of hair and montral color options to character customization for Cathar, Chiss, Cyborg, Human, Miraluka, Mirialan, Togruta, and both Imperial and Republic Zabraks. Additionally, more skin colors have been unlocked for Mirialans and Imperial Zabraks. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b824867a6aa1e971a0b807b641f7f9d591365ed3.png"][/img][i](Example of face definition and texture smoothing for Rattataki)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Combat Changes[/u][/b][/p][p]We are continuing with our audit of the default granted abilities and will focus on Mercenary/Commando, Operative/Scoundrel, and Sorcerer/Sage in 7.7.1. A full list can be found in the [u][url="https://www.swtor.com/patchnotes"]patch notes[/url][/u]. [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Active Twitch Drop[/u][/b][/p][p]Players will need to watch 4 hours of live Twitch content to get their hands on the TF-6 Striker Mount. Be sure to connect your SWTOR and Twitch account through the account page on our website in order to be eligible to unlock this reward![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6914062787545ccf98746e1253d33a321089dc3c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy Game Update 7.7.1 “Flashpoint Resurgence”! [/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Galactic Season 9 “Flashpoint Resurgence”
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/cb315457b577003abe3b11801f23a92699036550.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Galactic Seasons 9 “Flashpoint Resurgence” will begin with the launch of Game Update 7.7.1 on August 19th! Once the update goes live, players will be able to make progress through the Free Reward track or the Subscriber Reward track (both tracks are available to Subscribers!) and earn new rewards. Below are the details of what players can expect from this new season![/p][p][u][b]Diving Back Into Flashpoints![/b][/u][/p][p]For the duration of Galactic Season 9 (GS9), players will be encouraged to jump back into Flashpoints to complete their weekly objectives.[/p][p]Kai Zykken returns with another offer to test a new version of the adrenal boost created by Czerka. The updated [b]Experimental Combat Enhancers[/b] will provide even more special buffs upon use. You will receive the following buffs that will last for the duration of the Flashpoint:[/p][list][*][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Experimental Repulsor Field -  Grants a temporary ability bar that allows you to lift an enemy and throw them into another[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[NEW] [/b]Projectile Probes - Two probes will appear by your side and fire projectiles at your enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Destruction Overload - Every 5th enemy that is defeated will explode causing a damaging AOE effect[/p][/*][*][p]Czerka Combat Drones - Drones will assist you in taking your enemies down[/p][/*][*][p]Unstable Radiation Field - A devastating point blank AOE will help you decimate your enemies[/p][/*][/list][p]These Experimental Combat Enhancers can be found on the Galactic Season reward track and in Ki’at Thavo’s inventory during the season. [/p][p][u][b]Updates to Activity Finder[/b][/u][/p][p]Players will also be encouraged to use Activity Finder to complete their weekly GS9 objectives. This window has been given a Quality of Life update and players will see the following updates to it: [/p][list][*][p]Players can choose all eligible roles in the Group tab [/p][/*][*][p]Players can choose Roles from both Combat Styles[/p][/*][*][p]When queue pops, players can see the Role they have been assigned[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now change combat style while in queue![/p][list][*][p]Loadouts will need to be manually changed[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]With GS9, there will be a new Flashpoint Resurgence queue added to Activity Finder. Every week, this queue will feature 1-2 Veteran Flashpoints that will match the weekly objectives that need to be completed in order to make progress on the reward track. Players will be able to jump into the GS9 queue and other normal queues as well. [/p][p]Another change that was made to Activity Finder is that players may see that some queues will have more activities selected than are required to complete for the Daily Reward Bonus and Weekly Mission Credit.  [/p][p]In the example below, you can see that there are 13/11 Story Mode Operations that have been selected. While 13 Operations are selected, you will only need to select 11 in order to receive credit. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/718b61c3d83e4028967aa54cb464c73c9a44ce5d.png"][/img][/p][p]In the example below, there are 24 out of 25 Veteran Flashpoints selected which then show that  you are not eligible for credit. You will need to select one more Flashpoint in order to receive rewards. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d7597f74ce32513c59e87c7972899955927ad593.png"][/img][/p][p]The final change that has been made to Activity Finder is that any group that uses this window to enter a Veteran or Master Mode Flashpoint will find that the cinematics are replaced with a fade to black screen. They will no longer need to use Spacebar to skip cinematics. As cinematics will be “skipped”, the Light and Dark side choices will be randomly selected and no points will be granted. [/p][p]If players would like to experience the cinematics in Veteran or Master modes, they can group up and walk through a phase gate of their desired Flashpoint.  [/p][p][u][b]Seasonal Rewards![/b][/u][/p][p]As with previous Seasons, there will be a Free and Subscriber track that players can earn rewards from as they complete objectives and progress through Galactic Seasons 9. Rewards for this season will feature items themed around the Disney+ series [i]Andor™ [/i]season 2.  [/p][p][b]The following rewards will be available on the Free/Preferred reward track: [/b] notes.title: Game Update 7.7.1 "Flashpoint Resurgence" Patch Notes
notes.content: [h3][b]Highlights[/b] [/h3][p][b][u]Galactic Season 9 “Flashpoint Resurgence”[/u][/b] [/p][p align="start"]Kai Zykken returns with another offer to test a new version of the adrenal boost created by Czerka. The updated Experimental Combat Enhancers will provide even more special buffs upon use when in Flashpoints. Players will be able to make progress through the Free Reward track or the Subscriber Reward track (both tracks are available to Subscribers!) and earn new rewards. [/p][p align="start"]A new Galactic Season Flashpoint Resurgence queue has been added to Activity Finder. Every week that Galactic Season 9 is active, this special queue will have 1 or 2 Veteran Flashpoints that match the weekly objectives. [/p][p align="start"][b][u]Updates to Activity Finder[/u][/b][/p][p align="start"]Improvements to the UI and functionality of the Activity Finder Window have been made that focuses on more support for Combat Styles. Via a new Group Role dropdown, players will be able to choose all roles they are eligible for in the Group tab including the roles from both Combat Styles. Players can now adjust their Combat Styles while waiting for PVE group content. Once the queue pops, the updated Join Window will display the player’s current Combat Style selection and they will need to be sure to match what the Group Finder required role is prior to joining. For convenience, a quick link to Combat Styles and Loadouts has also been added. Players will need to be mindful of the Loadouts they are using and update as needed.[/p][p align="start"]Players can now earn the Daily Reward Bonus and Weekly Mission credits even if they do not select every piece of content in the filter.  In the Activity Finder UI players will see two numbers next to each other to explain this information as the following (total available pieces of content // minimum number selected to receive rewards).[/p][p align="start"][b][u]Flashpoint Cutscene Skip[/u][/b][/p][p align="start"]Players that enter a Veteran or Master Mode Flashpoint via Activity Finder will find that the cinematic scenes will now skip automatically. The cinematics will be replaced with a brief fade to black. In instances where players would typically make a Light or Dark side choice, a default choice will be made for players and Light/Dark points will not be granted. Should players want to experience the cinematics in a Veteran or Master Mode Flashpoint, they can manually walk into the phase.[/p][p align="start"]In addition, players who complete the below Flashpoints in Veteran Mode via Activity Finder will no longer need to return to the fleet to complete the access mission:[/p][list][*][p]Athiss[/p][/*][*][p]Cademimu[/p][/*][*][p]Hammer Station [/p][/*][*][p]Mandalorian Raiders[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b][u]Improvements for F2P/Preferred players[/u][/b][/p][p align="start"]F2P/Preferred players will be able to: [/p][list][*][p]Gain access to companion customizations[/p][/*][*][p]Gain access to use Legacy Titles[/p][/*][*][p]Earn Rest XP[/p][/*][*][p]Gain the first Cargo Bay for free[/p][/*][*][p]Use the Hide Head slot[/p][/*][*][p]Withdraw more credits from Escrow when using Cartel Coins[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Additionally, all account types will have access to all quickbars. [/p][p align="start"][b][u]Artifact Authorization[/u][/b][/p][p align="start"]Any piece of gear under level 80 [b][u]will not[/u][/b] require Artifact Authorization. [/p][p align="start"]Level 80 Artifact (purple) or Legendary (gold) gear that [b][u]will[/u][/b] require Artifact Authorization are: [/p][list][*][p]All 7.0 purple gear[/p][/*][*][p]Legendary Implants[/p][/*][*][p]Hyde and Zeek’s purple enhancements[/p][/*][*][p]Grade 10/11 Reusable Medpacs, Stims, and Adrenals[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b][u]Security Key Update[/u][/b][/p][p align="start"]Players who have a Security Key tied to their account will only receive their Cartel Coin grants if they were active in the last 29 days. We will not be removing coins that have already been granted. To add a Security Key to your SWTOR account, go to your account page on our website. All commonly used authenticators are accepted.[/p][p align="start"][b][u]Cartel Market Offerings[/u][/b][/p][p align="start"]Alongside the Imperial Scout Mount, the Brushback hairstyle customization, Nightfall Operative Glasses head accessory, and Prototype Test Pilot armor set inspired by the Disney+ series Andor™ are coming to the Cartel Market. [/p][p align="start"][b][u]Character Select Modernization [/u][/b][/p][p align="start"]The character select screen has received improved lighting and a new Depth of Field update that keeps the focus on the player character. Note that these visual updates only apply to the character select screen and not the entirety of the player’s ship. [/p][p align="start"][b][u]Character Modernization [/u][/b][/p][p align="start"]The face definition and texture smoothing that was implemented in Game Update 7.7 has been added to Rattataki. We are also fixing the Dark Side corruption issues some players saw with skin colors turning overly pale. [/p][p align="start"]We have unlocked hundreds of hair and montral color options to character customization for Cathar, Chiss, Cyborg, Human, Miraluka, Mirialan, Togruta, and both Imperial and Republic Zabraks. Additionally, more skin colors have been unlocked for Mirialans and Imperial Zabraks. [/p][p align="start"][b][u]Combat Changes[/u][/b][/p][p align="start"]We are continuing with our audit of the default granted abilities and will focus on Mercenary/Commando, Operative/Scoundrel, and Sorcerer/Sage in 7.7.1. A full list of changes  is detailed in its own section below. [/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]General [/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the game client to crash when the Legacy of the Sith trailer ends. [/p][/*][*][p]Classic Cartel Pack Reputation Legacy Titles are no longer missing on characters who have them unlocked. [/p][/*][*][p]The Codex Window will now open when players click on Open when obtaining a new Codex Entry. [/p][/*][*][p]Travel costs are now displayed in the tooltip when players choose a Transport destination. [/p][/*][*][p]An error message now appears when a player tries to delete a character that has unclaimed items from the Cartel Market. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various assets in the Star of Coruscant that caused players to get stuck if they jumped into notes.title: SWTOR In-game Events for August 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/dc046fd205a4608c4c99ffba7ecaf3effee1587b.png[/img]

[u][b]Pirate Incursion[/b][/u]

Date: August 5 - August 11 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
Requirement: Level 20+

The remote planet Dantooine has been thrust into the center of escalating hostilities between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Spurred on in secret by covert Imperial forces, the Nova Blade pirates have staged an all-out attack on the pastoral Republic world. As the Republic scrambles to defend this key territory at the edge of Imperial space, the Empire plans to capitalize on the chaos and deal a major blow to the longtime Republic bastion.

FEATURED REWARDS:
[list]
[*] Nova Blade and Dantooine Homesteader Armor Sets
[*] Ugnaught Companion
[*] Walker Mount
[*] Kath Hound Mount
[*] Kath Hound Mini-pet
[*] Dantooine-inspired Stronghold Decorations
[*] … and more!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/721dfa1b8779d506b93eea5797a7ac03fcc105f7.png[/img]

[u][b]Bounty Contract Week[/b][/u]

Date: August 19 - August 25 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
Requirement: Level 15+

For a limited time, the Bounty Brokers Association has opened its doors to anyone willing to take on their dangerous contracts, offering an opportunity for both seasoned and rookie hunters to prove their skills and bring crime syndicates and violent gangs to justice!

Each day, you can sign up for one standard Henchman contract and one high profile Kingpin Contract, and each may take you to a separate planet. Complete five standard contracts to unlock Kingpin missions with bigger loot! Head to the fleet now, invite your friends and visit representatives of the Association to get started on your contracts!

FEATURED REWARDS:
[list]
[*] Reputation with the Bounty Brokers Association
[*] Bounty Tracker’s Armor Set and Contract Hunter’s Armor Set
[*] Assassin’s Bowcaster and Elite Tracker’s Bowcaster weapons
[*] Lobelot, Swamp Kell Drake, and Drink Server Probe Mini-pets
[*] BH-7X Custom Hunter Mount
[*] …and more!
[/list]

notes.title: New Star Wars The Old Republic update expands the MMORPG's free-to-play features
notes.content:
What is it about the Old Republic that makes Star Wars fans all misty eyed? You'd think that the prequel trilogy did enough damage for us not to want more stories from before Luke Skywalker was born. Alas, we're gluttons for punishment and lap up every expanded-universe novel, game, and anything else we can get our hands on. The pinnacle, for me at least, is BioWare's series of RPGs. While many players will fondly remember Knights of the Old Republic and its sequel, MMORPG Star Wars: The Old Republic is a classic in its own right, held back only by its monetisation.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Game Update 7.7.1 Livestream Recap
notes.content:
If you were unable to watch-or if you want a recap of everything we showed during our Game Update 7.7.1 Livestream, don't worry! Below is a VOD and breakdown of what we showed for the different segments of our livestream.

  [previewyoutube=z0E_bwCPnoM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Active Twitch Drop[/b]

From now until August 13th, watching 1 hour of live content on Twitch will grant you the Coruscant Poster Decoration!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/2ab99f4da758bd54033d2475b518e28bc39096e9.png[/img]

At 7.7.1 launch, players will need to watch 4 hours of live Twitch content to get their hands on the TF-6 Striker Mount. 

Be sure to connect your SWTOR and Twitch account through the account page on our website in order to be eligible to unlock these rewards! 
[img {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6914062787545ccf98746e1253d33a321089dc3c.png[/img]
        
[b]Update on story content [/b]

The next story arc will be coming soon! We are working to put the final touches on these storylines and get them into your hands as soon as possible. Galactic Threads is targeted for Game Update 7.8 with Master’s Enigma to follow in 7.8.1. Should this schedule change at all, we will communicate updates on our social channels and forums. 

We are also continuing to work on Date Night content. In Game Update 7.8.1, we are targeting to release two Date Night Missions featuring Kira Carsen and Torian Cadera. We will go into further details on these missions in the game update’s respective livestream. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/ba724aec1dc91c1f702c427535de2dbf9f2d0bd7.png[/img]

[b]Galactic Season 9 “Flashpoint Resurgence”[/b]

Galactic Season 9 will begin at 7.7.1 launch and run for 26 weeks. Kai Zykken needs your help once more as a new version of Czerka Combat Enhancers needs to be tested. These new enhancers can be used upon entering Flashpoints and can provide two new buffs.

Experimental Repulsor Field - Grants a temporary Ability Bar that will allow you to lift an enemy and throw them into another. 

Projectile Probes - Two probes will accompany you through the Flashpoint firing projectiles towards enemies while you are in combat.

A variety of decorations can also be earned during the season and will be detailed in a Galactic Season article closer to launch. 

The Meta Achievement Reward is the T7-01 Rugged Customization

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/41862751f65b0ad9ee05662250c27da8c67be7a6.png[/img]
    
[b]System QoL Updates[/b]

[u]Activity Finder [/u]

Improvements to the UI and functionality of the Activity Finder Window have been made that focuses on more support for Combat Styles. Via a new Group Role dropdown, players will be able to choose all roles they are eligible for in the Group tab including the roles from both Combat Styles. They will be able to change their Combat Style while in queue and when a queue pops, players will be able to see the role they have been assigned. Players will need to be cognizant of the Loadouts they are using and update as needed.

In addition to the above updates, a new Galactic Season Flashpoint Resurgence queue will be added to the window. Every week that Galactic Season 9 is active, this special queue will have 1 or 2 Veteran Flashpoints that match the weekly objectives. Players can also join normal queues if they want. 

Players can earn the Daily Reward Bonus and Weekly Mission credits even if they do not select every piece of content in the filter. In the Activity Finder UI, players will see two numbers next to each other to explain this information as the following (total available pieces of content // minimum number selected to receive rewards).  

[u]Flashpoint Cutscene Skip[/u]

Players that enter most Veteran or Master Mode Flashpoint via Activity Finder will no longer need to spacebar through cinematic scenes. The cinematics will be replaced with a brief fade to black. In instances where players would typically make a Light or Dark side choice, a default choice will be made for players and Light/Dark points will not be granted. Should players want to experience the cinematics in a Veteran or Master Mode Flashpoint, they can manually walk into the phase. 

As a general note, loot from Flashpoint boss drops have been improved for players under level 75. 

[u]Combat Updates[/u]

We are continuing with our audit of the default granted abilities and will be focusing on Mercenary/Commando, Operative/Scoundrel, and Sorcerer/Sage. There will also be a handful of other balance updates in 7.7.1. Examples are: 
[list]
    [*]Assassin/Shadow - Level 73 ability tree option Avoidance/Celerity now reduces the cooldown of Force Speed by 7s.[/*]
    [*]Operative/Scoundrel - Level 60 ability Exfiltrate/Scamper cooldown changed from 8s to 7s.[/*][/list]
A full list will be posted in the 7.7.1 patch notes as we get closer to launch. 

[u]Security Key Updates[/u]

Players who have a Security Key tied to their account will only receive their Cartel Coin grants if they were active in the last 29 days. We will not be removing coins that have already been granted. 

To add a Security Key to your SWTOR account, go to your account page on our website. Commonly used authenticators can be used.   

[u]F2P/Preferred Improvements[/u]

More changes have been made to improve the F2P experience. Previous updates that have gone into the 7.x patches include: 
[list]
    [*]All players now being able to sprint at Level 1[/*]
    [*]All players can train speeder piloting at level 10[/*]
    [*]Added a mount onboarding mission to guide new players to a speeder vendor[/*]
[/list]
In 7.7.1, F2P/Preferred players will be able to: 
[list]
    [*]Gain access to companion customizations[/*]
    [*]Gain access to use Legacy Titles[/*]
    [*]Earn Rest XP[/*]
    [*]Gain the first Cargo Bay for free[/*]
    [*]Use the Hide Head slot[/*]
    [*]Withdraw more credits from Escrow when using Cartel Coins[/*]
[/list]
In addition to the above, all account types will have access to all quickbars. 

[u]Artifact Authorization Update[/u]

Beginning in Game Update 7.7.1, any piece of gear under level 80 will not require Artifact Authorization. 

Level 80 purple or gold gear that will require Artifact Authorization are: 
[list]
    [*]All 7.0 purple gear[/*]
    [*]Legendary Implants[/*]
    [*]Hyde and Zeek’s purple enhancements[/*]
    [*]Grade 10/11 Reusable Medpacs, Stims, and Adrenals[/*]
[/list]
[b]Subscriber Only Log In Rewards[/b]

From September 9 to December 9, 2025, active Subscribers will notice a new type of Log In Reward in the form of a currency. Subscribers who log in at least four times a week will receive this currency and will be able to redeem it at a special vendor that carries gameplay focused rewards. These rewards can range from purchasing endgame game or leveling gear, special XP and crafting boost, etc… There will also be a unique companion customization reward on the vendor inspired by the Disney+ series [i]Andor[/i]™ that can be used on companion droids 2V-R8 and C2-N2.

[b]Feast of Prosperity[/b]

SWTOR’s annual fall event returns October 7, 2025! A plethora of new rewards are coming to the Feast of Prosperity event. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/da17c77606dcffdc7e29a244d7f9cbe8aeb41bf8.png[/img]

Beginning July 30, 2025, there will be a variety of category sales on the Cartel Market ranging between 30-90% off. Below is the current category sales schedule: 
[list]
    [*]July 30 – Mounts[/*]
    [*]August 11 – Tunings, Toys, and Crystals [/*]

    [*]September 16 - Decorations[/*][/list]

[b]Character Selection Modernization [/b]

Our modernization efforts continue across the game. The character select screen has received improved lighting and a new Depth of Field update that keeps the focus on the player character. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/20ef85378cdddb4fcbde61f008e6aeca5c60b855.png[/img]

[b]Character Modernization Updates[/b] 

We are now moving on to modernizing other species. The face definition and texture smoothing that was implemented in Game Update 7.7 has been added to Rattataki. We are also fixing the Dark Side corruption issues some players saw with skin colors turning overly pale. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b824867a6aa1e971a0b807b641f7f9d591365ed3.png[/img]

The team now has a functioning version of the game on DX12! Our next steps are to upgrade UI technology and implement baseline shader. We will communicate further details on the timeline of this test when the team makes further progress. We are very excited for this upgrade to come to SWTOR!

notes.title: Nar Shaddaa Nightlife returns on July 8 with new rewards!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/9ea58eb7a634b81f7f277e5ee08238399ae93db8.png[/img]

The Nar Shaddaa Nightlife event begins July 8 and will run until August 19, 2025. If this is your first time participating in the event, you will want to head over to the Republic or Imperial Fleet. A floating mission terminal located in the connecting corridors of the Fleet will grant you a mission that will send you to the Star Cluster (Republic) or Club Vertica (Imperial) Casinos on Nar Shaddaa. There are three different slot machines that players can test their luck on. 

[b]Smuggler’s Luck[/b]

The Smuggler’s Luck slot machine requires a Smuggler’s Casino Chip, purchasable from any Hospitality Droid for 5,000 credits. Players have a chance to earn Casino Chips for Smuggler’s Luck and Kingpins’ Bounty machines and Golden Certificates (a special type of currency that can be taken to the event vendors to gain exclusive rewards). Additionally, by playing this slot machine, players will also have a chance to earn the “Feeling Lucky” Buff. This Buff boosts the chances of winning from the other types of slot machines - Kingpin’s Bounty and Emperor’s Grace.

[b]Kingpin’s Bounty[/b]

The chips required to use this can either be won from the Smuggler’s Luck slot machine or bought for 100,000 credits. Players will be able to win Kingpin’s Bounty Casino Chips, Golden Certificates, Cartel Certificates, Emperor’s Grace chips, and rewards from this machine. This machine also offers players a chance at receiving the “Good Karma” buff that increases their chances of winning on Kingpin’s Bounty and Emperor’s Grace. Chances are increased when you have the Feeling Lucky Buff or increased further if you have the Good Karma Buff.

[b]Emperor’s Grace[/b]

Emperor’s Grace has the highest priced Chip at 7.5 million credits a piece but rather unique rewards that can only be won while playing on this machine such as the High Stakes Squadron Helmet and High Roller Skiff Mount. Players can also obtain Golden Certificates and Cartel Certificates as common prizes. Chances of winning are increased when you have the Feeling Lucky Buff and when you have Good Karma, these effects stack for the best chances of winning when you have both buffs.

[b]Max Bet Machines[/b]

Each Machine also comes in a Max Bet version exclusive to the VIP Lounge on the Fleet, with higher win rates and exclusive prizes! The chips required to use these can be purchased with credits or non-Max Bet chips from the Hospitality Vendors. Access with the VIP Lounge Wristband can be acquired from the Cantina Vendor on the Fleet.

[b]Mechanical Updates[/b]

The following changes are being made to the event for 2025!

[b]All Chips are now Legacy Currency[/b]
[list]
[*] As you login to your character you character currency will be converted to legacy currency to be accessible on all characters.
[*] This can cause the currency to go over the cap - this will prevent you from gaining more chips until you spend them so if you go over the cap remember you can turn them into Max Bet Chips at the Hospitality Vendors in the VIP area of the Fleet!
[*] Most Chip Currency limits have also been increased! All normal chips are now capped at 1,000,000 and all Max Bet chips are capped at 100,000.
[/list]
[b]Drop Rates for Emperor’s Casino Chip has been increased in Master Flashpoints, Veteran Operations, and Master Operations!

You can not lose on Emperor’s Grace and Emperor’s Grace Max Bet Machines.[/b]

[b]Lucky and Good Karma buffs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now both are 10 minutes long so you no longer need to get them in a specific order to maximize effectiveness on the Emperor’s Grace machines. 
[*] Only removed by the timer running out or from a successful Jackpot! Jackpots on Smuggler’s Luck do not remove Lucky or Good Karma.
[*] The effect cannot be reapplied until the timer runs out or it is removed by a Jackpot, so if you lose it you’ll need to get it again.
[/list]
[b]Winning Chips:[/b]
[list]
[*] Like past iterations you can get your Chip back from the machine instead of winning.[list]
[*] This no longer counts as a win. 
[*] It does not play the win visual effects or grant achievement progress
[*] All machines have a chance of giving your Chip back now.[/list]
[*] It is possible to get the Chips from the next tier machine
[*] It is possible to get the Max Bet Chip for the current tier machine 
[*] Max Bet machines can give Chips for the next tier Max Bet machine.
[/list]
[b]New Achievements have been added for playing on all machines.[/b]

[b]Rakghoul Resurgence on Tatooine[/b]

Date: July 8 - July 14 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
Requirement: Level 25+

The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization (T.H.O.R.N.) has issued an official level-2 emergency alert concerning an outbreak of the Rakghoul plague on Tatooine. Quarantines have been put in place to restrict traffic of the plague off-world, but exceptions will be made for individuals with priority clearance.

T.H.O.R.N. is recruiting qualified volunteer emergency responders to travel to affected areas to combat the spread of the Rakghoul plague. More information about the outbreak can be found by checking the News Terminals on the Republic or Imperial Fleet!

T.H.O.R.N. wishes to remind you that plague symptoms can be treated if they are identified in the early stages of infection. Whether or not you have travel plans, please consult your nearest trusted medical supply droid and get vaccinated!

Requirement: None!

Test your luck at the exotic Star Cluster and Club Vertica Casinos with the return of the Nar Shaddaa Nightlife event! Rare and extravagant rewards await high-rollers or those touched by Lady Luck. For those of you wanting a change in scenery, the event has broadened its horizons and is also happening on Mek-Sha. New Daily Missions and rewards await all those flushed with credits.

notes.title: Executive Producer Letter - Q2 2025
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/db581a10ab4c47a771c183895de2ea26e40153e1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hi folks! [/p][p]As we head into the second half of the year, there’s quite a bit that has happened since March, and even more to look forward to for the rest of 2025. Let’s first take a look back on what’s happened in the last few months and then I’ll get into what’s coming up in the near future. [/p][p][b][u]Game Updates [/u][/b][/p][p]On March 11th, we released Galactic Seasons 8 in [u][url="https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%255Bnews-category%255D/20250311-0"]Game Update 7.6.1 “Rising Powers”[/url][/u], allowing players to obtain extra abilities to annihilate their enemies and complete Uprisings even faster. This update also came with additional customizations for the Basilisk companion B3-S1, the return of our Spring Event, new Utility Bundles in the Cartel Market, and new rewards for players who completed R-4 Anomaly Operation Veteran Mode in under 40 minutes.[/p][p][u][url="https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%255Bnews-category%255D/20250528-1"]Game Update 7.7 “Dynamic Worlds”[/url][/u] was released on May 28, and it came with new Dynamic Encounters for the starter planets, capital planets, and Ilum which included a ton of new rewards and Achievements to earn! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d327c32620f9a39ea8e32d307509380cc7088b77.png"][/img][/p][p][i](Coruscant Conspiracy Console (Achievement Reward))[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/71d1d1cf52afd2c356d4ab0b9557bcfcd546d214.png"][/img][/p][p][i](Imperial Massive Cannon)
[/i][/p][p]Speaking of, there are additional Achievements, rewards, and augments to earn for the toughest players who are experienced enough to take on Relentless Replication Master Mode.    [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/ea3458b913ba28d8756dcad46689a34c0c207f2b.png"][/img][i](Replication Throne Mount)
[/i][/p][p]This update also included[b] [/b][u][url="https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%255Bnews-category%255D/20250527"]PvP Season 8 “Champions of the Wild”[/url][/u], various quality of life improvements, combat updates, Cartel Market items inspired by the Disney+[i] [/i]series [i]Andor™[/i] on, and a wide array of new skin color customizations across Cathar, Chiss, Mirialan, Nautolan, Sith Pureblood, Togruta, and Twi’lek characters. That’s over [b][u]400[/u][/b] new skin colors across these species that were never available prior to 7.7. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/199ade3d0894785330ae4ae66bfdcde4b9e74248.png"][/img][/p][p][i](Examples of new skin colors for Togruta, Nautolan, Cathar, Mirialan, and Twi’lek characters)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Players also saw updates for character modernization. The adjustments focused on facial definition and skin texture changes, a fix for the splotchiness seen on vibrant colored species, and bringing parity to what is shown in the Preview Window and seen in general gameplay. A more detailed post about these changes can be found [u][url="https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940324-character-modernization-updates-going-into-77/"]here[/url][/u].  
[/p][p][b][u]Special Events[/u][/b][/p][p]In between the two latest updates, we had the opportunity to be part of [i]Star Wars[/i] Celebration 2025™ in Japan! A video featurette aired on April 19 giving the broader [i]Star Wars™[/i] audience a look into [i]The Old Republic[/i]™ and a little tease into upcoming story content. [/p][p][/p][p]It was fantastic being able to celebrate [i]Star Wars[/i]™ with so many players over the course of the weekend both in person and in-game. For Celebration, we released a Jubilee Hoverpod log in reward, Naboo Speeder Type-C Subscriber Mount, and a redeemable Amethyst Vulptilla mini-pet. Players have been very interested in the subscriber rewards, and so expect to see more rewards in the near future. [/p][p]Hot on the heels of Celebration, we released a May 4th B25-SAL mini-pet log in reward, ran a Double XP event, and had various sales happening in the Cartel Market. [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]What else is happening?
[/u][/b][/p][p][u]DirectX 12[/u][/p][p]We also saw a lot of questions during our 7.7 livestream asking for updates on DirectX 12 (DX12). Currently, we have a working version of the game running in DX12! However, we still have more to do before we can release a version for players to test such as converting the game’s UI system to DX12 and ensuring any major bugs are identified and resolved. We will have more to share later this year, but I am pleased with the progress the team has been making on this initiative![/p][p][/p][p][b][u]What’s coming up? 
[/u][/b][/p][p]Our next seasonal event is arriving in just a couple weeks! Nar Shaddaa Nightlife will be returning on July 8th! A separate article will be published at a later time focusing on new rewards and some updates coming to the event. [/p][p]Those familiar with our content calendar will know Game Update 7.7.1 is our next release. With it, players can expect the next Galactic Season. When we get closer to talking about the next season, we will unveil the theme and its new rewards. [/p][p]Players will also see additional updates to our character modernization efforts in 7.7.1. The most important of these will be the anticipated improvements for Rattataki to give them the same attention other species recently received. Companions not covered in 7.7 will also be getting some love, as well as continuing refinements and bug fixes based on your feedback. [/p][p]I know many of you have been asking for updates on the story content and I cannot tell you how much I appreciate your patience. I am happy to say that we will have concrete details of the release of Galactic Threads and Master’s Enigma in our upcoming 7.7.1 livestream, so we are looking forward to sharing the story roadmap with you all then. [/p][p]The team and I thank you for your continued support of this beloved game, and we cannot wait to show you what’s in store for it. See you all soon! [/p][p]-Keith[/p]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/721dfa1b8779d506b93eea5797a7ac03fcc105f7.png[/img]

[u][b]Bounty Contract Week[/b][/u]

Date: June 10 - June 16 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
Requirement: Level 15+

For a limited time, the Bounty Brokers Association has opened its doors to anyone willing to take on their dangerous contracts, offering an opportunity for both seasoned and rookie hunters to prove their skills and bring crime syndicates and violent gangs to justice!

Each day, you can sign up for one standard Henchman contract and one high profile Kingpin Contract, and each may take you to a separate planet. Complete five standard contracts to unlock Kingpin missions with bigger loot! Head to the fleet now, invite your friends and visit representatives of the Association to get started on your contracts!

FEATURED REWARDS:
[list]
[*] Reputation with the Bounty Brokers Association
[*] Bounty Tracker’s Armor Set and Contract Hunter’s Armor Set
[*] Assassin’s Bowcaster and Elite Tracker’s Bowcaster weapons
[*] Lobelot, Swamp Kell Drake, and Drink Server Probe Mini-pets
[*] BH-7X Custom Hunter Mount
[*] …and more!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d49e114a8ac56a033d7fe9919d107e72eb5c429d.png[/img]

[u][b]The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally[/b][/u]

Date: June 24 - June 30 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
Requirement: Level 20+

In the growing shadow of war, swoop fans across the galaxy descend on Dantooine, Tatooine, and even Onderon for the sport’s biggest spectacle—The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally! They’re packing the stands, eager to take their minds off their troubles and cheer their favorite swoop gangs. The bikers are here to take on dangerous challenge courses, show off their piloting skills, and flaunt their souped-up swoop bikes. The thunder of the engines, the deafening applause from the fans, the wind battering their helmets… there’s no bigger rush for these thrill seekers.

Despite their reputation as wild rebels whose makeshift courses disregard local districting restrictions, swoop gangs aren’t a serious threat to anyone--something all true swoop fans know! They just love adrenaline-pounding speed, sweet jumps, and big explosions, and the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally combines all three in one crowd-pleasing package. The biggest gangs on the circuit — Horizon’s Razor, the Pit Screamers, and the Blatant Beks — are ready to show their fans a great time.

FEATURED REWARDS:
[list]
[*] Swoop Rally Mounts (regular and gold versions)
[*] Swoop Gang Outfits
[*] Promotion Droid Mini-pets
[*] Various Stronghold Decorations
[*] …and more!
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Dynamic Encounters[/b]

First introduced in 7.6, Dynamic Encounters offer a variety of new adventures for players to experience. In addition to Hoth, Tatooine, and Hidden Chain Invasions, with 7.7, new Encounters will become available on: 
[list]
[*] Tython
[*] Korriban
[*] Hutta
[*] Ord Mantell
[*] Coruscant
[*] Dromund Kaas
[*] Ilum
[/list]
[b]Relentless Replication Master Mode[/b]

The highest difficulty for Relentless Replication has been released in Game Update 7.7! With it comes new Achievements and rewards to earn including Legendary Augments and themed mount!

[u]Augment Updates[/u]

Legendary Augments will now be available with Master Mode Relentless Replication! Crafters brave enough to defeat XR-53, with a little luck, can begin their crafting journey into our new Legendary implants. For those of you that may not want to venture into Master Mode just yet, we are making some adjustments to our PvP Weekly Missions and Veteran Mode Relentless Replication for a few alternate paths to the new Augments as well.

Read [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940135-legendary-augments-coming-in-patch-77/]here[/url] for all the details! 

[b]Eras Window[/b]

Whether you are a new, returning, or seasoned player, the Eras Window will guide you in your journey through SWTOR’s story. Content from the game’s launch to the present is categorized into Eras, providing summaries for each as well as a chronological visual guide to the story. The Eras Window will show you where you are in the overall crit path storyline, what you’ve completed, and what is still to come for each of your characters. 

This window also acts as a great refresher if you are coming back to a character you haven’t played in some time as the overviews are tailored to your journey, show you where that character is in the overall narrative, and allow them to quickly jump directly into their next Mission! 

Important note: Players should expect a larger download for this update as the Eras Window will be importing all the cinematic trailers and this will affect the download size for 7.7.  

[b]Mission Log Updates[/b]

Alongside the introduction of the Eras Window, we have also made a few Quality of Life improvements to the Mission Log to help in ensuring that important information is easier to find as you move through the game. Some of the key changes we made include:

[list]
[*] Introduction of a Galaxy Map button within your Mission Log for easier navigation from Missions to galactic travel!
[*] Reorientation of various UI elements for improved navigation.
[*] Adjustments to make Mission Prioritization clearer (Ex: reduction of non-crit path Missions using Purple)
[/list]
[b]PvP Season 8 “Champions of the Wild”[/b]

PvP Season 8 “Champions of the Wild” begins with 7.7 launch and will run for 16 weeks! 

Alongside the new season, we will be providing players with a Cartel Coin purchase option to bring more parity with other seasonal content such as Galactic Seasons. Catch up via credits will still be available. Read [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%255Bnews-category%255D/20250527]here[/url] for details on the new rewards! 

[b]Additional Quality of Life Improvements[/b] 

[u]World Map[/u] 

We have made a host of quality of life improvements to the World Map to help in navigating the Galaxy! The first thing to note is that we have added a 3 section accordion menu to the left side of the World Map: 
[list]
[*] Quick Travel - This now has a filter button that can be used as a toggleable shortcut to quickly isolate Quick Travel points in respect to important Mission icons. Toggling it off will put your filters right back to your original preference!
[*] Encounters - The most exciting of the new sections, the Encounters section will highlight all available Dynamic Encounters in your area. Clicking on one will begin tracking it, this will act as an aid to help breadcrumb you straight to the event location
[*] Filters - The Galaxy Map, Filter options, and Magnifying Glass have been organized into this small utility menu.
[/list]
[b]Combat Updates[/b]

We want to ensure that players have a viable, fun, and fantasy-fulfilling experience from the default choices that we make within your Combat Style. We’ve reevaluated the default choices within Disciplines and have made a variety of changes in 7.7. 

A full list of changes is listed below in the Combat Updates section of the patch notes. 

[b]Cartel Market items[/b]

Two new armors (inspired by Andor™), a Manaan mini-sub mount, and a Nar Shaddaa decoration bundle have come to the Cartel Market! See [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528]here[/url] for more details! 

[b]Character Modernization Updates[/b]

Coming in 7.7 are the following: 
[list]
[*] Further definition changes
[*] Chiss Texture Improvements
[*] Preview Window and Game Lighting Parity 
[/list]
We’re continuing to work on modernization for additional species to be released in future updates. Read [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940324-character-modernization-updates-going-into-77]here[/url] for additional details. 

[b]Expanded Customization Options! [/b]

New skin colors will be available to all players with 7.7! Cathar, Chiss, Mirialan, Nautolan, Sith Pureblood, Togruta, and Twi’lek characters will see an abundance of new skin colors added to their skin customization sliders.

[b]Nar Shaddaa Nightlife[/b]

SWTOR’s summer seasonal event returns with a plethora of new rewards and will begin on July 8th! More details on the new rewards will be posted the first week of July. 

[u]General [/u]
[list]
[*] Movement bonuses will now stack correctly with Sprint. 
[*] This does not affect mounts
[*] When a player begins a task or a mission that requires their companion to be desummoned (such as while controlling droids, etc.), the companion will now be properly resummoned when the task or mission is completed.
[*] Corrected many instances across the game of companions not being resummoned after players return from a polymorph state.
[*] Weapons Tunings that are always visible will now be displayed in cinematics. 
[*] The cinematic scenes for arriving on Makeb and CZ-198 now play as intended. 
[*] The path to the Corellian Datacron is no longer impeded by a troublesome tree. 
[*] Imperial players will no longer be teleported to an unplayable area when exiting their Strongholds.
[/list]
[u]Dynamic Encounters[/u]
[list]
[*] [Tatooine: In Search of a Problem] Fixed an issue with the facial textures for the Imperial Scientists. 
[*] [Hoth: White Maw Assault] The encounter will now correctly share progress if the fight is started by a player who has already completed the event. 
[*] [Hoth: Hidden Chain Invasion] The encounter will now correctly progress to the “Defeat the Hidden Chain Lieutenant” step even if the fight is started by a player who has already completed the event. 
[/list]
[u]Galactic Seasons[/u]
[list]
[*] The “Regal Senator” and “Senator’s Consort” hairstyles are now unlocked account wide. 
[*] The Key to West Wing Exterior and Suite item no longer disappears from the vendor if the player purchases the Key to the East Wing Exterior and Suite for the Copero Stronghold first. 
[/list]
[u]Nar Shaddaa Nightlife[/u]
[list]
[*] Players will now see an alert and a chat text indicating when they have won the “Good Karma” and “Feeling Lucky” buffs. 
[*] Players will be able to use the “Smuggler’s Luck” machine after receiving a Push.
[/list] 
[u]Relentless Replication Operation Boss[/u]
[list]
[*] The Shielded buff is no longer missing its icon. 
[*] Updated the “Becoming The Hunter” and “Just Stay Calm” Achievement descriptions to clarify that it can only be completed on Veteran and Master Mode difficulties. 
[*] All Relentless Replication Achievements now award Achievement points as intended.
[*] The Hungering Bite Ability no longer affects players who are outside of the displayed VFX effect. 
[*] Updated the spawn conditions for the Mistaken Constructs so only one Construct is summoned at a time. 
[*] Mistaken Constructs spawned from the fourth Prime Directive now engage players in combat as intended. 
[*] The Aura of Rust debuff no longer uses the same icon as the Digestive Enzyme debuff. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the map notes for the elevator inside the Imperial Base Camp and phase gate not displaying correctly.
[/list] 
[u]Uprisings [/u]
[list]
[*] [Done and Dusted: Story Mode] The following changes have been made to the Bel Nerodia and G9-RX boss fight: 
[*] Lowered total amount of additional enemies that spawn during the encounter
[*] Reduced damage output from bosses  
[*] Additional enemies will despawn if players are defeated
[*] [Crimson Fang: Port Nowhere] Fixed an issue with part of the boss encounter room glitching when players moved their camera.   
[/list]
[u]Missions[/u]
[list]
[*] [DAILY] Capture and Release Mission obtained from the Onderon terminal now displays the mission item icon when the mission is being tracked. 
[*] [Remote Trading Outpost: Contact the Manufacturer] Players will now receive the correct mail if they abandon the mission. 
[/list]
[u]Dantooine Abundance Spring Festival[/u]
[list]
[*] [DAILY] Pirates. Again. When entering the polymorph state to become a turret, the companion is desummoned. 
[/list]
[u]Items[/u]
[list]
[*] The Peerless Explorer’s Enviro-Suit helmet no longer clips through the back of the neck for characters using Male Body Type 3. 
[/list]
[u]Combat Updates[/u]

Vengeance Juggernaut:
[list]
[*] Level 27 default is now Projected Scream (was Overwhelming Slashes)  
[*] Level 68 default is now Mad Dash (was Intimidating Roar)  
[*] Level 73 default is now Crushing Fist (was Through Passion)

notes.title: New Star Wars The Old Republic update reinvigorates the classic MMORPG's planets
notes.content:
Back before FF14 won my heart, it was Star Wars: The Old Republic, not World of Warcraft, that first sold me on the idea of MMORPGs. I already had a lot of love for the galaxy far, far away, and while it's not explicitly Knights of The Old Republic 3, SWTOR does have the storytelling chops to follow in the footsteps of the iconic Bioware and Obsidian RPGs. Add in the ability to experience those tales in co-op with your friends, and its availability as a free Steam game, and it's certainly worth trying. To give you one more reason, it's just had a fresh injection of life.

Read the rest of the story...

Content from the game’s launch to the present is categorized into Eras, providing summaries for each as well as a chronological visual guide to the story. The Eras Window will show you where you are in the overall crit path storyline, what you’ve completed, and what is still to come for each of your characters. 

This window also acts as a great refresher if you are coming back to a character you haven’t played in some time as the overviews are tailored to your journey, show you where that character is in the overall narrative, and allow them to quickly jump directly into their next Mission!

[u]Mission Log Updates[/u]

Alongside the introduction of the Eras Window, we have also made a few Quality of Life improvements to the Mission Log to help in ensuring that important information is easier to find as you move through the game. Definitely check out the before and after images to spot the differences but some the key changes we made include:
[list]
[*] Introduction of a Galaxy Map button within your Mission Log for easier navigation from Missions to galactic travel!
[*] Reorientation of various UI elements for improved navigation.
[*] Adjustments to make Mission Prioritization clearer (Ex: reduction of non-crit path Missions using Purple)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/db4cdd998363013e7d72c4c0a4811b03ea5ace9c.png[/img]

[u]PvP Season 8 “Champions of the Wild”[/u]

PvP Season 8 “Champions of the Wild” begins with 7.7 launch and will run for 16 weeks! 

Alongside the new season, we will be providing players with a Cartel Coin purchase option to bring more parity with other seasonal content such as Galactic Seasons. Catch up via credits will still be available. Read [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%255Bnews-category%255D/20250527]here[/url] for details on the new rewards! 

[u][b]Additional Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/u] 

World Map 

We have made a host of quality of life improvements to the World Map to help in navigating the Galaxy! The first thing to note is that we have added a 3 section accordion menu to the left side of the World Map: 
[list]
[*] Quick Travel - This now has a filter button that can be used as a toggleable shortcut to quickly isolate Quick Travel points in respect to important Mission icons. Toggling it off will put your filters right back to your original preference!
[*] Encounters - The most exciting of the new sections, the Encounters section will highlight all available Dynamic Encounters in your area. Clicking on one will begin tracking it, this will act as an aid to help breadcrumb you straight to the event location
[*] Filters - The Galaxy Map, Filter options, and Magnifying Glass have been organized into this small utility menu.
[/list]
[u][b]Combat Updates[/b][/u]

We want to ensure that players have a viable, fun, and fantasy-fulfilling experience from the default choices that we make within your Combat Style. We’ve reevaluated the default choices within Disciplines and have made a variety of changes in 7.7.

A full list of these changes can be found in the [url=https://www.swtor.com/patchnotes]7.7 patch notes[/url]. 

[u][b]Cartel Market items[/b][/u]

Two new armors (inspired by the [i]Andor[/i]™ series on Disney+), a Manaan mini-sub mount, and a Nar Shaddaa decoration bundle have come to the Cartel Market! See here for more details! 

Imperial Director’s Armor
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/144fc83e85e52fa178467aeb2dd69e3779b239b2.png[/img]

[u][b]Character Modernization Updates[/b][/u]

Coming in 7.7 are the following: 
[list]
[*] Further definition changes
[*] Chiss Texture Improvements
[*] Preview Window and Game Lighting Parity 
[/list]
We’re continuing to work on modernization for additional species to be released in future updates. 

[u][b]Expanded Customization Options! [/b][/u]

New skin colors are now available to all players with 7.7! Cathar, Chiss, Mirialan, Nautolan, Sith Pureblood, Togruta, and Twi’lek characters will see an abundance of new options added to their skin customization sliders. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/199ade3d0894785330ae4ae66bfdcde4b9e74248.png[/img]

[u][b]Twitch Drop![/b][/u] 

A new Twitch Drop is now active until June 25! In order to obtain the Umbaran Holo-Rancor, you must watch five (5) hours of live SWTOR content on Twitch. Be sure to connect your Twitch and SWTOR account on the website so you can earn this new mount today! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/81d8121dea7f73daa3ea67179523036f592d1de7.png[/img]

[u][b]Current Rewards Reminder![/b][/u]

Redeem code “SWTORSWC25” to unlock the Amethyst Vulptilla Minipet. Go to your account page on our [url=https://www.swtor.com]website [/url]to redeem this cute reward before May 30th! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/04abf63f39cf90b827e0f89021b548f52188bff8.png[/img]

A full list of patch notes can be found [url=https://www.swtor.com/patchnotes]here[/url]! 

We hope you enjoy Game Update 7.7 “Dynamic Worlds”!

notes.title: Dynamic Encounters have been added to seven more planets!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b4dd948a4f6181cb78d4625cedbd19780cebdb3b.png[/img]

In addition to Hoth and Tatooine, Dynamic Encounters have to come to starter planets - Tython, Korriban, Hutta, and Ord Mantell, Capital Worlds - Coruscant and Dromund Kass, and the ice planet of Ilum!

These fun missions are sprinkled throughout a planet adding life and a quick burst of additional narrative and lore to the planet you may be exploring. They can be completed solo or in a group and can be enjoyed by new and seasoned players alike! 

Originally debuted in Game Update 7.6 “Galactic Threads,” Dynamic Encounters were first introduced to Tatooine and Hoth with Hidden Chain Invasions spreading across the galaxy. Now in Game Update 7.7 “Dynamic Worlds,” these encounters have been added for the starter planets, capital planets, and Ilum! 

[b]New Encounters means new rewards![/b]
