notes.title: Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" coming May 28th
notes.content:
We will be bringing down the servers on May 28 at 7:00am CT / 12:00pm UTC deploy Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds"!  

Estimated downtime: 4 hours

Patch notes will be available on May 27th.

notes.title: Game Update 7.7 Content Now Available on the Public Test Server!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b4dd948a4f6181cb78d4625cedbd19780cebdb3b.png[/img]

[url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250509]Content for Game Update 7.7 “Dynamic Worlds”[/url] is now available on the Public Test Server (PTS)! Read below to know exactly what will be on the PTS and where you can leave feedback. 

[b]Dynamic Encounters[/b]

New encounters will be available on the following planets:
[list]
[*] [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940087-tython-dynamic-encounters-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*oxwkaf*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]Tython[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940088-korriban-dynamic-encounters-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*oxwkaf*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]Korriban[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940089-ord-mantell-dynamic-encounters-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*oxwkaf*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]Ord Mantell[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940090-hutta-dynamic-encounters-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*oxwkaf*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]Hutta[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940091-dromund-kaas-dynamic-encounters-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*oxwkaf*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]Dromund Kaas[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940092-coruscant-dynamic-encounters-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*1lj78rd*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]Coruscant[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940093-ilum-dynamic-encounters-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*1lj78rd*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]Ilum[/url]
[/list]

To help organize feedback, we will have a feedback thread for each planet. Each of the links above will take you to said thread. 

[b]Eras Window[/b]

As this content changes depending on where your character is in the story, we highly encourage players to transfer characters over from live, ideally in as many varied game / story states as possible!

Leave feedback on this content [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940094-eras-window-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*1lj78rd*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]here[/url]!

[b]Relentless Replication Master Mode [/b]

RRMM returns for another round on the PTS! As with previous testing, while vendors will be available for gearing, we recommend players transfer their characters over so they can have the most authentic experience with taking down XR-53. 

A full list of patch notes/updates that have been implemented into this iteration of the encounter and info on the new Legendary Augments will be found in the feedback thread [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940096-master-mode-xr-53-feedback-thread-as-of-may-8th/?_gl=1*1lj78rd*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]here[/url]. 

[b]UI/UX updates for Mission Log and World Map[/b]

A number of UI/UX updates have been made for easier readability and navigation for the Mission Log window and the World Map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/db4cdd998363013e7d72c4c0a4811b03ea5ace9c.png[/img]
[i](Mission Log as it will be displayed in Game Update 7.7)[/i]

Feedback for these can be left [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940097-uiux-mission-log-and-world-map-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*1ct43oq*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]here[/url]! 

[b]Character Modernization Updates[/b]

This iteration of Character Modernization updates will have three main focuses: 
[list]
[*] Further definition changes
[*] Chiss Texture Improvements
[*] Preview Window and Game Lighting Parity
[/list]
Leave feedback for Character Modernization [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940095-character-modernization-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*1lj78rd*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]here[/url]. 

[b]Combat Changes[/b]

To reiterate, we want to ensure that players have a viable, fun, and fantasy-fulfilling experience from the default Discipline choices. We’ve reevaluated what the current default talent choices within Disciplines are and have adjusted the levels in which they are acquired and adjusted the selected default Disciplines (where necessary). 

A full changelist can be found in this [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940126-combat-changes-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*1ct43oq*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]feedback thread[/url]. 

New skin colors will be available on the PTS! Cathar, Chiss, Mirialan, Nautolan, Sith Pureblood, Togruta, and Twi’lek characters will see an abundance of new skin colors added to their skin customization sliders. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f1256c2b76ef021af5a0b4b1aec8d6bf47a635ac.png[/img]
[i](Blue Cathar and purple Twi'lek) [/i]


If this is your first time playing content on the PTS, [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/868200-getting-started-on-the-pts/?_gl=1*1ct43oq*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]read this post[/url] to learn how to get started! 

[i]**PTS is only available to Subscribers
**PTS is only available in English[/i]

notes.title: Game Update 7.7 Recap
notes.content:
If you were unable to watch-or if you want a recap of everything we showed during our Game Update 7.7 Livestream, don't worry! Below is a VOD and breakdown of what we showed for the different segments of our livestream.

[previewyoutube=0M8p0avi-kY;full][/previewyoutube]

A new Twitch Drop is now active until May 22nd! In order to obtain the Dromund Kaas Poster Decoration, you must watch 1 hour of live SWTOR content on Twitch. Be sure to connect your Twitch and SWTOR account on the website so you can earn this new deco today!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/5ed186158ce1323038ac78196b72c21867ca0e0e.png[/img]

When 7.7 goes live (date TBD), players will be able to earn another Twitch Drop reward. 

The Umbaran Holo-Rancor Mount will be unlocked after 5 hours of watch time and earnable for 28 days following 7.7 launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/81d8121dea7f73daa3ea67179523036f592d1de7.png[/img]

[b]Current Rewards Reminders![/b]

Redeem code “SWTORSWC25” to unlock the Amethyst Vulptilla Minipet. Go to your account page on swtor.com to redeem this cute reward before May 30th! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/5f78da22d782d8c61dbeca9686e71c81ae8c89d2.png[/img]

Players who have active subscription as of May 23rd will receive the Naboo Type-C Speeder Mount! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/60d810a0f9da124056192f45e38ba64351f622b6.png[/img]

[b]May 4th Celebrations! [/b]

From May 1st to May 16th, the following will be available for all SWTOR players: 
[list]
[*] 50% Collections Unlock Sale
[*] Cartel Market items under the Inspired By The Mandalorian™ tab will be 25-75% off
[*] Double XP Event
[*] Log in and receive an exclusive B25-SAL Probe Droid Mini-Pet!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/407420f74179fe18f9e9d6a4b4cb18c53ad43251.png[/img]

[b]Narrative Updates[/b]

There are story spoilers ahead if you did not complete Game Update 7.5: Desperate Defiance! 

In case you missed, a special Darth Malgus teaser video made its debut during Star Wars Celebration in Tokyo, Japan. 

[previewyoutube=7Hst-cfWAGE;full][/previewyoutube]

[u]Galactic Threads[/u]

As a refresher, the events in Galactic Threads immediately follow the conclusion of Desperate Defiance (Game Update 7.5). As you pursue Darth Malgus and Shae Vizla, you will also investigate the puzzle that is Darth Nul’s holocron, track the threat of the Hidden Chain, and uncover Malgus’ ultimate plans for the galaxy.

[u]Master’s Enigma[/u]

Master’s Enigma immediately follows the events of Galactic Threads. Players will be diving into a deeper investigation into Darth Nul’s holocron and discover a mysterious figure who has been pulling strings from behind the scenes… 

A note about story content. Galactic Threads was our intended 7.6 storyline with Master’s Enigma intended for 7.7. The development for these story updates has continued on and it is nearly finished! Once we have all the missing pieces to complete this content, we will be communicating how they will be released for players to enjoy. We are eager for everyone to experience the next chapters of Legacy of the Sith, and we appreciate your patience!

[b]Eras Window[/b]

Whether you are a new, returning, or seasoned player, the Eras Window will guide you in your journey through SWTOR’s story. Content from the game’s launch to the present is categorized into Eras, providing summaries for each as well as a chronological visual guide to the story. The Eras Window will show you where you are in the overall crit path storyline, what you’ve completed, and what is still to come for each of your characters. 

This window also acts as a great refresher if you are coming back to a character you haven’t played in some time as the overviews are tailored to your journey, show you where that character is in the overall narrative, and allow them to quickly jump directly into their next Mission!

[b]Mission Log Updates[/b]

Alongside the introduction of the Eras Window, we have also made a few Quality of Life improvements to the Mission Log to help in ensuring that important information is easier to find as you move through the game. Definitely check out the before and after images to spot the differences but some the key changes we made include:
[list]
[*] Introduction of a Galaxy Map button within your Mission Log for easier navigation from Missions to galactic travel!
[*] Reorientation of various UI elements for improved navigation.
[*] Adjustments to make Mission Prioritization clearer (Ex: reduction of non-crit path Missions using Purple)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/aa6d7cbc947e4311689680b1a238ddd2f49448d6.png[/img]
(Mission Log currently live)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/db4cdd998363013e7d72c4c0a4811b03ea5ace9c.png[/img]
(Mission Log as it will be displayed in Game Update 7.7)

[b]Relentless Replication Master Mode[/b]

The highest difficulty for Relentless Replication will be released in Game Update 7.7! With it comes new Achievements and new rewards to earn. New rewards include both Legendary Augments and a brand new Mount!

[u]Augment Updates[/u]

Legendary Augments will now be available with Master Mode Relentless Replication! Crafters brave enough to defeat XR-53, with a little luck, can begin their crafting journey into our new Legendary implants. For those of you that may not want to venture into Master Mode just yet, we are making some adjustments to our PvP Weekly Missions and Veteran Mode Relentless Replication for a few alternate paths to the new Augments as well.

[u]Replication Throne Mount[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/ea3458b913ba28d8756dcad46689a34c0c207f2b.png[/img]

[b]PvP Season 8 “Champions of the Wild”[/b]

A new PvP season begins with 7.7 launch and will run for 16 weeks! Season 8 “Champions of the Wild” comes with new rewards:
[list]
[*] Bestial Champion’s Armor Set
[*] Bestial Warrior’s Armor Set
[*] Armor Set of the Wild
[*] Armor Set of the Beast 
[*] Legacy Title: Way of the Warrior
[*] Character Title: Stalker of Prey
[*] Season 8 Battle Flags (Red and Blue)
[*] Season 8 Trophy Decorations (Small and Large)
[*] Champion’s Seat Decoration
[*] Throne of the Beast Decoration
[*] Wild Warrior’s Respite Decoration
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/70e8f6b17f07946df3a4d6eae2130de492df9741.png[/img]
(Bestial Champion’s Armor Set)

[b]PvP Season 8 System Update[/b]

Alongside the new season, we will be providing players with a Cartel Coin purchase option to bring more parity with other seasonal content such as Galactic Seasons. Catch up via credits will still be available. 


[b]Nar Shaddaa Nightlife Event[/b]

Nar Shaddaa Nightlife returns July 8th! This seasonal event will run for 6 weeks until August 19th. New rewards will be available once this event goes live!

New rewards include: 
[list]
[*] Supernova Helmet 
[*] Smuggler’s Trained Vine Cat
[*] Smuggled Sithspawn
[*] Fiery Grefna 
[*] Vixian Youngling
[*] Iridescent Varactyl
[*] Emperor's Mewvorr
[*] Luxury Ice Tromper
[*] Pocket Orlax
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b1278a69a2e7cbc9e2ab9834da164404b9bea323.png[/img]
(Supernova Helmet)


[b]New Dynamic Encounters[/b]

First introduced in 7.6, Dynamic Encounters offer a variety of new adventures for players to experience. In addition to Hoth, Tatooine, and Hidden Chain Invasions, with 7.7 new Encounters will become available on: 
[list]
[*] Tython
[*] Korriban
[*] Hutta
[*] Ord Mantell
[*] Coruscant
[*] Dromund Kaas
[*] Ilum
[/list]

With these new Dynamic Encounters comes a plethora of new rewards to earn! Players can expect the following themed rewards: 
[list]
[*] Coruscant Conspiracy Console
[*] Coruscant Construction Crane
[*] Coruscant Fireworks Launcher
[*] Coruscant Shipping Cargo
[*] Coruscant Uggernaught
[*] Dromund Kaas Broadcast Tower
[*] Dromund Kaas Hanging Cage
[*] Dromund Kaas Mining Drill
[*] Dromund Kaas Sarcophagus
[*] Hutta Poison Pit Sign
[*] Ilum Crystal Node
[*] Ilum Kolto Tank
[*] Ilum Turret
[*] Ord Mantell Fire Barrell
[*] Ord Mantell Wardrobe
[*] Tython Statue
[*] Tython Training Bay
[*] Killik Stalker Larva Pet
[*] Starter Planet Mounts

World Map 

We have made a host of quality of life improvements to the World Map to help in navigating the Galaxy! The first thing to note is that we have added a 3 section accordion menu to the left side of the World Map, let’s talk about what is in each of those sections!
[list]
[*] Quick Travel - This now has a filter button that can be used as a toggleable shortcut to quickly isolate Quick Travel points in respect to important Mission icons. Toggling it off will put your filters right back to your original preference!
[*] Encounters - The most exciting of the new sections, the Encounters section will highlight all available Dynamic Encounters in your area. Clicking on one will begin tracking it, this will act as an aid to help breadcrumb you straight to the event location
[*] Filters - The Galaxy Map, Filter options, and Magnifying Glass have been organized into this small utility menu.
[*] 
[/list]

[b]Combat Updates[/b]

We want to ensure that players have a viable, fun, and fantasy-fulfilling experience from the default choices that we make within your Combat Style. We’ve reevaluated the default choices within Disciplines and are making a variety of changes.

[*] Deception Assassin and Infiltration Shadow
[*] Now Hatred Assassin and Serenity Shadow by default[list]

[/list]
[/list]

The above will be available on the Public Test Server before launch. We’re continuing to work on modernization for additional species to be released in future updates.

New skin colors will be available to all players with 7.7! Cathar, Chiss, Mirialan, Nautolan, Sith Pureblood, Togruta, and Twi’lek characters will see an abundance of new skin colors added to their skin customization sliders.

notes.title: Executive Producer Letter - Q1 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/db581a10ab4c47a771c183895de2ea26e40153e1.png[/img]

Hi folks! 

We’re wrapping up the first quarter of 2025, and we have quite a bit happening right now! Let’s get into what’s new in SWTOR the last few months, and then move into what will be coming in the near future. 

[u][b]Game Updates [/b][/u]

We kicked off with Game Update 7.6.1 featuring Galactic Season 8 “[url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250310]Rising Powers[/url]”, letting players take advantage of special buffs that would help them demolish their enemies in Uprising Encounters. This season comes with a plethora of new rewards including items like the Senator Consort hairstyle and Coruscant and Kaas Compact Cruiser Mounts inspired by the Disney+ series [i]Andor[/i]™. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/2b914c33f6d6495e5e8dfb719dd20f6351ce2265.png[/img]
[i](Appearance Options: Senator’s Consort Hairstyle)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/c6c2664569a856036aace6f3cf627fc41657bfbc.png[/img]
[i](Coruscant Compact Cruiser)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/a55094b6dbd7dd3558393d101b0714a6ae457fe9.png[/img]
[i](Kaas Coruscant Compact Cruiser)[/i]

Many rewards are also heavily themed around a couple of our starter planets, Coruscant and Dromund Kaas. 

For players who enjoy decorating their Strongholds, we also released Coruscant and Dromund Kaas themed Utility Bundles that can be found in the Cartel Market. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/3958f62b8efdb7f335d68c3cffbaa93210e3a4fb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/fa9904eb54d5647a440b1dc50f7db532b28430c3.png[/img]
(Dromund Kaas and Coruscant themed Utility Bundles)

[u][b]Public Test Server (PTS)[/b][/u]

We recently opened up a new round of PTS to share progress on character modernization updates. We want to thank everyone who has participated and your feedback is a critical part of putting the final touches on this work. We’ll be releasing updates to character models over time beginning with the neckline seam improvements which will be released in Game Update 7.6.1c. Further refinements to face smoothing and other initiatives will appear on PTS at a later time.  

Currently, we are gathering feedback on character modernization until April 3rd and then we will be preparing to open the PTS to release Master Mode for Relentless Replication! 

Experienced players who enjoy a good challenge will want to check out the newest mode for this encounter. We will be gathering feedback here! 

More details regarding the PTS will be posted when we have them, so keep an eye on our forums and social channels for future updates. 

[u][b]What else is happening?[/b][/u]

As a reminder, the AC-10 Disruptor Mount Twitch Drop is currently active until April 8th.  Watch four hours of live SWTOR content on Twitch to unlock this reward. If you haven’t yet, hook up your SWTOR and Twitch accounts on the My Account page on swtor.com to ensure that you can obtain this mount and future Drops. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/19f3c4b9f95bdee069bccb2a22184e7e00674aec.png[/img]
[i](AC-10 Disruptor Mount)[/i]

[u][b]What’s coming up? [/b][/u]

This is a wonderful year for Star Wars™ fans all around the world! [i]Star Wars[/i] Celebration [i]2025™[/i] will be hosted in Tokyo, Japan this year and those attending may see a couple of familiar faces there. While we are not hosting a Cantina, Ashley, Jackie, and Joe will be out and about meeting players and representing SWTOR during that weekend. 

SWTOR will also have a featurette on the [i]Star Wars Celebration Live™[/i] stream as well. We will communicate the exact date and time when it will air, and you will not want to miss it. We plan to show some never before seen footage, so be sure to tune in!  

Naturally, we will also have special in-game rewards available to partake in the festivities: 

[u]Jubilee Hover Pod Log In Reward[/u]

Available from April 17, 12pm CT / 5pm UTC to April 30, 12pm CT / 5pm UTC
All players who log in at any time between the times above will receive this Celebration themed reward

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/895e4ecc424aeacd99aa3348ab9fb176973a6841.png[/img]
[i](Jubilee Hover Pod Log In Reward)[/i]


[u](Naboo C-Type Speeder Mount Subscriber Reward)[/u]

Players who have an active subscription between April 17, 12pm CT / 5pm UTC and May 23, 12pm CT / 5pm UTC will unlock this Celebration themed mount! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/60d810a0f9da124056192f45e38ba64351f622b6.png[/img]
[i](Naboo C-Type Speeder Mount Subscriber Reward)[/i]

At the end of April, we will be releasing the next Master the Fight bundle, featuring the Storm I. This mount is mini pet compatible, is rideable at level 1, and comes with a fun flourish and additional speed boost! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/70cdc999c635a456e01223cecc9a3da07e1c0732.png[/img]
[i](Storm I mount. Flourish does not deal actual damage)[/i]


That brings us to May! We will have a log in reward to celebrate May 4th, and a variety of events and sales happening during that time. Stay tuned for more details! 

We also anticipate hosting the Game Update 7.7 livestream sometime in early May. More Dynamic Encounters and Master Mode for Relentless Replication will be coming in 7.7 as will additional character customization options and more. We’ll go over all the details in the stream, so keep an eye out for the date announcement. 

[u][b]Is there any update on story content?[/b][/u]

The team has not stopped working on our story updates! We shared details about "Galactic Threads" in the 7.6 livestream, and are looking forward to sharing a glimpse of "Master's Enigma" in the 7.7 livestream. We know story is a vital part of what makes SWTOR so special, and we're eager to release these updates as soon as we can. We thank you for your patience and understanding, and we're looking forward to bringing these updates live!

-Keith

This seasonal event returns with the launch of 7.6.1! Return to your homestead on Dantooine to complete a variety of daily and weekly missions and earn new rewards! Read more details [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20250310]here[/url]!

[b]Twitch Drop[/b]

The AC-10 Disruptor Mount is the newest Drop that can be obtained after watching four hours of SWTOR content on Twitch! This Drop will remain active until April 8, 2025. To accrue progress toward this reward, connect your SWTOR and Twitch account through your account page on swtor.com. 

[b]Beyond 7.6.1[/b]

[u]Character Modernization Status[/u]

Our priorities after Game Update 7.6 include the following: 
[list]
    [*]Reworking source assets to address wrinkles and muscle definition[/*]
    [*]Reworking textures to fix neckline seams[/*]
    [*]Improving textures on vibrant colored species such as Chiss[/*][/list]
Other initiatives we are tackling include the following:
[list]
    [*]Improved lighting for characters in gameplay to better match what’s seen in cinematics [/*]
    [*]Improved lighting in Preview Window[/*]
    [*]Additional Species[/*][/list]
Players will see the first set of changes when we stand up PTS very soon! 

[u]Relentless Replication - Master Mode[/u]

Once we wrap testing and gathering feedback for character modernization, we will re-open the PTS for players to test Master Mode for the Propagator Core XR-53 encounter. 

Keep an eye on our forums and social channels to know when we begin opening up the PTS!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/e814567eaf3e8861334317495c003813538bffdc.jpg[/img]

Galactic Seasons 8 “Rising Powers” will begin with the launch of Game Update 7.6.1 on March 11! Once the update goes live, players will be able to make progress through the Free Reward track or the Subscriber Reward track (both tracks are available to Subscribers!) and earn new rewards. Below are the details of what players can expect from this new season!

[u][b]Uprisings with a twist![/b][/u]

For the duration of Galactic Seasons 8 (GS8), players will be encouraged to jump back into Uprisings to complete their weekly objectives. While similar to Flashpoints, Uprisings are fast paced 4-player group content that can be completed quickly. Each Uprising is available in Story, Veteran, and Master Mode. All modes can be accessed through the terminals in the Combat Training section of the fleet. Veteran Mode Uprisings are also available through the Activities Window for players who are looking to group up with others. 

Previously, Uprisings were available to Subscribers between levels 75 and 80. Beginning with 7.6.1, this content will now be available for all players beginning level 10 and will remain openly accessible after the season ends. 

At the start of “Rising Powers”, none other than Kai Zykken will reach out with an offer to test a new adrenal boost created by Czerka. These[b] Experimental Combat Enhancers[/b] have a variety of effects that can give you a special buff. Upon using the combat enhancer, you will receive the following buffs that will last for the duration of the Uprising:  

Destruction Overload - Every 5th enemy that is defeated will explode causing a damaging AOE effect
Czerka Combat Drones - Drones will assist you in taking your enemies down
Unstable Radiation Field - A devastating point blank AOE will help you decimate your enemies

Be careful though! Your enemies may also benefit from combat enhancers as well, so stay sharp!

These Experimental Combat Enhancers can be found on the Galactic Season reward track and in Ki’at Thavo’s inventory during the season. 


[b][u]Seasonal Rewards![/u][/b]

As with previous Seasons, there will be a Free and Subscriber track that players can earn rewards from as they complete objectives and progress through Galactic Seasons 8. Rewards for this season will feature items themed around Coruscant and Dromund Kaas and inspired by [i]Star Wars: Skeleton Crew™ [/i]and [i]Andor[/i]™ !

notes.title: Game Update 7.6.1 livestream recap
notes.content:
If you were unable to watch-or if you want a recap of everything we showed during our Game Update 7.6.1 Livestream, don't worry! Below is a VOD and breakdown of what we showed during the stream.

[previewyoutube=Ibh-6UzXMcw;full][/previewyoutube]

A new Twitch Drop is now active until March 12th! In order to obtain the Ord Mantell Poster Decoration, you must watch 1 hour of live SWTOR content on Twitch. Be sure to connect your Twitch and SWTOR account on the website so you can earn this new deco today! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/c940026fa39b0a35a579f82b4726f3cc1bced5d9.png[/img]
[i](Ord Mantell Poster (purple frame)[/i]

When 7.6.1 is live (date TBD), players will be able to earn another Twitch Drop reward. 

The AC-10 Disruptor mount will be unlocked after 4 hours of watch time and earnable for 28 days following 7.6.1 launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/19f3c4b9f95bdee069bccb2a22184e7e00674aec.png[/img]

[b]Galactic Season 8 “Rising Powers”[/b]

Kai Zykken reaches out offering an opportunity to try out Czerka’s new Experimental Combat Enhancers. In order to test the effectiveness of these seasonal items, players will be guided to jump back into Uprisings content. 

We will be opening up Uprisings to all players and make them available at level 10. 

Upon consuming the Experimental Combat Enhancer, players will receive one of three available buffs that will help them decimate their enemies as they complete Uprisings objectives:
[list]
[*] Destruction Overload Buff - Every 5th enemy that is defeated will explode causing a damaging AOE effect
[*] Czerka Combat Drones Buff - Drones will assist you in taking your enemies down! 
[*] Unstable Radiation Field Buff - A devastating point blank AOE
[/list]
A word of caution. The combat enhancers may also give your enemies a buff as well, so stay sharp! 

New rewards will be available on the free and Subscriber tracks. Here are some of the rewards that players can earn. 

Legacy Titles
[list]
[*] Risen
[*] Powerful
[/list]
Titles
[list]
[*] Czerka Scientist
[*] Dromund Kaas Resident
[*] Coruscant Resident
[/list]
Stronghold Labels
[list]
[*] Seat of Power
[*] The Laboratory
[/list]

We will also be adding [i]Andor[/i]™ inspired Senator’s Consort and Regal Senator’s hairstyle customizations to the reward tracks! 

More details on Galactic Season 8 “Rising Powers” will be coming soon! 

[b]New Basilisk Prototype Venture Customizations[/b]

Four new B3-S1 variants will be added to a new vendor at Lane’s Lab! Turn in Prototype Data, role-specific currencies, and credits to help fund The Curator’s projects in order to obtain the new variants!

Beginning in 7.6.1, players can also find new B3-S1 Training Modules for completing Dynamic Encounters on Hoth and Tatooine!


[b]Cartel Market Additions[/b]

Two themed Utility Bundles and a [i]Star Wars: Skeleton Crew[/i]™ inspired outfit will be coming to the Cartel Market. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/3958f62b8efdb7f335d68c3cffbaa93210e3a4fb.png[/img]

(Peerless Explorer’s Enviro-Suit)[/i]

[b]Cartel Market Storefront Updates[/b]

We will be retiring older, lower performing items from the Cartel Market beginning February 26th. Items intended to be removed from the Cartel Market will be added to the “Sale” tab and rotated out on a bi-weekly basis by category. The first Category Sale will be weapons. These storefront updates do not impact dyes. Be sure to check in on the Cartel Market often to see what’s on sale! 

[b]Master the Fight Bundle: Storm Edition[/b]

A new Master the Fight bundle is on the way! Here’s a sneak peek into the Storm I mount that will be included in the bundle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/70cdc999c635a456e01223cecc9a3da07e1c0732.png[/img]
[i](Storm I mount)[/i]

The bundle will include new dyes, subscription time, and Cartel Coins. More details will be released at a later time. 

[b]New Legacy Perk[/b]

Increased Speed Boost (Improved Speeder Rank 6) will be available to Subscribers per character! 

[b]Dynamic Encounter Achievements[/b]

More Achievements have been added to the Tatooine and Hoth Dynamic Encounters. 

[b]Character Modernization Status[/b]

Our priorities after Game Update 7.6 remain: 
[list]
[*] Reworking source assets to address wrinkles and muscle definition
[*] Reworking textures to fix neckline seams
[*] Improving textures on vibrant colored species such as Chiss
[/list]
Other initiatives we are tackling in addition to the above include: 
[list]
[*] Improved lighting for characters in gameplay to better match what’s seen in cinematics 
[*] Improved lighting in Preview Window
[*] Additional Species
[/list]
Players will see the first set of changes when we stand up PTS after 7.6.1 launch. 

[b][i]STAR WARS[/i]™ Celebration[/b]

SWTOR will have a short segment during this year’s[i] Star Wars™[/i] Celebration Live stream! We will also have a Celebration themed log in reward and special Subscriber reward. Stay turned for more details. 


Game Update 7.6.1 is targeting a March release!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d1375173c566e5017eb471caf7a0a7137be56f73.png[/img]

[b]The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally[/b]

Date: February 4 - February 10 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
Requirement: Level 20+

In the growing shadow of war, swoop fans across the galaxy descend on Dantooine, Tatooine, and even Onderon for the sport’s biggest spectacle—The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally! They’re packing the stands, eager to take their minds off their troubles and cheer their favorite swoop gangs. The bikers are here to take on dangerous challenge courses, show off their piloting skills, and flaunt their souped-up swoop bikes. The thunder of the engines, the deafening applause from the fans, the wind battering their helmets… there’s no bigger rush for these thrill seekers.

Despite their reputation as wild rebels whose makeshift courses disregard local districting restrictions, swoop gangs aren’t a serious threat to anyone--something all true swoop fans know! They just love adrenaline-pounding speed, sweet jumps, and big explosions, and the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally combines all three in one crowd-pleasing package. The biggest gangs on the circuit — Horizon’s Razor, the Pit Screamers, and the Blatant Beks — are ready to show their fans a great time.

Rakghoul Resurgence on Alderaan

Date: February 18 - February 24 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
Requirement: Level 25+

The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization (T.H.O.R.N.) has issued an official level-2 emergency alert concerning an outbreak of the Rakghoul plague on Alderaan. Quarantines have been put in place to restrict traffic of the plague off-world, but exceptions will be made for individuals with priority clearance.

T.H.O.R.N. is recruiting qualified volunteer emergency responders to travel to affected areas to combat the spread of the Rakghoul plague. More information about the outbreak can be found by checking the News Terminals on the Republic or Imperial Fleet!

T.H.O.R.N. wishes to remind you that plague symptoms can be treated if they are identified in the early stages of infection. Whether or not you have travel plans, please consult your nearest trusted medical supply droid and get vaccinated!

notes.title: Executive Producer Letter - Q4 2024
notes.content:
Hi folks! 

Happy 13 years with Star Wars: The Old Republic! Much has been accomplished this year and we are happy to see players enjoying Game Update 7.6 “Galactic Threads”. Let’s take a look at what’s happened in 2024 so far! 

[b]Game Updates [/b]

We started off the year with [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20240312]Galactic Seasons 6 “Building a Foundation”[/url] and debuted [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20240312-1]Date Night Companion missions[/url] featuring Arcann, Koth Vortena, Theron Shan, and Lana Beniko. We will continue to deliver these throughout the year and keep you all posted on the next companions. 
Game Update 7.5 “Desperate Defiance” released in late May and came with a variety of new content including the continuation of the main storyline, the debut of the Basilisk Prototype Venture, a new spring seasonal event, and a modernization update for the planet Hutta. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0NLU_pgU1xk&t

[url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20240820]Galactic Seasons 7 “The Greatest Bounty”[/url], which released with Game Update 7.5.1 was extended to January 7, so be sure get all your bounties in to reap all the rewards! 

And now [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20241210]Game Update 7.6[/url] launched on December 10 and with it came [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20241210-0]Dynamic Encounters, the Propagator Core XR-53 Operation Boss[/url], [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20241209]PvP Season 7[/url], Life Day, and more modernization updates to planets Tython, Hoth, Korriban, and Ilum and also character models.   

[b]Modernization [/b]

The team has done an incredible job with the modernization updates over the last couple years, and one question I have seen pop up every now and then is “why modernize the game?”. The short answer is that SWTOR launched in 2011, and we have to replace, extend, and refine our technology which enables us to continue delivering regular updates to the game. Both hardware and software have substantially improved over the years and many of our changes enable us to leverage the new tech.

There have been huge improvements made in 7.6 to the environments of Tython, Korriban, Hoth, and Ilum, and I am pleased to see our modernization efforts continue with character models. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WN7JD4pTpks

[b]Mac Launcher[/b]

In case you missed it, we now have an [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/938305-welcome-to-the-mac-launcher-open-beta-test/]open beta test for the new Mac launcher[/url]! Back in October, we opened a closed technical test and we received nearly a thousand players responding to it!  We rolled out the technical test to several groups of players to validate how the launcher and ultimately the game would perform on select M-Series Mac machines. We’ve now moved to open beta, and anyone who would like to check it out can download the launcher from the main page on swtor.com. 

[b]Skeleton Crew inspired items[/b]

Our collaboration with Lucasfilm Games continues on with new [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20241210-0]Cartel Market offerings[/url] inspired by the Disney+ series [i]Star Wars: Skeleton Crew™[/i]. The Mysterious Rogue outfit and Fearless Buccaneer weapons are fun additions to any player’s wardrobe who may want to indulge in the pirate life. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/cf18eef5923480ed7610864c6c9fe9c46ba1bd66.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d577d9a4dfa999a995fd1e0deef2c313dfb49dc8.png[/img]

Fun fact, a new mount inspired by the speeder bike as seen in [i]Star Wars: Skeleton Crew[/i] is now in-game and you’ll notice that it has a rather unique feature about it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/8bfc5f96cb3938570793f4244bb48cbf9ebdde94.png[/img]

That’s right, companion and mini pet functionality has now come to SWTOR! The [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20241129]Meirm Cicada mount[/url] is our newest reward for any player who is a Subscriber through January 4, 2025.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/86e6c231a46a9e515fc945ac8fb880cda9d87701.png[/img]

[b]What else is happening?[/b]
 
Another Twitch Drop campaign is now active and the reward is a highly requested Amethyst Vulptilla Mount. Watch four hours of live SWTOR content on Twitch to unlock this reward. If you haven’t connected your SWTOR and Twitch account, you can do so on the account page on [url=https://account.swtor.com/en/account]SWTOR.com[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6a98dbe16616e890332d12f3c31a7d4136836754.png[/img]

[b]Events and sales[/b]
[list]
[*] Our Anniversary Event is now live and will be active until January 3, 2025.  
[*] The Coruscant and Kaas City Strongholds are discounted to 13 credits (down from 5000) until the next game update.
[*] Life Day is now live and will be active until January 7, 2025. 
[*] The Double XP event runs from December 22, 2024 to January 2, 2025. 
[*] The 50% off Collection Unlocks sale is now active and will run until January 7, 2025.
[*] If you missed the announcement during our dev stream, all dyes in the Cartel Market are 50% off! 
[/list]
Last month, we released the limited time offer [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3076020/STAR_WARS_The_Old_Republic__Master_the_Fight__Starbolt_Edition/]Master the Fight: Starbolt Edition bundle[/url]. This bundle includes: 
[list]
[*] 180 Days Subscription Time + 600 Cartel Coins per month
[*] 5500 Cartel Coins
[*] Vectron 240R Starbolt Mount 
[*] Rideable at level 1
[*] Base speed as fast as Speeder Rank 5 (130%)
[*] Gives players a speed boost while mounted
[*] Primary Metallic Yellow Dye (x5 per character)
[*] Secondary Metallic Yellow  Dye (x5 per character)
[*] Bundle is priced at $99.99 USD
[/list]
Be sure to pick it up before January 14, 2025!

[b]What’s coming up? [/b]

We are really excited as we look towards 2025! Let's talk about the beginning of the year. First up will be Game Update 7.6.1 in the first quarter of the year which will kick off our next Galactic Season. This one will be a fun one as we throw you into some content you may not have played in a bit... be sure to come back early in the year for our livestream to hear about that season and everything else planned for the update.

And then of course, right on the horizon of 7.6.1 is 7.7! Really looking forward to talking about our plans here as we have a new <redacted> coming with some new <redacted>, the continuation of our story, along with a host of other things to tell you about! Last but not least, we can't forget that 2025 is the next Star Wars Celebration 2025 is just around the corner and so I'm just excited as a Star Wars fan to see what next year holds for all of us.

Enjoy Game Update 7.6, have a happy holiday, and we will see you in the new year!

-Keith

notes.title: Game Update 7.6 debuts Dynamic Encounters and The Propagator Core XR-53
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b432df44ff75b7c119e4b7c64921ed5b77e7a649.png[/img]

[u][b]Dynamic Encounters[/b][/u]

Dynamic Encounters is new world content that breathes life into planets and offers a wide variety of repeatable activities that rotate their availability over time. This content makes its debut with Game Update 7.6 and can be found on Tatooine and Hoth. 

When players make their way to either of these planets with the Galaxy Map, they can immediately see which Encounters are active. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/22be02235bdd0add3ccba0bb18285805dff1d52c.png[/img]

As players venture out and explore, they will see unique icons pop up on their map indicating that a Dynamic Encounter is currently active. Once a player is close enough to the Encounter, the mission tracker will update with a description of the Encounter and what requirements need to be fulfilled in order to complete the Encounter. All encounters can be completed solo or in a group. There are two different types of encounters: those that share progress normally (only with others in your group) and those that share progress between all active players in the encounter area--even if you aren't in a group. These use different icons to let you know which is which. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/9e531b12bf90f8087c485b45f1ff6e4d9eb7f676.png[/img]

[u]What kind of Dynamic Encounters are there? [/u]

Though you may be tasked to take down enemy NPCs and mini bosses, not every Encounter requires combat! On Hoth, you may need to calm some anxious Ice Kittens or carry baby Tauntauns up a hill just so they can happily run down it and back to their mother. On Tatooine, you may come across a Cantina band experiencing travel woes and you need to help repair their vehicles or become an Ad Gonk droid and market their show to patrons. 

[b]Hidden Chain Invasions[/b] are unique Dynamic Encounters that can occur on Tatooine, Hoth, Rishi, and Ilum. Stop Heta Kol’s forces from wreaking havoc in the galaxy by summoning friendly NPC faction forces to take down the Hidden Chain and earn rewards for doing so. 

[u]What are the rewards? [/u]

There are a number of rewards that can be earned as Dynamic Encounters are completed! Alongside numerous Achievements, players can earn Conquest Commendations, Tech Fragments, Mounts, a unique decoration, and armor sets! 

Hidden Chain Invasions Encounters will drop pieces of the Hidden Chain armor set and various Encounters on Hoth and Tatooine will drop pieces of the Electric Gaze armor set. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/3386e38280d6b241c7f6eb5cb686766292192277.png[/img]

Completing specific (and also rare) Dynamic Encounters on Hoth may drop the Everglade Zakkeg mount and the Hoth Snowcap decoration. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/37c51350d6b0275356923611a658ecf4bed58e0d.png[/img]

A rare and unique Freckled Loth-cat Kitten pet can be obtained upon completing kitten related Dynamic Encounters on Hoth. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/03ef42bf32ab9d57f9b986348cb3f0146c149bfe.png[/img]

Upon completing the meta-Achievement for Hoth, players will receive the Frozen Peaks Mount. Completing the meta-Achievement for Tatooine will yield the Desert Sand Mount. Both mounts come with mini-pet functionality! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f138cea2eda9f27e8136596a763474736066e307.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/614d89158ed280f74bf50d8099ef499600fbce6e.png[/img]

We look forward to creating more missions for other planets in the future! 



[u][b]The Propagator Core XR-53 Operation Boss on Story and Veteran Mode![/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6c52b49737dc4746c55d575cdcbf75ceb2fca92c.png[/img]

The Propagator Core XR-53 originated from one of the many broken pieces when the Emperor's Fortress crashed onto Ilum. The XR-53 is a Rakatan droid replicator trying to fix itself by harvesting resources. As players explore an abandoned production lab on Ilum, they may find themselves the XR-53’s newest targets to be collected. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/91ed2d47241df6f4087036da4df5fc91e9904c47.png[/img]
(Complete Construct enemy NPC)

There are two ways to begin the encounter. Players can: 

[list]
[*] Fly to Ilum and approach the phase gate located in the main base camp
[*] Use the Group Activity Finder window and choose “Relentless Replication” for Story Mode
[list]
[*] For a limited time, Relentless Replication will be the only Encounter listed in the window 
[/list][/list]
Players are encouraged to jump into a 8-player group and take down XR-53 not only for the excitement of a challenging fight, but also because this boss drops the needed components to craft new augments! 

Three new tiers of augments have been introduced with 7.6: 

[list]
[*] Augment 83 (Item Rating, 296 Prototype)
[list]
[*] The tradeable Schematic to craft these will drop from the XR-53 fight on Story Mode [/list]
[*] Augment 86 (Item Rating 302, Prototype) [list]
[*] The tradeable Schematic to craft these will drop from the XR-53 fight on Veteran Mode[/list]
[*] Advanced Augment 86 (Item Rating 310, Artifact)[list]
[*] The schematic is only available by deconstructing Augment 86.[/list][/list]

A full breakdown of these augments can be found [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/937613-new-augments-coming-in-patch-76]here[/url]. 

A full list of the updated schematics and requirements can be found [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/937613-new-augments-coming-in-patch-76/page/2/#findComment-9832364]here[/url]. 


We hope you enjoy Dynamic Encounters and the new Operation boss!

notes.title: Active Subscribers will be getting a new ride beginning 7.6!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/625e0b99cd1b3a53178add28e741fd0c39d67173.png[/img]

SWTOR’s first ever companion and mini pet mount will be coming in Game Update 7.6! As a thank you to our most active players, The Meirm Cicada Mount will be free to players who are Subscribers between November 29, 2024 and January 4, 2025. 

The Meirm Cicada mount has both companion AND mini pet functionality, so players are able to enjoy their galactic road trips with a full squad. However, due to size limitations of the passenger seat, keep in mind that some companions like B3-S1 won’t fit.

If you’re looking for options to Subscribe, check out the various plans [url=https://www.swtor.com/buy]here[/url]. We have: 
[list]
[*] A new Master the Fight bundle (comes with 6 months sub time, 5,500 Cartel Coins +600 per month, 10 primary and secondary yellow dyes per character, and the Vectron 240R Starbolt Mount)
[*] Join the Fight bundle (comes with 60 days sub time, 2400 Cartel Coins, and the K-NorCo B5C Mount)
[*] Month to month subscription plan
[*] 60-180 days subscription plans
[/list]
The mount will be granted to Subscribers beginning Game Update 7.6 launch. We look forward to seeing which companions and pets you choose to join in on your travels around the galaxy!

notes.title: Public Test Server Update: Changes and Fixes
notes.content:
A new PTS build was released earlier today! Here’s a snapshot of the changes that players can now see and test.

[b]Character modernization:  [/b]
[list]
[*] Before hopping onto the PTS, please read Eric’s Character Modernization Status forum post! 
[*] In this iteration of PTS, players will see a fix applied to the shader change that impacted character models. Please leave feedback here.  
[/list]
[b]Steam launcher[/b]
[list]
[*] If connecting to the PTS via Steam, players should no longer see the EULA box pop up after accepting the terms and conditions once. 
[*] The launcher carousel design now matches the SWTOR launcher. 
[/list] 
[b]Propagator Core XR-53 Changes[/b]

[u]Boss Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Made general adjustments to the flow of the Propagator Core XR-53’s abilities in order to space them more regularly. This should help create a more predictable cast cadence, and allow movement to be smoother.
[/list]
[u]Extraneous Expulsion[/u]
[list]
[*] Should now properly drop pools in all cases.
[*] Now acquires targets in a rectangular shape (Was a cone).
[/list]
[u]Hungering Bite[/u]
[list]
[*] Should now properly find targets inside its warning.
[*] Now acquires targets in a rectangular shape (Was a cone).
[/list]
[u]Lethal Strike[/u]
[list]
[*] No longer completely blocked by certain mitigation abilities, e.g. Sonic Rebounders.
[*] The Propagator Core XR-53 should no longer begin casting abilities while airborne.
[/list]
[u]Story Changes[/u]

Powerful Construct
[list]
[*] Added a 50% absorb shield to the Propagator Core XR-53 while the Powerful Construct has not yet cast Explosive Finality or been defeated.
[/list]

[u]Veteran Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Increased Propagator Core XR-53’s damage by 5%.
[*] Added visible debuffs on the Propagator Core XR-53 that indicate which role has been sampled by the Prime Directive so far. One each for Tank, Healer, and DPS.
[/list]
Lethal Strike
[list]
[*] Lethal Strike will no longer be mitigateable from the second stack onwards.
[/list]
Imperfect Construct
[list]
[*] Health increased to 388k (was 310k)
[/list]
Prey Seeker Droid
[list]
[*] Health increased to 388k (was 155k)
[/list]
Defender Construct
[list]
[*] Health increased to 4M (was 1.5M)
[/list]
Supplicant Construct
[list]
[*] Health increased to 3.1M (was 1.5M)
[/list]
Rampaging Construct
[list]
[*] Health increased to 3.1M (was 1.5M)
[*] The Rampage buff will now properly state that it increases damage by 25%, not 10%.
[*] Rampage should no longer be reflectable.
[/list]
[u]Dynamic Encounters[/u]
[list]
[*] General bug fixes
[*] Various improvements to all Dynamic Encounters which include new steps and/or functionality
[*] The Conquest Objective "Missions: Dynamic Encounters Infinite" now requires 1 Dynamic Encounter to complete (down from 5) and rewards 1650 Conquest Points (down from 6900)
[/list]

notes.title: SWTOR to release inactive character names with Game Update 7.6
notes.content:
We’ve been looking for opportunities to release inactive character names, and we have selected 7.6 launch as the time to begin this process. Please read through this blog in its entirety to understand how you can keep your character name if it was impacted. 

[b]For players who are Subscribers on 7.6 launch[/b]
[list]
[*] None of your character names will be impacted
[/list]
[b]For players who have a F2P or Preferred account[/b]
[list]
[*] If you have not logged into a character since January 1, 2024, that character name will be released into an unreserved pool and can potentially be claimed by another player with 7.6 launch 
[*] If you would like to keep your character name, you must log into the game before 7.6 launch. 
[list]
[*]If you want to keep every character name, you must log in with every character before the  7.6 launch. 
[/list][*] If you are an active Subscriber at 7.6 launch, all of your character names will be preserved.
[/list]
[b]If you are a player who loses their claim on a character name:[/b]
[list]
[*] When you log into that character again, you will receive an opportunity to rename your character for free.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update 7.6 "Galactic Threads” Recap
notes.content:
If you were unable to watch-or if you want a recap of everything we showed during our Game Update 7.6 Livestream, don't worry! Below is a VOD and a breakdown of highlights from each segment we showcased on the stream.

7.6 Livestream VOD
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wilyuGT1V-g&t

[u]Twitch Drops [/u]

As a reminder, Twitch Drops are enabled! Be sure to connect your Twitch account to your SWTOR account. Drops will be active at the start of each dev stream and with every game update launch. 

From November 14th to November 28th, players will be able to obtain the Ilum Art Poster decoration (purple frame) after watching one hour of SWTOR content. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/3d728430cda2767569567b362409cdc397693dd0.png[/img]

At 7.6 launch, another Twitch Drop campaign will be active. After watching four hours of SWTOR content on Twitch, players will obtain the Amethyst Vulptilla Mount. This campaign will remain active for 28 days following 7.6 launch. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/5eeec7fb367b70e73e038a48755cdcde0055af15.png[/img]

[u]Galactic Threads Storyline [/u]

*Story spoilers for Update 7.5 story content in this section*

Galactic Threads begins immediately following the events from the Desperate Defiance storyline. Players and their Alliance race to find Darth Malgus and stop whatever plans he has set in motion. At the same time, players will also seek answers surrounding Darth Nul’s holocron and the Hidden Chain’s ambitions. 

Jekiah and Rass Ordo, Arn Peralun, Major Anri, Talos Drellik, Akaavi Spar, and Lana Beniko will be making a return in this story update. 

Story Missions will be taking players to Hoth, Tatooine, and the digsite at Nul’s temple of Elom. 

There is an important caveat that the team would like to address to set player expectations. While the “Galactic Threads” story chapter is well into production, the SWTOR Narrative team does not currently have all the components needed to deliver high-quality story content that adheres to the team’s standards, as well as player expectations for story. The release date for “Galactic Threads” is currently delayed until this content can be completed. Please note, no other content in Game Update 7.6 is impacted.

[u]Cartel Market Additions, Remote Trading Outpost Decorations, and the Master the Fight: Starbolt Edition Bundle[/u]

A new type of decoration bundle is making its debut with 7.6! The Remote Trading Post bundle is inspired by [i]Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge™[/i].

When initially purchased, players will receive one set of “neglected” decorations. These items will appear broken, damaged, and will need to be fixed! After completing a couple of light gameplay missions, players will receive a full set of fixed decorations.

But that’s not all!  Players will also receive two mini pets, a baby Dianoga and the D5-C0 DJ Droid.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/c2e94c032af582711b364f549c998fd1efc4c3a9.png[/img]

Also coming to the Cartel Market are [i]Star Wars: Skeleton Crew™[/i] inspired items including a new armor (plus one variant), an array of weapons, customizations, and new dyes. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/cf18eef5923480ed7610864c6c9fe9c46ba1bd66.png[/img]
[i](Mysterious Rogue Armor - with jacket and without jacket)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d577d9a4dfa999a995fd1e0deef2c313dfb49dc8.png[/img]
[i](Fearless Buccaneer weapons)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/afc851b19a4110f5d29ae94dbb7807ba73d32651.png[/img]
[i](Fearless Buccaneer lightsaber and dualsaber)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/edd18f09d15978f9cf4b2bbafbf40087dd62399e.png[/img]
[i](Left is default colors. Metallic Gray/Chrome White and Chrome White/Metallic Gray dyes have been applied in the second and third panels) [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/e28092fc567bc27661f20842ebafbef142931e72.png[/img]
[i](Long hair customization. This specific hairstyle will be free for all players!)[/i]

The Master the Fight: Starbolt Edition Bundle will be dropping November 15th! This bundle contains: 
[list]
[*] 180 Days Subscription Time + 600 Cartel Coins per month
[*] 5500 Cartel Coins
[*] Vectron 240R Starbolt Mount 
[*] [list]
[*] Rideable at level 1
[*] Comes with Speeder Rank 5
[*] Gives players a speed boost while mounted
[/list]
[*] Primary Metallic Yellow Dye (x5 per character)
[*] Secondary Metallic Yellow  Dye (x5 per character)
[*] Bundle is priced at $99.99 USD
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/720b714a5dd6be23e7fa39c06d032457c291aef0.png[/img]
[i](Vectron 240R Starbolt Mount) [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/c31c9c9623b28367da2a8ef427e38b59f8ccc5c5.png[/img]
[i](The left panel shows the armor’s default colors. Primary and Secondary Yellow dyes have been applied in the second and third panels)[/i]

Speaking of dyes! The team has been looking into ways to improve functionality and accessibility to dyes. We will keep you posted on upcoming changes.  In the meantime, [u][b]we are reducing the price of all dyes on the Cartel Market by 50%[/b][/u].  Now is the time to grab those packs you have been dying to own!

[u]Dynamic Encounters and the Propagator Core XR-53 Lair Boss[/u]

Dynamic Encounters is new world content that offers a variety of missions for players to experience. They are meant to breathe life into the planets they inhabit, giving players a sense that something is always happening at any given time. As players explore planets, they will naturally come across Dynamic Encounters or they can find active Encounters on their map. Missions can range from taking out Hidden Chain forces to herding escaped Banthas running amok in a space port. These Encounters will debut on Hoth and Tattoine with 7.6. 

Hidden Chain Invasions are special Dynamic Encounters where players are tasked with stopping Heta Kol’s forces as they continue to wreak havoc in the galaxy. These Encounters can take place on Hoth and Tattooine, but can also be found on several other planets.  

Dynamic Encounters will have a variety of rewards associated with them. Completing Encounters will yield tech fragments and Conquest Commendations, and unlocking Achievements. Hidden Chain Invasion Encounters will drop armor pieces. And a special rare Encounter will drop the Freckled Loth-cat mini pet. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/3386e38280d6b241c7f6eb5cb686766292192277.png[/img]
[i](Hidden Chain and Electric Gaze Armors)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/03ef42bf32ab9d57f9b986348cb3f0146c149bfe.png[/img]
[i](Freckled Loth-Cat Kitten pet)[/i]

Completing the meta-achievement for the Tatooine and Hoth Encounters will grant players the Desert Sand and Frozen Peaks Mounts. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f138cea2eda9f27e8136596a763474736066e307.png[/img]


[u]Propagator Core XR-53[/u]

A new lair boss will be coming with 7.6. The Propagator Core XR-53 originated from one of the many broken pieces when the Emperor's Fortress crashed onto Ilum. The XR-53 is a Rakatan droid replicator trying to fix itself by harvesting resources. Story and Veteran Modes will launch with 7.6. 

[u]Public Test Server Schedule and Incentives[/u]

Players can earn PTS specific incentives by completing Dynamic Encounters and taking down XR-53 in Story and Veteran Modes. Below is a breakdown of the requirements for each incentive. 

[b]Cutting Edge Title & Kai Zykken’s MK-85 Mount[/b]
[list]
[*] Complete 25 Dynamic Encounters with a Republic character on Tatooine and 25 on Hoth
[/list]
[b]Strike Team Hero Title & Kai Zykken’s MK-90 Mount[/b]
[list]
[*] Complete 25 Dynamic Encounters on Tatooine and 25 on Hoth with an Imperial character
[/list]
[b]B1-SAL + First Line of Defense, Strike Team Specialist, Strike Team Commander, and Led the Charge Titles[/b]
[list]
[*] Complete all of the Dynamic Encounters achievements
[/list]
[b]First of Many Title[/b]
[list]
[*] Defeat the Propagator Core XR-53 on Story Mode
[/list]
[b]First Among Veterans Title[/b]
[list]
[*] Defeat the Propagator Core XR-53 on Veteran Mode
[/list]
All incentives will be granted at 7.6 launch. 

[i]*PTS is only available to Subscribers[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/3a4aea3d6a32d75a0f6105195b8375acd1b6d871.png[/img]
(B1-SAL mini pet inspired by Andor)

[u]PvP Season 7[/u]

PvP Season 7’s theme is Path to Mastery, will begin with 7.6 launch, and will run for 16 weeks. Rewards include: 
[list]
[*] New armors and decorations
[*] Honorable Bow Emote
[*] Legacy Title: Pathfinder
[*] Master of Paths Title
[*] Meta-achievement Title: Seeker  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/8ea33f7b661113134f0c2b3b7ad5f1bf7742b48e.png[/img]
[i](Plumed Scout and Plumed Trapper Armors. Earned from the reward track)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/5520e0bff0ff04345a064b174d519c6d916a5cf0.png[/img]
[i](Feathered Range and Feathered Huntmaster Armors. Can be purchased from PvP vendor)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/32c2b2e1e6e15a5076c64f79ae2fc315d2937f02.png[/img]
[i](PvP Season 7 Battler, small, and large trophy decorations)[/i]

Two holistic changes will also be coming to PvP beginning 7.6: 
[list]
[*] Warzone matching will be updated allowing players to group up with four players max (down from eight).  
[*] Set Bonus effects on the level 75 Spoils of War gear will be disabled during PvP matches.
[/list]

[u]Life Day[/u]

Our winter seasonal event is almost upon us! Life Day will begin mid-December. Two new rewards will be available for players to get!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/7b3ac7203c12d533bc107cdefe0d2456108c081c.png[/img]
[i](Tirsa G1-F7 Mount)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6485ee0e6c45f699f7be5d5b4ef8dd00cb8902f4.png[/img]
[i](Life Day Ornate Robes. The left panel shows the default colors. The Havoc Squad red and white dye was applied to the armor in the right panel. )[/i]

[u]Best View in SWTOR 2024[/u]

The Best View finalists have been selected! Winners will be announced soon. 

[u]Mac Launcher Update[/u]

Our technical test is still underway and we are currently gathering and responding to feedback from players who have been invited to the test. Based on the testing, we are now planning to release the Mac Launcher in the near future. We will have more updates to share soon.

[u]Companion Mounts are coming to SWTOR[/u]

The [i]Star Wars: Skeleton Crew™ [/i]inspired Meirm Cicada Mount comes with *companion AND mini pet functionality. 

As a thank you to our players, the Meirm Cicada Mount will be free to players with an active subscription anytime between November 29 – January 4!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/625e0b99cd1b3a53178add28e741fd0c39d67173.png[/img]

*Not all companions are compatible with this mount. As an example, B3-S1 can’t fit!

Remember the Desert Sand and Frozen Peaks Lifter Mounts that can be earned through Dynamic Encounters? Surprise! They come with mini pet functionality too! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/614d89158ed280f74bf50d8099ef499600fbce6e.png[/img]


[u]Freeing Inactive Character Names[/u]

We’ve been looking for opportunities to release inactive character names, and have selected 7.6 launch as the time to begin this process. If you have not logged into a character since January 1, 2024, that character name will be released into an unreserved pool and can potentially be claimed by another player when 7.6 launches. Players who want to keep their character names must log into the game before the 7.6 launch and log into each character. Players who are Subscribers at 7.6 launch will not need to take any action. Read here for more details! 

[u]Modernization [/u]

Our modernization efforts continue on with Game Update 7.6. Players will see updates done to Tython, Korriban, Hoth, and Ilum.

But wait, there’s more! Character models, specifically heads, will also see improved fidelity across the game! Players will see updates to their character via updated character textures, along with ocular specularity and with lighting, and shader improvements. Our goal was to improve the fidelity of characters across the game while keeping your character uniquely yours. Texture changes are starting in this update with Human, Chiss, Cyborg, Miralukan, Mirialan, Togruta, Rattataki, and Zabrak models. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WN7JD4pTpks

Game Update 7.6 is coming early December!

notes.title: Big Star Wars The Old Republic update breathes new life into the 2011 MMORPG
notes.content:
I will always advocate for Star Wars: The Old Republic. While it never quite reached the heights of rivals like World of Warcraft or Final Fantasy 14, the MMORPG sequel to the KOTOR series is absolutely worth trying if you're a Star Wars fan. It successfully transforms the classic BioWare and Obsidian RPGs into a multiplayer format while still retaining what made them special, and because it's a free-to-play game you can jump in without any commitment. Even better, an Old Republic update has just been unveiled that freshens up its worlds, making now a great time to try it.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Public Test Server Update: Propagator Core XR-53 Changes and Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/0193cbab721f8a7841bb55e982a8089a9a5422ba.png[/img]

We will be releasing a new Public Test Server (PTS) build today at 10am CT / 4pm UTC. Below are the XR-53 (Story Mode) changes that will be included in the build. 

[u][b]General[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Propagator Core XR-53’s health has been reduced to 51M (down from 86M).
[/list]
[u][b]Abilities[/b][/u]

Digestive Enzyme
[list]
[*] Adjusted debuff duration to 20s (up from 15s).
[*] Digestive Enzyme’s damage type is now Internal.
[*] Digestive Enzyme’s per-stack ticking damage increased by 150%.
[/list]
Acidic Rocketry
[list]
[*] Cast time reduced to 1s (down from 2s).
[*] Rocket travel time increased to 3s (up from 2s).
[*] Propagator Core XR-53 will now be immobilized for 1s after completing the Acidic Rocketry Cast (was 2.5s).
[*] Acidic Rocketry now only targets the four furthest players from the boss in the group, as opposed to all players.
[/list]
Prepare for Harvest
[list]
[*] Cast time reduced from 2s to 1s.
[*] Propagator Core XR-53 will now be immobilized for 1.25s after completing the Prepare for Harvest cast (was 2.5s).
[*] Prepare for Harvest projectile travel time reduced from 2s to 0.5s.
[/list]
Extraneous Expulsion
[list]
[*] Cast time reduced to 2.5s (down from 4s).
[*] Fixed an issue where Extraneous Expulsion was dealing damage outside of its warning area.
[/list]
Hungering Bite
[list]
[*] Cast time reduced to 3s (down from 4s).
[*] Fixed an issue where Hungering Bite was dealing damage outside of its warning area.
[/list]
Lethal Strike
[list]
[*] Lethal Strike has been rebalanced. It now gives three different debuffs based on the role of the struck target, each called “Softened Up”. DPS and Healers afflicted with this debuff will now have a looping effect to indicate that they are afflicted with it.
[*] Tank: Lethal Strike deals 250% increased damage to the affected target. 45 second duration.
[*] Healer: All outgoing healing reduced by 75%. 1 minute duration.
[*] DPS: All outgoing damage reduced by 75%. 1 minute duration.
[/list]
Prey Seekers
[list]
[*] Cast time reduced to 1s (down from 3s).
[*] Prey Seeker Droids will now indicate who they are going to jump towards before doing so in order to give players time to react.
[/list]
Imperfect Fabrication
[list]
[*] Added a new buff called “Imperfect Fabrication” to the Propagator Core XR-53 with the following description: “The Propagator Core XR-53 is following its programming, but what it creates isn’t perfect…” to indicate that the boss is producing Imperfect Constructs.
[*] Imperfect Fabrication will now be inactive during the Prime Directive Phase of the encounter. Imperfect Fabrication will become active again after the Propagator Core XR-53 completes its Recovery Protocol.
[*] Decreased the frequency of Imperfect Construct spawns. They now appear once every 15 seconds (down from once every 10 seconds).
[*] Imperfect Constructs will now indicate who they are going to jump towards before doing so in order to give players time to react.
[/list]
Prime Directive
[list]
[*] Changed the color of the Prime Directive warning from red to orange to indicate caution instead of danger, as players should be aware that one of them needs to stand inside of it to avoid summoning the Mistaken Construct.
[*] The Propagator Core XR-53 will now broadcast that it is looking for one final sample when it is casting its Prime Directive ability.
[/list]
[u][b]Adds[/b][/u]

General
[list]
[*] All adds will now spawn in the center of the arena, which should ensure that they are more visible to players regardless of their location in the arena. 
[/list]
Prey Seeker Droid
[list]
[*] HP pool reduced to 155k (down from 310k).
[*] A Prey Seeker Droid will now properly increase the Propagator Core XR-53's Harvested Materials count if its channel is successful. 
[/list]
Powerful Construct
[list]
[*] Powerful Construct's Acidic Rocketry should no longer be reflectable.
[*] Powerful Construct’s Explosive Finality should no longer be reflectable. 
[/list]
Imperfect Construct
[list]
[*] HP pool reduced to 155k (down from 543k).
[*] Fixed an issue where Imperfect Constructs would find multiple targets and jump to both instead of finding only one.
[*] Imperfect Construct’s Imperfect Explosion should no longer be reflectable.
[/list]
Mistaken Construct
[list]
[*] HP pool increased to 30m (up from 552k).
[*] Volatile Output now properly applies a Digestive Enzyme stack to all players when they are struck by the Ability.
[*] Volatile Output now properly hits up to 8 targets instead of only hitting the closest 4.
[*] Volatile Output’s base damage has been doubled.
[*] Volatile Output should no longer be reflectable.
[/list]

Players can continue to leave feedback for this lair boss encounter [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/937362-propagator-core-xr-53-lair-boss-pts-feedback-story-mode/]here[/url]!

notes.title: Game Update 7.6 content is rolling out onto the Public Test Server!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/9805d147aa0ea52cf1f70d70cf492f85f9d78e9e.png[/img]

As announced in the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tuBOaTpQfCg]7.6 Public Test Server (PTS) video [/url]that was published last week, two new features will be coming to the PTS over the coming weeks. Below are all the details on the roll out schedule and the incentives tied to each.

[u][b]Dynamic Encounters[/b][/u]

Dynamic Encounters are coming to SWTOR in 7.6! As players explore Hoth and Tatooine, they'll notice a new type of Mission popping up on the map. Dynamic Encounters offer a variety of new adventures for players to experience, from rounding up escaped Bantha calves at the spaceport to defeating dangerous bosses or even helping a down-on-its-luck cantina band get back on the road. There are tons of Dynamic Encounters, and which missions are available will cycle throughout the day, giving these iconic planets brand new life.

In addition to these planetary Dynamic Encounters, players can participate in Hidden Chain Invasion Encounters. Heta Kol's forces are growing bold, staging assaults across several planets to secure resources for the Hidden Chain. These special Dynamic Encounters will only be available for a limited time as the Hidden Chain threatens the galaxy, so players will want to jump in and call upon their allies to help thwart their plans!   

Dynamic Encounters can be played solo or in a group, and completing them will net players unique rewards and achievements, giving everyone a great reason to discover these planets all over again.

[u]This feature debuts with PTS starting today![/u]

[u][b]Propagator Core XR-53[/b][/u]

The second feature that players got a sneak peek of last week is info on the new lair boss, the Propagator Core XR-53, and its level design. XR-53 can be found on Ilum as it was once a part of the Emperor’s Fortress that crashed during the Battle of Ilum. [u]This feature will debut in Story Mode next week with Veteran to follow at a later time.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/8e4efb40d7da8fb692d1179f4e72241cc4f801b0.png[/img]
(New boss encounter level design on Ilum)

[b][u]PTS Incentives[/u][/b]

As mentioned in the 7.6 PTS video, we are bringing back previously released PTS incentives and a few new ones! Here is the breakdown on what players need to do in order to obtain past and new incentives! 

[u]Dynamic Encounter Incentives[/u]

To earn the Cutting Edge Title and Kai Zykken’s MK-85 Log Mount, players must: 
[list]
[*] Complete 25 Dynamic Encounters with a Republic character on Tatooine
[*] Complete 25 Dynamic Encounters with a Republic character on Hoth
[/list]
To earn the Strike Team Hero Title and Kai Zykken’s MK-90 Holo-Log Mount, players must: 
[list]
[*] Complete 25 Dynamic Encounters with an Imperial character on Tatooine
[*] Complete 25 Dynamic Encounters with an Imperial character on Hoth
[/list]
Completing [u][b]all[/b][/u] of the Dynamic Encounters achievements above will grant players the B1-SAL mini pet droid! Along with this [i]Andor [/i]inspired pet, players will also receive the following titles:  
[list]
[*] First Line of Defense
[*] Strike Team Specialist
[*] Strike Team Commander
[*] Led the Charge
[/list]
[u]Lair Boss Incentives[/u]

To earn the First of Many Title, players must: 
[list]
[*] Defeat the Propagator Core XR-53 on Story Mode
[/list]
To earn the First Among Veterans, players must:  
[list]
[*] Defeat the Propagator Core XR-53 on Veteran Mode
[/list]
Players will be able to keep track of their progress as they unlock PTS Achievements, however, note that [u]these incentives will be granted at 7.6 launch[/u]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/cffe2dd23a600f5a9b151c836481154244900e82.png[/img]
(B1-SAL mini pet, inspired by [i]Andor[/i])


[u][b]When will the PTS open? [/b][/u]

The PTS is open now and players can get a first look into Dynamic Encounters today! Story Mode for XR-53 will be released next week with Veteran to follow in the weeks after. As always, the PTS sub-forums will be the space where we will be gathering feedback on these two new features. 

Eric Musco announced in the PTS video that we will also be hosting a livestream going over all of the features coming in 7.6 in November. It will be at this time that more content will be released on the PTS for players to check out.

In short, players will have more than a month to experience new content and obtain the PTS incentives.

To get started on the PTS and to leave feedback, read [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/937274-76-content-is-now-available-on-the-pts/]here[/url]. 

[i]*PTS is only available for Subscribers.   
*PTS is only available in EN[/i]

notes.title: The “Best View in SWTOR” Contest has returned for 2024!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f0a751de0b06b9bc945f1c7e4944dfc93ec5f8b9.jpg[/img]
[i](Ilum 2023 winner)[/i]

We are back with our fourth Best View in SWTOR contest! As with previous years, we’re looking forward to all the creative shots our players will be submitting. Starting today, players can submit screenshots taken anywhere on five select SWTOR locations. We’ll choose the screenshot that we feel captures the essence of that environment, so get creative! One winner will be chosen per location for a total of five winning submissions. 

The winning submissions will then be turned into Stronghold decorations and distributed by the Anniversary event vendor in-game! The five eligible locations for this contest are:

[list][*]Ziost[/*]
[*]CZ-198[/*]
[*]Section X[/*]
[*]Minboosa District[/*]
[*]The Black Hole[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/0711f31858ba35e106b7944353c26fa81d93eec5.jpg[/img]
[i](Onderon 2023 winner)[/i]

[u][b]How to Enter[/b][/u]

If you’re interested in participating in this contest, you can enter by submitting your screenshots to contests@swtor.com. You’re more than welcome to submit a screenshot for multiple locations, but please limit all submissions to only one location per email, and please only submit one image per location. All image submissions must follow certain guidelines:

[list][*]No Player Characters in screenshot
[list][*]NPCs are allowed[/*][/list][/*]
[*]The in-game UI needs to be turned off.
[list][*]The default command for this is Alt+Z[/*]
[*]This includes having nameplates turned off.[/*][/list][/*]
[*]Screenshots of cinematics do [b]NOT[/b] qualify.[/*]
[*]No additional editing done to screenshots. For example, no filters added or editing done by external tools.[/*]
[*]Camera settings must be within intended in-game parameters.
[list][*]This means not using external tools or editing game files to exceed in-game settings.[/*][/list][/*]
[*]Graphics settings at [b]Very High[/b] or [b]Ultra[/b][/*]
[*]Image Size: 1920x1080 or higher resolution
[list][*]The team will crop the chosen screenshots to a 4:3 format.[/*][/list][/*]
[*]Image Format: JPG[/*][/list]

In addition to those image requirements, we ask that your email include the following information:
[list][*]Subject line clearly states the name of the contest and the specific location where your screenshot submission was taken.[/*]
[list][*][b]Example: The Best View In SWTOR Contest - Ziost Submission[/b][/*][/list]
[*]Account Name.[/*]
[*]Name of an existing character on the listed account.[/*]
[*]Server the listed character resides on.[[/list]
The account, character, and server names are crucial to give the winners a special prize, so please don’t forget to include that! This contest is open to everyone, regardless of account status, so whether you’re a Subscriber or Preferred/Free-to-Play status, you’re encouraged to enter!

[u][b]Rules and Regulations[/b][/u]

Players have from now until October 20, 2024 to submit their screenshots! In addition to the above mentioned criteria and required information, there are a few additional rules players must follow in order for their submission to qualify:
[list]
[*]Qualifying accounts must have been created by September 1, 2024.[/*]
[*]Accounts need to have a clean standing, both in-game and on the forum.[list]
[*]No record of in-game suspension since September 4, 2023.[/*]
[*]No forum suspensions since July 1st, 2024.[/*][/list][/*]
[*]Character names must abide by our ToS rules.[/*]
[*]Screenshot submissions without the required information (Account name, Character name, and Server name) provided in the same email as the screenshot will be rejected.[/*]
[*]Each account is limited to one submission per location.[list]
[*]If you want to submit a screenshot for each eligible location, please send a separate submission per location.[/*][/list][/*]
[*]Submission emails that have more than one image attached will be disqualified.[/*]
[*]Email subject lines must follow the “The Best View In SWTOR Contest - [insert location name] Submission” format.[/*]
[/list]
Failure to adhere to the above guidelines will result in your submission being rejected. In the event that several people submit the same, or very similar, screenshots, the screenshot submitted first will be selected as the winner, so don’t wait to email us! 

[u][b]Results Announcement[/b][/u]

After the SWTOR team selects the winning submissions, we’ll publish an article announcing the winners before our upcoming 2024 Anniversary event. In this announcement, we’ll reveal the winning screenshots, and credit each player (Character Name / Server) who submitted a winning screenshot. 

While the winners are credited outside of the game, they will receive something special in SWTOR; a gilded version of the screenshot they submitted! While the normal versions will be available to everyone via the Anniversary event vendor as soon as the event starts in December, the gilded versions will be distributed shortly after the event starts.

We look forward to seeing what screenshots the community comes up with!
