notes.title: The Feast of Prosperity event is coming October 8th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/fe0a9dd864324b63c70f851ff6ae932d213ff447.png[/img]

[u][b]Feast of Prosperity[/b][/u]

Date: October 8 - November 5 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 5:00AM PST/12:00PM GMT)
Requirement: Level 20+

Over the years, the Hutt Cartel’s reputation has taken a hit. The once powerful organization no longer instills respect and fear. To restore the Cartel’s influence, two up-and-coming Hutts, Gaboorga the Abundant and Duuba the Magnanimous, are throwing the most lavish “charitable banquet” in history for the galaxy’s underprivileged. And if the Cartel happens to advance their business interests during the Feast, everyone wins!

If Gaboorga and Duuba can cooperate, they could rocket the Cartel back into the upper echelons of the galactic underworld. But the Hutts’ conflicting priorities means they’re constantly undermining each other. Each week a new Story Mission will unlock to progress this storyline, leading to the climatic choice during the third and final week: Gaboorga or Duuba? Only one Hutt can win, and the fate of the Feast of Prosperity is at stake. Choose wisely!

For players that participated in the event when it previously ran, you'll be able to immediately jump into the Daily Missions and mini-games! If this will be your first time experiencing the event, each week a Story Mission will unlock - progressing the conflict between Gaboorga and Duuba.

notes.title: The SWTOR team opens MacOS Technical Test sign ups to eligible players
notes.content:
Following Keith’s announcement in the [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20240920]Q3 Producer letter[/url] that the team has been internally testing a Mac launcher, we’re happy to announce opening up a test session for players who are interested in seeing how SWTOR performs with MacOS on Macs with Apple Silicon. 

We will be hosting a [u][b]closed technical test[/b][/u] for eligible players in the coming days. Here’s what we’re looking for: 

[list]
[*] Players who have an active subscription or Preferred account. 
[*] Players who use a Mac with an M-Series Chipset: M1, M2, etc…
[*] MacOS 14 Sonoma or newer - Older MacOS versions will not work during this test.
[*] [b]This is not compatible with pre 2020 Macs with Intel processors[/b]. To find out if you have an Intel-based Mac, following these steps: 
 [list]
[*] Click the Apple icon in the upper left corner
[*]Choose “About this Mac”
[*]If the window shows an item labeled “chip”, you have a Mac with Apple Silicon and you will be able to participate in this test.
[*]If the window shows an item labeled “processor”, you have an Intel-based Mac and will not be able to participate in this test.
[/list] [/list]
Please keep the following in mind: 
[list]
[*] [u]While this is a technical test, the launcher will be using a live environment[/u]. 
[*] This is a technical test, so unexpected issues may pop up such as not being able to log into the game or the client crashing. Should these issues occur, there will not be loss of data eg. inventory or characters.   
[*] All technical tests will be available in EN only.
[/list]
If you meet the criteria above and are interested in helping us test the Mac Launcher, please [url=https://forms.gle/NyGbzYa8TTz4GcVF6]fill out this form[/url]! If you are accepted into the test, you will receive an email with further instructions from us. 

[u][b]We will keep the form open until October 8[/b][/u].

notes.title: Executive Producer Letter - Q3 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/db581a10ab4c47a771c183895de2ea26e40153e1.png[/img]

Hi folks! 

We’re now in the second half of 2024, and here to give you all a snapshot of Game Update 7.5.1 and what players can look forward to as we prepare for Game Update 7.6. 

[b][u]Game Updates[/u] [/b]

Game Update 7.5.1 “The Greatest Bounty” launched on August 20 and contains Galactic Seasons 7, the Vette and Aric Jorgan Date Night Missions, a plethora of Cartel Market offerings, and we kick started the beginning of our Twitch Drops campaign. 

Galactic Seasons 7 (GS7) is aptly named, The Greatest Bounty, as it leans into the playing the role of a Bounty Hunter. Our recurring Bounty Contract in-game event has been enabled for the duration of GS7 and it features the return of the 16 Dark vs Light event world bosses. More info can be found [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20240820]here[/url]. 

Game Update 7.5.1 also features two new weekly repeatable Date Night Missions starring the Sith Warrior companion, Vette and the Republic Trooper companion, Aric Jorgan! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/8e61623a138dc2790db8f253b84f469e02f343cf.png[/img]
[i](Vette/Aric Jorgan)[/i]

We collaborated with our friends over at Lucasfilm Games to bring even more “inspired by” items to the Cartel Market. This update brought items such as the Deadly Outcast Armor inspired by [i]The Acolyte series on Disney+[/i] and weapons inspired by [i]Star Wars: Visions™[/i]. All of the items can be seen [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20240819]here[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d124cbb05785de833b0a66cac059ec8b8a0b35de.png[/img]
[i](Deadly Outcast Armor)[/i]

We were also excited to announce the start of Twitch Drop campaigns. For 28 days post 7.5.1 launch, players who watch 4 hours of SWTOR content on Twitch could obtain the Orlean Voidstream mount. We have a variety of Drops planned out for the future, so stay tuned on further announcements. 

Game Update 7.5.1b launched on September 10 and included a number of bug fixes and additional Cartel Market offerings including the Corporate Security Outfit, weapons, and a new teal/orange dye module inspired by Disney+ series Andor and Ahsoka. 
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/ca55df5e84ebd0d11e72357724e6b61b9d27d388.png[/img]

In late July, we released the limited time offer Master the Fight: Firebolt Edition bundle. This bundle includes: [list]
    [*]5,500 Cartel Coins [/*]
    [*]180 Days of subscription and 600 Cartel Coins each month[/*]
    [*]A Vectron 240R Firebolt Mount has a quick hotrod burst mode and is rideable at level 1[/*]
    [*]5 Primary and 5 secondary Metallic Red dyes for [u]each character [/u] [/*][/list]
This bundle (valued at over $150) is available for a few more days.  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3076010/STAR_WARS_The_Old_Republic__Master_the_Fight__Firebolt_Edition]Be sure to pick it up[/url] before September 23, 2024, if you want to get your hands on the speed boosted new mount, the red/black metallic dyes, and have extra Cartel Coins available for a variety of new items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/7d01c879cab960c8dee53c0b23454f8c8f8160d6.png[/img]

[b][u]What’s coming up?[/u] [/b]

We’re heads down on development for Game Update 7.6 “Galactic Threads”. This update is jam packed and you should expect to hear from us quite a bit! First up, in mid-October we'll be back with a video showcasing our new content type we teased on the 7.5.1 live stream along with the new Lair Boss as both of those head to PTS.

Then just a short while later in early November we'll be back for the full livestream you've come to expect where we reveal everything else coming in 7.6! We’ll talk about where the Galactic Threads story is going, details on our art modernization efforts, and more so stay tuned!

Last up, to close out this quarterly letter I have something really exciting to announce on the tech front. We are working on a native Mac launcher for SWTOR! 

We have been doing extensive internal testing for some time now on late model Mac computers and we are getting close to being ready to roll out that testing externally soon. Keep your eyes peeled to the forums in the next couple weeks as we will be posting more details on the technical requirements and testing plans for exactly how everything will work. 

This stays directly in line with one of the key goals I have talked about when we added Steam as a platform and when we came back to the APAC region, that we are going to keep pushing SWTOR onto new platforms and to new audiences wherever and whenever possible. And the cool thing about the Mac Client is it is the same game, on the same servers as the live game is now, so all of your existing data will be available!

That’s it for me today but thank you all for reading and I'll see you all soon.

-Keith

notes.content:
[b]The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally[/b]
[b]Date[/b]: Sept 17 - Sept 23 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
[b]Requirement[/b]: Level 20+

In the growing shadow of war, swoop fans across the galaxy descend on Dantooine, Tatooine, and even Onderon for the sport’s biggest spectacle—The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally! They’re packing the stands, eager to take their minds off their troubles and cheer their favorite swoop gangs. The bikers are here to take on dangerous challenge courses, show off their piloting skills, and flaunt their souped-up swoop bikes. The thunder of the engines, the deafening applause from the fans, the wind battering their helmets… there’s no bigger rush for these thrill seekers.

Despite their reputation as wild rebels whose makeshift courses disregard local districting restrictions, swoop gangs aren’t a serious threat to anyone--something all true swoop fans know! They just love adrenaline-pounding speed, sweet jumps, and big explosions, and the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally combines all three in one crowd-pleasing package. The biggest gangs on the circuit — Horizon’s Razor, the Pit Screamers, and the Blatant Beks — are ready to show their fans a great time.

notes.title: Galactic Seasons 7 “The Greatest Bounty”
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f4ed7d1be74072c9e89796a414c01c51debf620b.jpg[/img]

Galactic Seasons 7 “The Greatest Bounty” will begin with the launch of Game Update 7.5.1 on August 20! Once the update goes live, players will be able to make progress through the Free Reward track or the Subscriber Reward track (both tracks are available to Subscribers!) and earn new rewards. Below are the details of what players can expect from this new season!

[b][u]Bounty Hunters, rejoice![/u][/b]

During the 7.5.1 developer livestream, it was announced that the Bounty Contract Event will be enabled for the entirety of Galactic Seasons 7. Players will be meeting up with Kantec Bren of the Bounty Broker Association (BBA) thus kicking off “The Greatest Bounty”.  

[u]What is the Bounty Contract Event?
[/u]

This is a recurring in-game event that allows players to play the role of a Bounty Hunter regardless of their current origin story.  The BBA bounty contracts can be found on vendors in the Cartel Bazaar section of the Fleet. Each contract outlines the parameters of a bounty that has been posted on one of many planets across the galaxy, including contact information for the client who posted the bounty and a list of underworld contacts in the sector who may be persuaded to assist you in the hunt. Targets include members of crime syndicates, violent gangs, and various other law-breaking entities. 

Players must be at least level 15 and have access to the Fleet in order to participate in this event. 

[u]Special bosses have been added to the weekly objectives
[/u]

 “The Greatest Bounty” will feature the world bosses from the Dark vs Light (DvL) event! Each week will feature one Dark Side and one Light Side world boss.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/3448479f00064366348fec943caf32a76b1cf950.png[/img]

These bosses can spawn on Hoth, Tatooine, Dromund Kaas/Coruscant, or Alderaan as they have in the DvL event. These bosses are tough and are designed for 8-16 players, so come to these fights prepared! If one group has already beaten a world boss, don’t worry! The bosses are on a much faster respawn timer and you will not have to wait long for them to respawn. 

As the bosses have made a return, so has the DvL currency that can be used at the DvL vendors on the Fleets. Note that Dark side bosses will drop Light Tokens and vice versa.

notes.title: Game Update 7.5.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]7.5.1 Patch Notes[/b]


[h3][b]Highlights[/b][/h3]

[b]Galactic Seasons[/b]

Galactic Season 7 “The Greatest Bounty” will begin with the launch of Game Update 7.5.1 on August 20th! Once the update is live, players will be able to make progress through the Free or Subscriber Reward track (both are available to Subscribers!) and new rewards. 

The Bounty Contract Event will be enabled for the entirety of the season. Players will be meeting up with Kantec Bren of the Bounty Broker Association (BBA) thus kicking off “The Greatest Bounty”. This season will feature the world bosses from the Dark vs Light (DvL) event! Each week will feature one Dark Side and one Light Side world boss.  

[b]Date Night[/b]

Date Night Companion missions are a new narrative feature that debuted with Game Update 7.4.1. Vette and Aric Jorgan missions will be going live with 7.5.1. These weekly Date Night missions will be available to players who are currently in a romance with these characters, and only when the companions are available in the player’s story.

[b]Cartel Market Window[/b]
[list]
    [*]A new Star Wars™: Visions tab has been added. [/*]
    [*]A new “Inspired by” Categories tab has been added to host items inspired by Andor, The Book of Boba Fett, and The Mandalorian. [/*][/list]
[b]Servers [/b]

All transfer restrictions to the Shae Vizla server have been removed. 

[b]Gearing adjustments[/b]

Gear progression adjustments to increase reward choice and provide more opportunities for progression will go live with 7.5.1. See [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/936281-progression-changes-coming-in-751]here [/url]for all the details. 

[b]7.5.1 download size[/b]

We have fixed the issue regarding the “Disorder” trailer triggering. Additionally, we have fixed some audio issues for the “Sacrifice” trailer. 

[u]These changes could add roughly 2GB to 7.5.1’s download size for some players. [/u]

[b]General [/b]
[list]
    [*]Conquest Rewards for Personal and Guild Weekly Conquest are now limited to a single pending reward of each type. [list]
            [*]As a result, any pending rewards should be claimed prior to the patch release. [/*]
            [*]Any future rewards need to be claimed before the next Weekly completion of the same type or they will not be awarded.[/*]  [/list] [/*]
    [*]Fixed a UI issue where Mission Reward icons on the Activities “Solo” tab would persist from previously selected activities. [/*]
    [*]A fly text warning message will now be displayed in all instances when attempting to summon a companion in a restricted phase. [/*]
    [*]The lock icon is now displayed in the Companions and Contacts window over unavailable companions when the player is progressing through Chapters that require a specific companion to progress the story.  [/*]
    [*]The Separatist Trench Patroller's Flamethrower animation has been fixed.[/*]
    [*]Traveling to Dantooine or Blba Groves via the Galaxy Map now properly shows the areas’ recommended level ranges. [/*]
    [*]Fixed the explosion sound effect for the Bounty Hunter “Death From Above” ability.[/*]
    [*]The name and health details of a de-summoned companion no longer persist when a new companion is summoned. [/*]
    [*]The Minboosa District Imperial Shuttle will no longer provide active destinations to Republic characters.  [/*]
    [*]Female characters can no longer get stuck on the metal display console located inside the Blba Groves barn.[/*]
    [*]Fixed an issue where the Imperial Base shuttle on Ossus was not landing on the platform properly. [/*]
    [*]The top side of the forcefield generator room’s entrance in the Nebula Research Base on Balmorra no longer disappears when the player exits the room. [/*]
    [*]The floor textures near the holding cells in the Camp Vigil Imperial Headquarters no longer flicker. [/*]
    [*]Adjusted the nameplates for the Automated Blaster Cannons on Hoth so that they appear above the cannons as intended. [/*]
    [*]Corrected various typos across items, NPCs, cinematic text and other objects.[/*]
    [*]French Client only: In the “Updated Content” pop up window, the correct number format is now used for the game update’s title.  [/*]
[/list]
[b]Basilisk Prototype Venture [/b]
[list]
    [*]Completing B3-S1's story missions will now reward players with items which raise her influence rank. [list]
            [*]These items will allow B3-S1’s influence to increase to 30 by the end of the Venture. [/*]
            [*]Players who have already completed the story missions will find these items available at the HK/Astromech vendor. These items will only increase BE-S1’s influence to 30. [/*]  [/list] [/*]
    [*]B3-S1 companions that are claimed from Collections will no longer have their influence reset when a player visits Lane’s lab on Ruhnuk for the first time. [/*]
    [*]The “Grant B3-S1” button is now available the first time an alt character opens the Venture tab. [/*]
    [*]Completing Makeb Training Missions now grants training progress as intended. [/*]
    [*]Fixed an issue where completing the Ruhnuk Daily Mission "Unconventional Methods" wouldn't grant the progress for an active Basilisk Prototype Mission.[/*]
    [*]The Basilisk companion’s "Pulse-Wave Cannon” ability visual animation now correctly fires upon enemies rather than on the player. (B3-S1 is very sorry about that!)[/*]
    [*]If a player is wearing a helmet before triggering the kissing scene with Lane Vizla, it is removed during the cinematic.  [/*]
    [*]The Quick Kolto Burst description has been updated to include the detail that the target’s health must be below 80% in order to heal them. [/*]
[/list]
[b]Missions[/b]
[list]
    [*]The following Ossus Daily Missions are now available again for Imperial characters:[list]
            [*][DAILY] Crossed Wires[/*]
            [*][DAILY] Wasteland Terrors[/*]
            [*][DAILY] Collected History[/*]  [/list]  [/*]
    [*]Fixed the Blaster shot sound effect that can be heard after the player fires upon Ri’kan during the “Sundering” cinematic.  [/*]
    [*]Players can no longer access Darth Malgus’ fleet prison phase after completing the “Sundering” mission. [/*]
    [*]Fixed an issue where the player character’s Dualsaber weapon appears when it is not activated during the “Sundering” cinematic. [/*]
    [*]The player character and Ri’kan’s hands are now properly placed in the “Heta Kol’s Machine: Remove the Holocron” cinematic. [/*]
    [*]The visual effect of Yusinduu’s Focused Beam ability now only appears when causing damage. [/*]
    [*]The maps for the Bastal Family Farmhouse for the "Eyes on the Prize" mission have been updated. [/*]
    [*]Resetting the mission “Sinking History” now allows totems that were activated prior to the reset to be intractable again.  [/*]
    [*]When Imperial players use the console during the Manaan “Fortification” mission to turn into a loader droid, they are now teleported to areas that allow them to progress the mission.  [/*]
    [*]To prevent confusion around how to begin HK-55’s chapter, the "Shroud of Memory" and the Arma Rasa Alert Missions will reappear when a chapter is active. Please note that if a player is actively replaying a chapter from the Knight of the Fallen Empire or Knights of the Eternal Throne expansions the "Arma Rasa" Alert will still be hidden. [/*]
    [*][u]French Client Only[/u]: Corrected typos found in the Missions Tutorial panels. [/*]
[/list]
[b]Galactic Seasons [/b]
[list]
    [*]Players can no longer climb out of bounds from the Western Lookout in the Copero Villa Stronghold.[/*]
    [*]Purchasing the Key to the East Wing Exterior and Suite from the Galactic Season vendor will no longer cause the Key to West Wing Exterior and Suite to disappear.[/*]
    [*]The intro cinematic when traveling to the Copero Stronghold now plays as intended. [/*]
    [*]The “Grand Architect” Title now grants the appropriate Codex entry. [/*]
[/list]
[b]PvP[/b]
[list]
    [*]Giradda the Hutt’s inventory will now update at Weekly Reset as intended.  [/*]
[/list]
[b]Items[/b]
[list]
    [*]Jedi Consular Female Chiss characters can now use the "Devoted Disciple" hairstyle customization if it has been unlocked.  [/*]
    [*]Added item description to the Devoted Disciple Hood (Hair enabled) tooltip. [/*]
    [*]The Devoted Disciple Hood and Devoted Disciple Hood (Hair enabled) armor pieces no longer clip with the character’s right shoulder. [/*]
    [*]The Furious Gladiator Helmet no longer appears completely black in cinematics and the Character Select Screen.[/*]
    [*]When dual wielding Refined Mentor lightsabers, the sound effects when sheathing the weapons no longer play an extra effect.  [/*]
    [*]The sound and visual effects for the "Turret Simulator" regeneration toy have been fixed.[/*]
    [*]The Loyal Adherent Hairstyle now fits properly on all male body types.[/*]
    [*]The Chrome White dye now applies a higher reflectivity, displaying a shinier effect.  [/*]
    [*]The Metallic Gold & Chrome White Dyes no longer appear too bright when applied to the Series 917, 505, 512 and 808 Cybernetic Armor Sets chest pieces.[/*]
    [*]The Zakuulan Chandelier decoration now casts light when activated.[/*]
    [*]The Secondary Metallic Red Dye module tooltip has been updated to include “Master the Fight: Firebolt Edition” as its source. [/*]
    [*]The Vectron 240R tooltip has been updated to include mention of the temporary speed boost. [/*]
    [*]The boost buff for the Vectron 240R mount has been added to the buff’s tooltip. [/*]
    [*]The Major Social Boost item is now obsolete and can be safely sold to vendors. It has also been removed from the Smooth Talker Bundle. [/*]
    [*]The “Buzzed Hairstyle 1” and “Buzzed Hairstyle 2” complexions are now present for Chiss characters that use Male Body Type 4 and Head Option 1. [/*]
[/list]
[b]Events[/b]
[list]
    [*]Players who have purchased VIP area access on the Fleets via the Cartel Market can now use the Max Bet slot machines during the Nar Shaddaa Nightlife Event. [/*]
    [*]Corrected a typo in the Weekly Egg Hunt: Rishi Village mission name. [/*]
    [*]The Rishi Village Abundance Eggs will now respawn at a faster rate.  [/*]
    [*]The long pauses throughout the conversation during the “Home on the Strange: Return to Ubog Ozo” mission have been shortened for better dialogue flow. [/*]
[/list]
[b]Flashpoints[/b]
[list]
    [*]The background art plates for various Objective Meridian Achievements have been fixed.[/*]
    [*]The Korriban Sith statues shown in the Korriban Incursion Flashpoint are now positioned to match the statues shown on main Korriban.  [/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Executive Producer Letter - Q2 2024
notes.content:
Hi folks! 

June 2024 is upon us, and this marks not only the second quarter of the year, but also our one year anniversary with Broadsword Online Games. In the past year, we’ve pushed out five content updates and 11 patches, a new APAC server, and collaborated with Lucasfilm Games to bring Ahsoka and The Acolyte inspired items to the game. And there’s much more coming! First let’s take a look at what we’ve done since Q1 and then I can give you a glimpse into what’s coming up next. 

[b]Q2 Highlights[/b]

The month of May is always a fun time for anyone who is a fan of Star Wars™! We celebrated Star Wars™ Day by releasing a droid mini-pet inspired by The Phantom Menace in celebration of the film’s 25th Anniversary!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/bb444f9a853cbb3f66e3b2811418811027bc1ce5.png[/img]

We also hosted the Game Update 7.5 livestream in early May to give players a glimpse into the content that would be coming with the “Desperate Defiance” update. 

[u]What’s in Game Update 7.5?[/u]

In short, a lot! Not only does 7.5 contain the next story arc, but we also introduced a new seasonal event, PvP Season 6 “Great Pirate Hunt, new player customizations, and a Venture system that would allow players to obtain their very own Basilisk War Droid companion. 

In the story content, players will be teaming up with Sa’har Kateen to retrieve Darth Nul’s holocron and the choices made will help shape her path as a Padawan. Players will be returning to Hutta, and the art team took the opportunity to modernize the origin planet. Various textures and environments have been updated and a new area, the Minboosa District, has been built for the new story content. 
[previewyoutube=0NLU_pgU1xk;full][/previewyoutube]

Subscribers who have completed Lane Vizla’s story missions can now embark on a [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20240528]Venture system[/url] that provides them an opportunity to train a Basilisk Prototype named B3-S1 and eventually obtain her as a full-fledged companion. Fully training B3-S1 will unlock all of her abilities and final appearance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/5c25eaa0786d308e42cb15571b6a3db590873fa3.png[/img]

The start of PvP Seasons will now be tied directly to game updates going forward. PvP Season 6 "Great Pirate Hunt" began with Game Update 7.5, and players can begin to earn new rewards such as the Cosmic Corsair and Corsair Radiance Armor sets. More details about PvP Season 6 can be found [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20240528]here[/url]. 

The [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20240529]Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival event[/url] has been added to SWTOR’s annual schedule, completing the seasonal event calendar. Players gain access to Blba Groves on Dantooine where they must take care of a new farmstead. This year's event has concluded, but while the event is active, players can partake in fun missions such as harvesting and cultivating plants, baking and sample pies, rehabilitating injured or abandoned animals and more!  

[previewyoutube=zR3rFOP_17Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Game Update 7.5 also gave us a chance to collaborate with our friends at Lucasfilm Games to bring items inspired by [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20240528-0][i]The Acolyte[/i] to the Cartel Market[/url]. This was a phenomenal opportunity for us as we are the only [i]Star Wars[/i] title in existence to have [i]The Acolyte [/i]inspired by items in-game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d8aa6a7c7e738adc7a399a74a041192bcc2fd1c8.png[/img]

And that brings us to today. 


[u]What’s coming up? [/u]

[url=https://www.swtor.com/patchnotes]Game Update 7.5b[/url] is now live and contains various bug fixes and even more items inspired by [i]The Acolyte![/i] See all of the items [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20240627]here[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b252079e0646d46d83a6b5cdbb0d8832dae41986.png[/img]
[i](Devoted Disciple hairstyle, armor, lightsaber, and dualsaber)[/i]

We’ll be hosting the 7.5.1 developer livestream sometime in July/August to reveal the next batch of Date Night Missions and details on Galactic Seasons 7. This stream will also be the first time we enable the Twitch Drops program, so be sure to tune in for more details!

The Nar Shaddaa Nightlife event will be live on July 9th and lucky players will be able to obtain the new High Stakes Squadron Helmet from the Emperor's Grace machine! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/8f3a99c98e35c6cae574bde80a8619c9ebbc7954.png[/img]

There’s quite a bit that the team has done this year, and even more to come for the rest of the year. I look forward to sharing all the juicy details in due time. Until then, please enjoy Game Update 7.5 and all the new content within. 

Thank you for reading and we’ll see you at the 7.5.1 livestream! 

-Keith

notes.title: Introducing the Basilisk Protype Venture!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/dabf572b6b995204ce57b526d4c63e1ae2f36dba.png[/img]

Players who caught the 7.5 Developer Stream or hopped onto the Public Test Server (PTS) recently were able to get a first glimpse into the Basilisk Protype Venture and meet B3-S1.

[b]First, what is a Venture? [/b]

Ventures are a new system we’re introducing to Star Wars: The Old Republic. To break a Venture down to its basics, players who participate in this new system will complete a relatively long series of tasks to receive a unique reward. Ventures are designed with the solo player in mind, so while grouping up may speed up the process, or make Heroic Missions easier, everything can be accomplished without needing to coordinate with other players. In this first Venture, players embark on an effort to restore functionality to B3-S1, the Basilisk Prototype that Lane has been working on, eventually unlocking her as a full-fledged companion.

[b]How can players start the Venture? [/b]

In order to be eligible for this Venture, players must have the following: 
[list]
[*] Active Subscription
[*] A character that is level 80
[*] The ability to travel to Ruhnuk
[*] Completed the mission “A Few Modifications” from Lane Vizla’s storyline in Kessan’s Landing
[/list]
Once eligible, players can continue Lane’s storyline as they unlock the Venture and begin on their journey. Lane will contact the player via holocall stating that there has been a breakthrough with her research and ask the player to come to Ruhnuk. Lane has relocated to a new lab on Ruhnuk, conducting research and experimentation to bring the prototype back online. Though she’s managed to get the droid stabilized for brief periods, she now needs the player’s assistance to gather combat data and fully rehabilitate the droid. Once players meet with Lane in her new lab, the Venture tab will be unlocked and viewable from the Achievement Window (press Y to open this window).  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/7f9c9dd41aecd562346f93e3affa066fe8cc73f2.png[/img]

After clicking the “Grant Mission'' button, players will be sent to speak with Lane in her new lab on Ruhnuk. After a brief introduction to B3-S1, the window will be updated to show B3-S1’s training progress. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/21f23c33249477fe587e4df1bfa46ef09ac6651d.png[/img]

[b]How to train B3-S1[/b]

While players can group up together to speed up the process of training B3-S1, this Venture can be completed entirely as a solo player. To begin, players will need to take B3-S1 out on[b] limited-time training missions[/b]. Since the droid is still quite unstable at the beginning of the Venture, it will take some time and effort until she becomes a full companion. At the outset, B3-S1 will only have one combat ability per role available–as you continue the Venture, you will bring her combat capabilities back online and upgrade them over time. To this end, you’ll need to complete training missions with her in each of her combat roles: Tank, Healer, and DPS.

When you begin training, you’ll start in Lane’s Lab by giving B3-S1 a [b]Memory Chip[/b] that allows her to become stable for one hour. One Memory Chip is available in the lab each day, but they can be found while collecting data on B3-S1 as well. 

Training Module items will grant a mission that directs you to a specific Daily Area, where you’ll need to complete missions alongside B3-S1 to receive credit. Note that she will need to be in the correct role in order to get credit for training! Using a Training Module will automatically set B3-S1 to the correct role.  Players will receive two random training modules each time they stabilize B3-S1, but more can be found in the data they collect, or purchased from the HK-24 Astromech droid in Lane’s Lab.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6b0003a5d14af86e49f77a40a7282c199dc888e1.png[/img]

While out with B3-S1, keep an eye on the following: 
[list]
[*] B3-S1 can’t be out all day, so make sure to watch her availability timer, which can be seen both near the companion’s portrait and on the companion screen.
[*] B3-S1 MUST be the summoned companion when completing training missions. If she is not, no progress will be made. 
[*] Make sure she is in the correct role while completing missions. Using the training item will automatically set the correct role for B3-S1.
[/list]
Some important things to note:
[list]
[*] Other characters within your Legacy can help progress B3-S1’s training via the[b] training missions [/b]at any time, but [u][b]only one character per Legacy will be able to complete Lane’s story arc.[/b][/u]
[*] Players cannot grant themselves these training missions unless they have B3-S1 as their active companion
[*] Only one training mission can be active at a time.
[*] Abandoning a Training Mission does not “refund” the training item.
[*] Training missions are daily missions, so they are subject to the same reset timer as all other daily missions.
[/list]

Once the requisite number of missions are complete, return to the lab, deliver the collected data to Lane, and let B3-S1 get some rest! Don’t worry, you can always take B3-S1 out for more training as long as you have a Memory Chip to stabilize her. As training progresses, B3-S1’s physical appearance will change indicating that she is becoming stronger. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/5c25eaa0786d308e42cb15571b6a3db590873fa3.png[/img]

[b]Heroics as Bonus Missions[/b]

Each Training Mission can also grant a bonus mission to complete a Heroic Mission in the designated area. Upon completion, players will be awarded extra rewards for their efforts. Heroics will count toward training progress making them the most efficient route to take. However, it will be a challenge as B3-S1 is still a pup in training. We encourage players to group up and help each other out if they choose to tackle Heroics, especially early on in the Venture.

[b]What does progression look like? [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6b0003a5d14af86e49f77a40a7282c199dc888e1.png[/img]

Each node on the Venture track is a small checklist of things to accomplish. Completing a node will unlock the next set of tasks, and offer some small Basilisk-specific rewards to continue their progress. Throughout the Venture, players will also experience story moments with Lane Vizla and her HK-Astromech assistant as they help upgrade B3-S1's systems. Once players reach the end, the final mission to pick up their fully repaired Basilisk Prototype will become available! From that moment on, B3-S1 will forever be a loyal companion by their side. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/404928a981371730d1b0c14e548ae51c281059bd.png[/img]

We’re very excited to introduce this system to SWTOR and look forward to building upon it for future Ventures to come.  

[u][b]FAQ[/b][/u]

[b]Do I need to complete the Ruhnuk storyline first in order to start Lane’s missions?[/b]
[list]
[*] No longer! Beginning with 7.5, players Lane’s introductory mission “Showdown’s Wake” will now trigger once a player reaches level 80 and has traveled to Ruhnuk. If a player has already completed the introductory missions, the trigger will grant “Eyes on the Prize”, the second set of missions instead. 
[/list]
[b]How will the story missions work with all of my characters?[/b]
[list]
[*] As the Venture is based on the Achievement system, only one character per Legacy at a time can play Lane Vizla’s story missions with B3-S1. Other characters within your Legacy, however, can help progress B3-S1’s training at any time, but only one character per Legacy will be able to complete Lane’s story arc.  
[/list]
[b]Can my other characters get B3-S1? [/b]
[list]
[*] Yup! B3-S1 will be added to your Collection once the Venture is complete.
[/list]
[b]Will B3-S1 be in Collections? [/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! B3-S1 and her customizations will both be in your Collection once they have been unlocked.
[/list]
[b]How does raising B3-S1’s influence work? [/b]
[list]
[*] Once B3-S1 is a companion, her influence will begin at level 1 and can be increased through gifts and compendiums just like other companions. 
[/list]
[b]Can B3-S1 be used for Crew Skills? [/b]
[list]
[*] She is a non crew-skill companion as she doesn’t have any thumbs!
[/list]
[b]Once unlocked, can I augment her weapons and armor stats? [/b]
[list]
[*] No, there are no weapon or armor slots, just customization.
[/list]
[b]Is there anything else I can get after unlocking B3-S1 completely?[/b] 
[list]
[*] Once you’ve fully repaired your Basilisk Prototype, you can still continue progress in the Venture! Truly dedicated B3-S1 fans can continue to collect data for Lane, and unlock a unique companion customization to show off on Fleet, or wherever your travels take you!
[/list
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/1ab70899c2e3250baf81073fd094209592651052.png[/img]

notes.title: The Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival Event has come to SWTOR!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/9fa5f1064c07aaea370d426f1bca6fb4fdd44069.png[/img]

The launch of Game Update 7.5 marks the debut and beginning of the Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival Event! This is an annual event that completes SWTOR’s seasonal event calendar. 
[b]
What can players do in the event? [/b]

Even heroes need a break every now and then. What better way to pass the time than relaxing on a cozy farmstead on Dantooine? When the event is active, players can pick up the mission on the Fleet and make their way to Blba Groves, a secondary landing point on the planet Dantooine.   

Players will find themselves the owner of a brand new farmstead, but something is not quite right as an unknown threat lingers on the land. After completing two story missions, players can access the repeatable event missions. 

[b]Festive Footwork - Daily [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/214381dda5d37458e4650697d02d867b5185d69e.png[/img]

Players can dance to their heart’s content at the holo-pole in the heart of the farmstead. 


[b]Patissier for a Day (Daily) and Festival Pastry Sampling (Weekly) [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/0fe3d437f74bc8a98e45a9af201f2f9865111f3a.png[/img]

Choose one of four pastries to bake and be sure to share them with friends!  


[b]Zap a Fish - Daily[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/bafa45e13ae7479cc58555a536e804900df211f9.png[/img]

This is the perfect mission to help you relax your weary feet, enjoy a beverage, and listen to some Cantina music. Use a probe droid to scour the farm pond and zap some fish. Rumor has it that there is an incredibly rare fish swimming around out there, and if captured, will unlock an Achievement. And don’t worry, they’re released after they’re captured, so no fish were harmed in the making of this mission! 


[b]Creature Rehabilitation - Weekly[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f287fac8d6f2948c592dab619a23f917e228c6ed.png[/img]

Several creatures in the galaxy need your help! These missions will lead players to Rishi, Hoth, and Alderaan, guiding them to injured or abandoned animals that need to be taken back to the Dantooine farm and rehabilitated. 


[b]Seed Sourcing and Cultivation - Weekly [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/df85a1d8ef69ab0bedf3d4bbc33a46da51e61512.png[/img]

After getting rare seeds from either Nar Shaddaa, the Fleet, or Mek-Sha shipped to the Dantooine Farmstead, players can take control of a helpful probe droid to plant, water, and harvest exotic plants. Each week, players will encounter a new mission to hunt down seeds.  


[b]Egg Hunt - (Weekly)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/2079b163694532185f194e2b2e481dc5ed473f9c.png[/img]

Eggs have been hidden on Alderaan, Rishi, Makeb, Onderon, and Yavin IV. Every week the event is active, two out of the four planets mentioned will be available for players to partake in a galactic egg hunt! 

   
[b]Does new event mean new rewards?[/b]

Yes, it does! With the completion of missions listed above, players will begin to accumulate a new currency called Farmland Medals. These can be turned into the Abundance Festival Token Vendor for various rewards! Below is the complete list of rewards that can be earned. 

[u]Titles[/u]
[list]
[*] Title: Crop Destroyer
[*] Title: Humble Farmhand 
[*] Legacy Title: One Who Reaps
[*] Legacy Titles: One Who Sows
[/list]

[u]Decorations [/u]
[list]
[*] Arrangement: Abundance Supplies 1 Decoration
[*] Arrangement: Abundance Supplies 2 Decoration
[*] Arrangement: Abundance Supplies 3 Decoration
[*] Arrangement: Abundance Supplies 4 Decoration
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/dd6b8c033d3c7e3ecb7e1d8c2c67fab1fb3abcf4.png[/img]
(Arrangement: Abundance Supplies Decorations) 

[list]
[*] Arrangement: Bestine Threeberry Pie Decoration
[*] Arrangement: Deepwater Dac Pie Decoration
[*] Arrangement: Pitted Ka-Olive Pie Decoration
[*] Arrangement: Sweet Spore Tart Decoration
[*] Spring Festival Barbeque Pit Decoration
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b9b4e6fc61288a9d10ea9de3590f4fd14c92f4dc.png[/img]
(Barbeque Pit and pie decorations)

[list]
[*] Spring Harvest Plant 1 Decoration
[*] Spring Harvest Plant 2 Decoration
[*] Spring Harvest Plant 3 Decoration
[*] Cursed Farmland Pillar Decoration
[*] Dantooine Potted Fruit Tree Decoration 
[*] Farm Harvest Shed Decoration
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/17116b9d63814505c310b3e683407af8b9397ed5.png[/img]
(Top: Farm Harvest Shed Decoration - Exterior and Interior)
(Bottom: Dantooine Potted Fruit Tree and Spring Harvest Plant Decorations)

[u]Outfits[/u]
[list]

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/18e80a49dc4fbad9c65f083cc78c73ca3637b118.png[/img]
(Farmland Grazer features two different headpieces to display goggles on or off)

[u]Weapons[/u]
[list]

[*] Fitted Westar 19 Blaster
[*] Fitted Westar 19 Sniper Rifle
[/list]

[u]Mounts and Pets[/u]
[list]

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/cb88b056c88aebc0d607dd9eaa109c09db65f534.png[/img]

[list]

[*] Savana Mudpup Mini Pet
[*] Subterranean Mudpup Mini Pet
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/5c5e6d48aec217bafdcd377c08b10eb284559966.png[/img]
(Marshland, Savanna, and Subterranean Mudpup mini pets)

The Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival Event will begin with the launch of Game Update 7.5 and will remain active for 28 days. When the event closes, Blba Groves will remain accessible to players, but the missions will not be active again until next year. 

We hope you enjoy this new event!

notes.title: PvP Season 6 "Great Pirate Hunt"
notes.content:
PvP Season 6 "Great Pirate Hunt" is coming with the launch of Game Update 7.5!  Previous seasons ran irrespective of game update launches, but beginning with 7.5, PvP Seasons will be tied directly to game updates going forward. Below are changes that players will see once the new season begins: 
[list]
[*] PvP Seasons will run for 16 weeks (up from 12 weeks). 
[*] Maximum Season Levels increased to 30 (up from 25)
[*] Total points required to complete the PvP Season will be 9000 (up from 7000)
[*] Warzone Medpacs and Adrenals will be added to the reward track
[/list]
More details can be found in this [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/934933-pvp-seasons-increased-to-16-weeks-long-with-75/#comment-9812918]forum post[/url].

notes.title: Items inspired by Star Wars™: The Acolyte will be coming to SWTOR!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/0a7005bc3aaf97c066dced3bff2a219f1c468371.png[/img]

Like so many [i]Star Wars™[/i] fans, we are eagerly awaiting the premiere of[i] Star Wars™[/i]: The Acolyte coming to Disney+ on June 4, 2024. 

To celebrate the debut of the series, we collaborated with Lucasfilm Games to build a set of items inspired by [i]The Acolyte[/i]. With Game Update 7.5 “Desperate Defiance”, the following will be available on the Cartel Market:

[b]Dark Harbinger Armor Set[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/8d4517f7414f295d2708ba48a8a839f5ed138258.png[/img]
(Headpieces pictured above: Dark Harbinger Hood (with hair) and Dark Harbinger Hood)

[b]Wookiee Jedi inspired Hairstyle and Beard Customizations[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/2df4c8c2945344e5e0b2ed5093e1536d53d60e11.png[/img]

[b]Serpent’s Tongue Vibroblade[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/fecd5f02a222de88d5631dd618bc53374a0b4e26.png[/img]

[b]A look behind the scenes of making the Dark Harbinger Armor Set[/b]

It is important to remember that our stories are set thousands of years before the events of [i]The Acolyte[/i]. Our talented artists and designers worked with Lucasfilm to create iconic items that find a balance between the striking items seen in the recent trailers and also stay true to the aesthetics of The Old Republic. 

When creating items inspired-by a new series, we always start with a high quality reference, and then get right to building a high-res model to bring our ideas to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/31f6a231da0cceed2325dcb16412cd5654826db9.png[/img]

From there, we determine what this armor would look like on a player model and add the necessary textures and materials to bring it to life. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/7d4e5473aa18c64dcb6adb06e4923162bf19e280.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/39fbd07868e5a8755dd2c2433c5d7d86a8421c15.png[/img]

Once we align on the overall direction, several more passes through the art, design, sound, and QV teams get us to a fully functional Dark Harbinger armor set in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/2079542cb2a82e4b97d74c2d1a1c6ec4aa20bcb1.png[/img]

We have been thrilled to share these with our players and even more excited to say that additional items are on the way! We’ll be sharing them with you all as we get closer to releasing them in another update.

Game Update 7.5 “Desperate Defiance” launches May 29th and [i]Star Wars™[/i]: The Acolyte premieres June 4th on Disney+.

notes.title: In-Game Events for May 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/2a3f78d229511c9bf95580485f134b9c38afab01.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Double XP Event[/b][/u]

Date: 05/01/2024 - 05/16/2024 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
Requirement: None!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d49e114a8ac56a033d7fe9919d107e72eb5c429d.png[/img]

[u][b]The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally[/b][/u]

Date: 04/30/2024 - 05/06/2024 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
Requirement: Level 20+

In the growing shadow of war, swoop fans across the galaxy descend on Dantooine, Tatooine, and even Onderon for the sport’s biggest spectacle—The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally! They’re packing the stands, eager to take their minds off their troubles and cheer their favorite swoop gangs. The bikers are here to take on dangerous challenge courses, show off their piloting skills, and flaunt their souped-up swoop bikes. The thunder of the engines, the deafening applause from the fans, the wind battering their helmets… there’s no bigger rush for these thrill seekers.

Despite their reputation as wild rebels whose makeshift courses disregard local districting restrictions, swoop gangs aren’t a serious threat to anyone--something all true swoop fans know! They just love adrenaline-pounding speed, sweet jumps, and big explosions, and the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally combines all three in one crowd-pleasing package. The biggest gangs on the circuit — Horizon’s Razor, the Pit Screamers, and the Blatant Beks — are ready to show their fans a great time.

FEATURED REWARDS:

[list]
[*] Swoop Rally Mounts (regular and gold versions)
[*] Swoop Gang Outfits
[*] Promotion Droid Mini-pets
[*] Various Stronghold Decorations
[*] …and more!
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/46b18f3d3e1d33b6a1826308ed8e17a325150533.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Rakghoul Resurgence on Tatooine[/b][/u]

Date: 05/14/2024 - 05/20/2024 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
Requirement: Level 25+

The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization (T.H.O.R.N.) has issued an official level-2 emergency alert concerning an outbreak of the Rakghoul plague on Tatooine. Quarantines have been put in place to restrict traffic of the plague off-world, but exceptions will be made for individuals with priority clearance.

T.H.O.R.N. is recruiting qualified volunteer emergency responders to travel to affected areas to combat the spread of the Rakghoul plague. More information about the outbreak can be found by checking the News Terminals on the Republic or Imperial Fleet!

T.H.O.R.N. wishes to remind you that plague symptoms can be treated if they are identified in the early stages of infection. Whether or not you have travel plans, please consult your nearest trusted medical supply droid and get vaccinated!

FEATURED REWARDS:

[list]
[*] Reputation with THORN
[*] Merciless Seeker’s Armor Set
[*] THORN Epicenter and Dark Vector Armor Sets
[*] Outbreak Response Weapons
[*] Alliance Contact - Doctor Lokin
[*] Infected Varactyl and Infected Dewback Mounts
[*] Ferocious Rakghoul Mini-pets
[*] …and more!
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update 7.4.1c Patch Notes
notes.content:
[u][b]Galactic Seasons[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Copero Stronghold access keys will be removed from the Mission Items tab following unlocking the corresponding rooms.
[*] "Anarchy in Paradise" Galactic Season Objective grants Blueprint Fragments as intended.
[*] The Galactic Season 6 Objective "Anarchy in Paradise" now rewards Blueprint Fragments as intended.
[*] The Northwestern, Northeastern and Southeastern "Eyto Eyto" mounts are now correctly available for purchase from their respective Galactic Season vendors on the Fleet. 
[*] The "Freedom from FR3-D0M" objective no longer misspells "Legacy of the Sith" as "Legends of the Sith".
[/list]
[u][b]Daily Areas[/b][/u]
The following Conquest Objectives have been added for Kessan's Landing:
[list]
[*] Kessan's Landing: Mission Complete
[*] Kessan's Landing: Defeat Enemies 1
[*] Kessan's Landing: Defeat Enemies 2
[*] Kessan's Landing: Weekly Patrol
[/list]
The requirement to access the following Daily Areas has been updated to require only one character having unlocked that area previously (and having the relevant Legacy Achievement). Previously it required each character to individually progress their story to unlock them:
[list]
[*] Iokath
[*] Kessan's Landing
[*] Makeb
[*] Manaan
[*] Onderon
[*] Oricon
[*] Ruhnuk
[*] Yavin IV
[/list]
[u][b]General[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Players who unlocked the "Mek-Sha Safehouse" before 7.4.1 should now have the unlock displayed in their Legacy window.
[*] Elevator sound effects will no longer play numerous times when exiting the elevator during Koth's Date Night "A Place to Call Home"
[*] The infinitely repeatable “Complete a Heroic Mission” Conquest Objective is now available at all levels (previously only available from 10-49).
[*] The “Complete a Heroic Mission” Conquest Objective is now worth 2000 Conquest points (up from 1650).
[/list]
[u][b]Items [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The Copero Umbrella (Blue) decoration can now be placed on Medium and Medium Narrow hooks. 
[*] Voice modulation has been added to the Master Builder's Headguard.
[*] Removed clipping bottles from the "Arrangement: Cantina Restaurant Pod" decoration.
[/list]

Updates have been made to the known issue lists [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/934096-game-update-741-known-issues/]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/dc046fd205a4608c4c99ffba7ecaf3effee1587b.png[/img]

[u][b]Pirate Incursion[/b][/u]

[b]Date[/b]: April 2 - April 9 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
[b]Requirement[/b]: Level 20+

The remote planet Dantooine has been thrust into the center of escalating hostilities between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Spurred on in secret by covert Imperial forces, the Nova Blade pirates have staged an all-out attack on the pastoral Republic world. As the Republic scrambles to defend this key territory at the edge of Imperial space, the Empire plans to capitalize on the chaos and deal a major blow to the longtime Republic bastion.

[b]FEATURED REWARDS:[/b]
[list]
[*] Nova Blade and Dantooine Homesteader Armor Sets
[*] Ugnaught Companion
[*] Walker Mount
[*] Kath Hound Mount
[*] Kath Hound Mini-pet
[*] Dantooine-inspired Stronghold Decorations
[*] … and more!
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/777dd8a36fc5077a6a70a63eb5567bc443a47a88.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Bounty Contract Week[/b][/u]

Date: April 16 - April 23 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
Requirement: Level 15+

For a limited time, the Bounty Brokers Association has opened its doors to anyone willing to take on their dangerous contracts, offering an opportunity for both seasoned and rookie hunters to prove their skills and bring crime syndicates and violent gangs to justice!

Each day, you can sign up for one standard Henchman contract and one high profile Kingpin Contract, and each may take you to a separate planet. Complete five standard contracts to unlock Kingpin missions with bigger loot! Head to the fleet now, invite your friends and visit representatives of the Association to get started on your contracts!

FEATURED REWARDS:

[list]
[*] Reputation with the Bounty Brokers Association
[*] Bounty Tracker’s Armor Set and Contract Hunter’s Armor Set
[*] Assassin’s Bowcaster and Elite Tracker’s Bowcaster weapons
[*] Lobelot, Swamp Kell Drake, and Drink Server Probe Mini-pets
[*] BH-7X Custom Hunter Mount
[*] …and more!
[/list]

notes.title: Executive Producer Letter - Q1 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/db581a10ab4c47a771c183895de2ea26e40153e1.png[/img]

Hi folks! 

We’re coming up on the tail end of Q1 for 2024, and there’s quite a lot that’s happened since my anniversary post last year. We’re seeing new players and returning players jumping into SWTOR, so I wanted to provide a recap of what’s been happening in the game since Update 7.4 went out in December. 

[b]Dev Streams[/b]

We kicked off the year with a dev stream, hosted on February 14th, that gave a glimpse into what content players could expect with Game Update 7.4.1. We’ll be doing the same with Game Update 7.5, which we expect to host sometime in April! 

[b]PvP Season 5 “Pirate’s Plunder” [/b]

[url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20240226]Season 5[/url] began February 27th, giving players who enjoy a PvP mode opportunities to earn rewards like new armor, decorations, and a new Flair called “Pirate’s Bounty.” The season will run for 12 weeks!

[b]Game Update 7.4.1[/b]

We just released our latest update on March 12th! [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20240312]Game Update 7.4.1 “Building a Foundation”[/url] features Galactic Seasons 6, the debut of a narrative feature called Date Night, and we opened transfers to our Shae Vizla server that is hosted in the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region.

Galactic Seasons 6 comes with a breathtaking new Copero Stronghold that can be earned from the reward track. All the details can be found [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20240311]here[/url].   

[url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20240312-1]Date Night Missions[/url] are a replayable, multiple-outcome cinematic feature, and the perfect treat for story-driven players seeking opportunities to develop deeper relationships with their romanceable companions. These weekly repeatable missions feature Theron Shan, Lana Beniko, Arcann, and Koth Vortena to start. Our goal is to release 1-2 Date Night Missions alongside Galactic Seasons and eventually have a polished and unique scene for every romanceable companion. 

When 7.4.1 went live on March 12th, we opened character transfers to the new Shae Vizla APAC server:
[list]
[*] From now until April 12th, Subscribers who have been consistently subbed since January 2nd will receive 16 free transfers. 
[*] From now until June 10th, Subscribers will have 50% off (500CC) these transfers. 
[*] There is a 15 million credit cap per character transfer.
[*] Characters must be at least level 20 in order to qualify for a transfer. 
[/list]
Transfers can be requested and processed [url=https://account.swtor.com/en/account]here[/url]. 

[url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20240312-0]The Cartel Market offerings[/url] for this update include Ahsoka™ inspired armors, new weapons (my personal favorite is the Prime Centurion Vibroblade), and a Copero themed Utility Bundle that would match perfectly with your new Stronghold!
 
[b]Other Updates[/b]

[list]
[*] We updated our SWTOR Launcher to present information more efficiently. We'll be making a similar update to the Steam launcher in the near future. 
[*] Players who have a Preferred account can post in the Introductions, New Player Help, and Bug Reports sections of the SWTOR Forums. 
[/list]

[b]What’s coming up? [/b]

I can’t spoil too much, of course, but we did tease a little about what’s on the horizon for Game Update 7.5. First, the new story content is named “Desperate Defiance,” and we will be returning to Hutta!

Players familiar with SWTOR know that we have seasonal events such as Nar Shaddaa Nightlife (summer), Feast of Prosperity (Autumn), and Life Day (holiday). Clearly, one season is missing. Happy to say that the team is also working on a new Spring event that will be debuting with 7.5! More details to come, but what I can say is that players will have a pretty cozy time with it. 

Lane Vizla has been up to a lot in our last few updates, and with 7.5, players will see all of her story missions come to fruition. 

We’ll be going over the above and more in further detail with the Game Update 7.5 dev stream. We are tentatively scheduling this coming April, so stay tuned for more announcements! 

Thank you for reading and I’ll see you all soon. 

-Keith

notes.title: Game Update 7.4.1b Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b][h1]Highlights [/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] For players who are unable to get past the “Chains in the Dark” loading screen, [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/934309-game-update-741b/]please see here[/url] for more details around the fix that will be deployed with Game Update 7.4.1b. 
[*] In Game Update 7.4.1, changes to the Reputation Track and Reputation Conquest Objectives connected to Galactic Seasons were changed. We are actively discussing what adjustments can be made regarding these changes. More details can be found [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/934346-conquest-changes-following-741//]here[/url].  
[/list]

[b][h1]Fixes [/h1][/b]
[b]General [/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the drop rates of new items in the "Grade 11 Treasure Hunting Lockbox" significantly to better align with previous drop rates.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing server transfers for some characters with previously opened lockboxes.
[*] Fixed an abrupt player character transition during Koth’s date.
[*] The "Crafting Trainers" mission is granted when the player enters the Gathering Skills hub on the Imperial Fleet.
[/list]
[b]Items [/b]
[list]
[*] Fitted Armors and Weapons for World Drops and Ancient Armaments are now Bind to Legacy on Equip and have a Vendor Value of 100 credits to allow sale on the GTN and Vendors.
[*] Tunings will now display properly when equipped to the Gothic Master's Dualsaber.
[/list]
[b]Date Night Missions[/b]
[list]
[*] The character with pink hair is no longer sitting on an invisible chair during cutscenes in Theron Shan’s Date.
[/list]
[b]Galactic Seasons 6[/b]
[list]
[*] The "Speak to Vagol Oss in Your Copero Villa" cinematic can now only be triggered once, as intended.
[*] Fixed an issue causing ambient sound from the Copero Stronghold to persist after leaving the stronghold.
[*] Vagol Oss will no longer change locations after completing the "Return to Vagol Oss in Your Copero Villa" step of the “A Commemorative Introduction” Mission.
[*] Some Small Wall Hooks in pre-unlocked areas of the Copero Villa stronghold no longer require the purchase of the "Underground Docks" expansion to be used.
[*] Unlocking a room in the Copero Villa stronghold with Cartel Coins now correctly refers to the unlock in chat as a Copero unlock (previously said Mek-sha)..
[*] The following vendor-only Galactic Season 6 titles will now be properly unlocked in Collections: "The Builder", "Edifice Engineer" and "Grand Architect". 
[*] The datapad found during the "Galactic Season 6: The Observation Room" mission when directed to talk to Yshal can now only be interacted with once.
[*] The Galactic Seasons: Weekly Objectives tracking no longer states “Missing Details Data”. 
[*] The Planetary Art: Tython Decoration now stacks with itself in the inventory.
[*] The "Elegant Chest of Loyalty" crate correctly refers to "Conquest Commendations".
[*] The cover of "Arrangement: Copero Vehicle Stall" decoration is now aligned with the vehicle platform.
[*] Corrected an issue where the Piloting Ranks listed in the ability and item descriptions for The S-100 Turbo Boxxer were inconsistent.
[*] Added a Dye Slot to the Master Builder’s Bracers.
[*] The Eyto Eyto Creature Mounts no longer clip with character hands while mounted.
[/list]

notes.title: Galactic Seasons 6 "Building a Foundation"
notes.content:
Galactic Seasons 6 “Building a Foundation” will begin with the launch of Game Update 7.4.1! Once the update goes live, players will be able to make progress through the Free Reward track or the Subscriber Reward track (both tracks are available to Subscribers!) and earn new rewards. Below are the details of what players can expect from this new season!

[u][b]A new BIG reward[/b][/u]

Once completing Galactic Seasons objectives and unlocking level one on the rewards track, players will have unlocked a new Stronghold based in Copero!
[previewyoutube=hBTlJt387rc;full][/previewyoutube]

In this season’s story, “Building a Foundation”, players will be connecting with the Inkrokini Chiss family. Historically the Chiss Ascendancy forbade outsiders from accessing their worlds, as well as shunning the use of the Sight (the Force) among their own people. The Inrokini family sees the changing times across the galaxy and wishes to learn what strengths the other sentients of the galaxy possess, including the Sight, so that they can better prepare their own people. Secretly, and without the knowledge of the rest of the Ascendancy, they set up a remote facility in the mountains of Copero, and discreetly invite the player to recruit experts from other species. They offer the use of Chiss technology and a safe haven to pursue various kinds of training, in exchange for observation.

Three story missions can be unlocked from the Galactic Seasons track. The new story content will take place in the Copero Stronghold and three narrative NPCs will be unlocked alongside the story content and present in the residence. The story unlocks are found at levels 1, 15, and 40 on the tracks with level 1 unlocking the Stronghold itself.

Subscribers will have three additional room unlocks on their reward track at levels 42, 67, and 94 and three additional rooms can be unlocked using Cartel Coins or Credits.

If a player has completed the mission on any character, they will be able to re-acquire the mission items on other characters from the Galactic Seasons vendor, Jaliet Nall. While story missions are optional and the player can continue progress on the Reward Track regardless of story mission completion, remember that the story unlocks are directly tied to unlocking rooms in your new Stronghold! Story mission unlocks and keys to purchased rooms will be available in Collections.

[u][b]Seasonal Rewards![/b][/u]

As with previous Seasons, there will be a Free and Subscriber track that players can earn rewards from as they complete objectives and progress through Galactic Seasons 6.

notes.title: Game Update 7.4.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b][h1]Highlights[/h1][/b]

[u][b]Galactic Season 6 - Building A Foundation[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Galactic Seasons 6 “Building a Foundation” will begin with the launch of Game Update 7.4.1 on March 12th! Once the update goes live, players will be able to make progress through the Free Reward track or the Subscriber Reward track (both tracks are available to Subscribers!) and earn new rewards such as a beautiful Copero Stronghold!
[/list]
[u][b]Date Night[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Date Night Companion missions are a new narrative feature debuting with Game Update 7.4.1. For the launch of Date Night in 7.4.1, we're starting with four companions that are available to all players. They include SIS agent Theron Shan, Sith Lord Lana Beniko, Zakuulan captain Koth Vortena, and former Eternal Emperor Arcann, each with their own unique scene that exemplifies their character. These Date Night missions will be available to players who are currently in a romance with these characters, and only when the companions are available in the player’s story.
[/list]
[u][b]Galactic Trade Network (GTN)  Droid Legacy Unlock[/b][/u]
A new Character Convenience unlock has been added to Legacy Perks! Once unlocked, players will be able to reach the GTN at any time without needing to travel to the Fleet, their personal ship, various planets or Strongholds!
[list]
[*] Level 1 - Access to droid, 60m cooldown
[list]
[*]Requires Player level of 20
[*]Costs 3.5M Credits (Req Legacy level of 5) or 400 CCs
[/list]
[*] Level 2 - Lowers cooldown to 45m
[list]
[*]Requires Player level of 50
[*]Costs 7M Credits (Req Legacy Level of 10) or 250 CCs
[/list]
[*] Level 3 - Lowers cooldown to 15m
[list]
[*]Requires Player level of 80
[*]Costs 15M Credits (Req Legacy Level of 20) or 250 CCs
[/list]
[/list]
[u][b]Ancient Armaments Added To Daily Login Rewards[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Ancient Armaments contain various armor appearances including ones that could not previously be acquired or traded.
[*] These armor pieces do not contain stats or mod slots and are intended solely for Outfitter.
[*] These armor pieces do have dye slots and can be traded and bought / sold on the GTN.
[*] The armor pieces that are available inside of Ancient Armaments are now also available as random world drops.
[/list]
[u][b]Character Transfers[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Outfits will now be included when characters are transferred between servers.
[*] Character Transfers to the Shae Vizla server in the Asia-Pacific region are now open! Here are all the details:  
[list][*] There is a 15 million credit cap per character.
[*] Characters must be at least level 20 in order to qualify for a transfer.
[*] Players who have been Subscribed since before January 2, 2024 will receive 16 free transfers to the Shae Vizla server.
[*] Free transfers will be available for the next 30 days only
[*] For the next 90 days, all Subscribers will receive a 50% discount (500 Cartel Coins off!) on transfers to the Shae Vizla server.
[*] This discount will be applied for Subscribers who use up their free transfers. 
[*] Paid transfers cost 1000CC per transfer for non-subscribers. This will be the default price after the promotion period ends. 
[*] The credit and character level requirements detailed above will still apply to these transfers and all future transfers.
[/list][/list]
[h1][b]General[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] The “View Ledger” button on the Cartel Market now correctly links to the updated page on the website.
[*] Fixed character visibility inconsistencies when using the Gree Hypergate Toy.
[*] Fixed issue where tooltip anchor would fail to save after area transition.
[*] Resolved an issue with the speeders on Hutta where Players would pop or spin around at the end of Taxi Routes.
[*] Fixed the Unread Mail UI icon so that it once again properly updates when new Mail is received.
[*] The Repair tab on vendors and repair droids can once again be accessed.
[*] The zoom function icon is now properly displayed during Character Create.
[*] Fixed wall gaps that some players can fall through on multiple planets.
[*] Fixed some of the Light Bars from the Imperial Fleet so that they're now placed correctly on the walls.
[*] The Mantellian Flutterplume’s name is now spelled correctly.
[*] Fixed some visual oddities on several waterfalls on Tython.
[*] Removed a random floating bottle on Dantooine.
[/list]
[h1][b]Missions[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] The mission "The State of Things to Come" now appears as a story mission in the mission journal and tracker.
[*] Resolved an issue where Players are unable to complete Andronikos's Return Mission "A Pirate Life '' due to romancing and breaking up with certain other companions.
[*] The mission step progress for "[DAILY] Scrapyard" is now shared across all players in the group.
[*] Z0-0M Should no longer become an invalid companion when re-logging during “Shroud of Memory”.
[*] The player's dark side corruption should no longer be removed when completing The Forgotten World mission.
[*] Characters can now contract the Rakghoul Infection properly during the Taris "Catalyst" mission.
[/list]

[h1]Kessan’s Landing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Corrected an issue that could cause players to become trapped in the Geothermal Plant on Kessan's Landing after completing "The Heat is On."
[*] Several Nova Blade pirates on Rishi who were hostile in previously-neutral areas have been asked to calm down a bit.
[*] Reduced the required missions to complete [WEEKLY] Daily Area: Kessan’s Landing to 8 (down from 10). 
[*] Added the following to the appropriate mission terminals. 
[list][*] [DAILY] Grateful Grazers (Republic)
[*] [DAILY] Panther Training (Imperial)
[*] [DAILY] Turn the Lights On (Both)
[*] [DAILY] Unstable Readings" (Both) 
[/list][/list]
[b][h1] Galactic Trade Network[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Additional slots can be purchased under the Favorite Tab.
[*] Fixed some inconsistencies with the GTN search function and the Buy button.
[/list]

[h1][b]Achievements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] The Spoils of War: Jedi Sentinel/Sith Marauder achievement no longer requires the removed tactical Fanged God Form.
[*] The Spoils of War: Vanguard/Powertech achievement no longer incorrectly requires the removed Sonic Heal Tactical.
[*] Corrected an issue preventing the completion of the Admiring the View achievement in Secrets of the Enclave.
[/list]
[h1][b]Combat Styles[/b][/h1]
[h2]Sage[/h2]
[list]
[*] When using Sage Stacks of Resurging Power, they will not be removed on using healing abilities, to match the equivalent Sorcerer effect.
[/list]
[h2]Vanguard[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased the duration of the triggered effect of Suppressive Heat to 20 seconds to match the equivalent Powertech effect.
[/list]
[h1][b]Cinematics [/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Shadows in cinematics for the “Relics of the Gree” no longer fragment around character models.
[*] Updated the Imperial arrival cinematic for Voss.
[/list]
[h1][b]Map [/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] The Overlay Map will now be correctly updated when Quick Traveling from an exterior to an interior location.
[*] The Galaxy Map icon will no longer be highlighted for newly created characters that can't access it.
[/list]
[h1]Items[/h1]
[list]
[*] Regeneration Toys will correctly regenerate resources for all origin story and combat style combinations.
[*] Ancient Force-Imbued Blade's sheath/holster will remain visible after certain abilities are used. 
[*] Cartel Market items will now have the appropriate use description text where applicable.
[*] Gathering resource nodes while a weapon is drawn will no longer make equipped items invisible.
[*] The Lekku on "Ri'kan's Helmet" no longer stretch when the helmet is equipped in combination with "Cassus Fett's Body Armor".
[*] Fixed thruster positions on Veteran Boltblaster's Chestguard Mk-2.
[*] The Ancient Force-Imbued Blade's sheath will now retain its crystal color after cinematics.
[*] The Shrewd Rascal's Hat now properly reflects the applied Dye Module.
[*] HK-51's Scoped Assassinator rifle can no longer be equipped on player characters.
[*] Adjusted the description of the Advanced Orange-Yellow color crystals.
[*] The "BR-06 Republic Bomber Paint Job" item now unlocks the corresponding cosmetic called “BR-05 Republic Bomber Paint Job”.
[*] Fixed some clipping issues on the Separatist Relay Desk and Lava Pit decorations.
[*] 
[/list]
[h1][b]Strongholds[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] The Mek-Sha Safehouse Stronghold unlock is now properly displayed in the Legacy window.
[*] Fixed the Small Wall decoration hooks in the Mek-Sha Safehouse Stronghold.
[*] 
[/list]
[h1][b]Flashpoints[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Companions will now join in the first boss fight in Objective Meridian on Solo–Story mode for Imperial characters.
[*] The loot crate at the end of "Objective Meridian" will now persist correctly when the terminal is used.
[/list]
[h1][b]Galactic Seasons[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Galactic Season and PvP Season Objectives not giving the correct rewards during the conquest lockout period.
[/list]
[h1][b]French and German Game Clients[/b][/h1]
[h2]Flashpoints [/h2]
[list]
[*] Shrine of Silence and Ruins of Nul are present in the Activity Finder.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update 7.4.1 "Building a Foundation" coming March 12th!
notes.content:
Mark your calendars! Game Update 7.4.1 "Building a Foundation" will be releasing on March 12th!
[list]
[*] Time: 7am CT / 1pm UTC (note that DST is happening on March 10th)
[*] Expected downtime: 4 hours[/list]
Alongside Galactic Seasons 6, Date Night Companion Missions, and the opening of Character Transfers to the Shae Vizla server, the following will be coming with 7.4.1: 
[list]
[*] Outfits will now be included when characters are transferred between servers.
[*] Ancient Armaments Added To Daily Login Rewards
[list]
[*] Ancient Armaments contain various armor appearances including ones that could not previously be acquired or traded.
[*] These armor pieces do not contain stats or mod slots and are intended solely for Outfitter.
[*] These armor pieces do have dye slots and can be traded and bought / sold on the GTN.
[*] The armor pieces that are available inside of Ancient Armaments will also available as random world drops
[/list]
[*] Galactic Trade Network (GTN)  Droid Legacy Unlock
[list]
[*] A new Character Convenience unlock has been added to Legacy Perks! Once unlocked, players will be able to reach the GTN at any time without needing to travel to the Fleet, their personal ship, various planets or Strongholds!
[list]
[*] Level 1 - Access to droid, 60m cooldown
[list]
[*] Requires Player level of 20
[*] Costs 3.5M Credits (Req Legacy level of 5) or 400 CCs
[/list][*] Level 2 - Lowers cooldown to 45m
[list]
[*] Requires Player level of 50
[*] Costs 7M Credits (Req Legacy Level of 10) or 250 CCs
[/list][*] Level 3 - Lowers cooldown to 15m
[list]
[*] Requires Player level of 80
[*] Costs 15M Credits (Req Legacy Level of 20) or 250 CCs
[/list][/list][/list][/list]
Lastly, we did open up a few sections of the forums to players who have Preferred accounts. Going forward, any player who has a Preferred account can now create threads and post replies in the [url=https://forums.swtor.com/forum/10-new-player-help/]New Player Help[/url], [url=https://forums.swtor.com/forum/12-introductions/]Introductions[/url], and [url=https://forums.swtor.com/forum/188-bug-reports/]Bug Reports[/url] sub-forums. 

There's quite a bit in this update, so be sure to read the [url=https://www.swtor.com/patchnotes]full list of patch notes[/url] when they are on published on March 11th!

notes.title: In-Game Events for March 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6415dd9e455af4f2994afa3315373e461a9306ce.png[/img]

[b]Rakghoul Resurgence on Corellia[/b]

Date: March 5 - March 12 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
Requirement: Level 25+

The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization (T.H.O.R.N.) has issued an official level-2 emergency alert concerning an outbreak of the Rakghoul plague on Corellia. Quarantines have been put in place to restrict traffic of the plague off-world, but exceptions will be made for individuals with priority clearance.

T.H.O.R.N. is recruiting qualified volunteer emergency responders to travel to affected areas to combat the spread of the Rakghoul plague. More information about the outbreak can be found by checking the News Terminals on the Republic or Imperial Fleet!

T.H.O.R.N. wishes to remind you that plague symptoms can be treated if they are identified in the early stages of infection. Whether or not you have travel plans, please consult your nearest trusted medical supply droid and get vaccinated!

FEATURED REWARDS:

[list]
[*] Reputation with THORN
[*] Merciless Seeker’s Armor Set
[*] THORN Epicenter and Dark Vector Armor Sets
[*] Outbreak Response Weapons
[*] Alliance Contact - Doctor Lokin
[*] Infected Varactyl and Infected Dewback Mounts
[*] Ferocious Rakghoul Mini-pets
[*] …and more!
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/7c43508b2e462c947dca239c0cf8a6b412b5c999.png[/img]

[b]Relics of the Gree
[/b]
Date: March 19 - March 26 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)
Requirement: Level 50+

Explore Ilum's contested area in the Western Ice Shelf to uncover the mysterious purpose of the Gray Secant, an enormous ancient Gree starship. Get ready to face a powerful opponent that awaits you at the center of this ancient vessel. Visit the in-game News Terminal located on Carrick Station in the Republic fleet or Vaiken Spacedock in the Imperial fleet to get started on your adventure!

FEATURED REWARDS:

[list]
[*] Reputation with the Gree Enclave
[*] Gree Digitization Cube
[*] White, Red, and Blue Scalene Armor
[*] Gray Helix Weapons
[*] L1-L Defender, L1-L Scout, and Miniature Gray Secant Mini-pets
[*] Cyan Sphere, Blue Sphere and Red Sphere Vehicles
[*] …and more!
[/list]
