notes.title: Game Update 7.4.1 “Building a Foundation” Livestream recap
notes.content:
If you were unable to watch-or if you want a recap of everything we showed during our Game Update 7.4.1 Livestream, don't worry! Below is a VOD and breakdown of what we showed, including timestamps for the different segments of our livestream.

[previewyoutube=vCBNVHEdvpo;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]Timestamp 00:00[/b][/u]

Eric Musco, Lead Game Producer, and Jackie Ko, Community Manager discuss hosting streams more often, and a list of features for the 7.4.1 stream.

Redeem code "[b]LotSKrovos[/b]" [url=https://www.swtor.com/redeem-code]on this page[/url] to get a Darth Krovos Stronghold decoration. Be sure to redeem this deco before February 29th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/36a05ef8eeacd0dc3ddee9f83321ffdd566a6cfa.jpg[/img]


[u][b]Timestamp 03:40[/b][/u]

Galactic Seasons 6 “Building a Foundation” will be taking players back to a place with quite a view! We’re headed back to Copero! Players will be working with Inrokini family bringing them records of galactic events in exchange for the use of Chiss technology. The reward track features a brand new Stronghold based in Copero that players can unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b2b10bdc2e03ae47b3b978c7b8ef460040f0e83c.png[/img]


How does the Stronghold work for Galactic Seasons 6? This season will use story unlocks similarly to the way they worked in Galactic Season 5. A story mission will give access to the Stronghold, with 2 more rooms also able to be unlocked through more story missions. Subscribers will gain access to three additional rooms through the Galactic Seasons Subscriber Track. Three additional rooms can be purchased with Cartel Coins.  

Here's a sneak peek of some of the decorations that can be earned on the reward track! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/aaa8898ace07180faef1203076c013399d336409.png[/img]
(Large and small Copero fountains, Copero themed canopy, and Planet Art: Tython)
Timestamp 10:50

A Copero themed Utility Bundle will be coming to the Cartel Market!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/e58af6e0949e43a26482b54bb76644293cf40cb3.jpg[/img]
(Legacy Stronghold, Guild Bank, Cargo Bay, Item Modification, Appearance Modification, GTN Kiosk/Wall, and mailbox decorations)


We are also modernizing the original Utility Bundle decorations as well. Here are some before and after comparisons of the decorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/0b0cf8bcae7c83e5b4b28101ce7566c16b83aaf5.png[/img]
(Item Modification decoration before and after)


A new Red/Pink enhanced dye pack is now available and will be on the Cartel Market until February 29th! A special Green/Gold enhanced dye will be made available in March (date TBD). Here's how these dye look on different textures! Pictured is the Noble Attendant and Defiant Maverick armors.


[u][b]Timestamp 14:35[/b][/u]

Two new armors and weapons will be coming to the Cartel Market. Introducing the Prime Centurion and Gothic Master Armors and the Gothic Master Dualsaber and Lightsaber.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/86ce8d1034f598293de805d7dc2820a4ef122b56.png[/img]
(Prime Centurion Armor with Gothic Master Dualsaber)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/2156e0c85c1c17da8ca6993244dd1890f480aad7.png[/img]
(Gothic Master Armor, inspired by Marrok, with Gothic Master Lightsaber)


To help players prepare for decorating and partying in a new Stronghold, [u][b]we are running category sales on Decorations and Armors until February 29th! [/b][/u]So don't miss out!


[u][b]Timestamp 16:55[/b][/u]

PvP Season 5 "Pirate's Plunder" begins February 27th! Here's a look at the rewards coming in this season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b3ace90adbb19e018c029aaac2b2a26b13f50282.png[/img]
(Cunning Plunderer / Outlaw Battler Armors on the PvP track)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/dcfbda26ac3952a56e63714b8bf736c0e7d1547e.png[/img]
(Plunderer's Greed / Outlaw Warrior Armors available from the PvP Vendor)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/ae2d4b92f4426bcd5cfb0722d7d7376817a30e1c.png[/img]
(Large/Small Season 5 trophies, Cunning Plunderer Armor Display and Battler Trophy decoration)

[u][b]Timestamp 19:20[/b][/u]

Ashley Ruhl, Narrative Director and Caitlin Sullivan Kelly, Lead Writer, introduce a new narrative feature called Date Night!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/272cd38f4cc2ffaae9a9a0914ebab3da71414e5a.png[/img]


Date Night Companion Missions are weekly repeatable, cinematic-only missions designed to give players some personal time with their love interests. Game Update 7.4.1 will feature four companions: Lana Beniko, Arcann, Theron Shan, and Koth Vortena. Our goal is to have 1-2 companion missions released alongside Galactic Seasons.

For the creatives in the community, we are releasing cosplay kits based on the four companions featured in this update's Date Night release. They will be available on swtor.com at Game Update 7.4.1's launch.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/c6abfdbcb9492437a0205a87a7c3c8f7824a4868.jpg[/img]
(Sample of Koth Vortena's cosplay kit)

[u][b]Timestamp 34:40[/b][/u]

Keith Kanneg, Executive Producer, and Eric Musco take the stage and discuss Character Transfers to the Shae Vizla server. Transfers will be opening at 7.4.1's launch! Here are some things you need to know about them:

[list]
[*] There is a 15 million credit limit per character
[*] Minimum level 20 requirement
[*] Players that are active Subscribers and have been a Subscriber since January 2, 2024 will have 16 free transfers to Shae Vizla for 30 days after transfers open
[*] For the first 90 days after transfers open, all Subscribers will receive a 50% discount (500 Cartel Coins off) on transfers to the Shae Vizla server
[*] Paid transfers will become available at 7.4.1 launch and will still cost 1000 Cartel Coins for non-Subscribers. The credit and character level requirements will still apply
[*] Requirements may be adjusted in the future
[/list]

[u][b]Timestamp 42:45[/b][/u]

Keith and Eric tease what's coming in Game Update 7.5. The story update is called "Desperate Defiance" and will be taking place on Hutta. Lane Vizla's research comes to fruition and a new spring event will be launching with 7.5! We will share details on the next livestream!

We look forward to sharing Game Update 7.4.1 ‘Building a Foundation’ with all our players in March 2024! Keep an eye on swtor.com and our social channels for future updates!

notes.title: 12 Years With Star Wars™: The Old Republic
notes.content:
Hi, folks!

Today marks our 12th anniversary, and what a year it has been. I am once again reflective of everything that has transpired in 2023, and I couldn’t be more proud of the Star Wars™: The Old Republic team. 

We began the year by deploying the 64-bit client to all players, releasing Galactic Seasons 4 "Passage of Peace”, PvP Season 2 “Piercing the Veil”, and opened a test server in the Asia-Pacific region completely hosted in the cloud. It was an incredible kickoff to the new year, and we were delighted to see a lot of months of prep come to fruition. 

Midway through the year, the development team transitioned to Broadsword and delivered Game Update 7.3 “Old Wounds” which was full of new content, including a story update, the Shrine of Silence Flashpoint, and an entirely new area on Voss called the Interpreter’s Retreat. Game Update 7.3 also included art modernization, which updated various assets and the environment of the Interpreter’s Retreat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f26e0725a5e3e05f7c3e9f23c58c35557694a419.png[/img]

Over the following months, we officially moved all of our servers to the cloud! How cool is that? This initiative greatly streamlined our processes and allowed us to make additional upgrades to improve the overall health and stability of the game. 

On the heels of that migration, we launched Game Update 7.3.1 which came with Galactic Seasons 5 “Confidence in Power” (how about that Loth-Cat kitten pet?) and introduced Ahsoka-inspired items to the game. This collaboration with our friends at LucasFilm was a great deal of fun, and we were ecstatic to see how they resonated within the community. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/87f81f6c02f817e702b35d9e1be153f9eaeb7275.png[/img]

Now we find ourselves in the present day. We opened a new server in the APAC region called Shae Vizla, and it was incredible playing alongside new and returning players. I’m about halfway to completing Legendary status! 

Following the opening of the new server, we launched Game Update 7.4 “Chains in the Dark”, which brings players back to a new area on Ord Mantell to progress the storyline around Heta Kol and the Hidden Chain.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/db83fd3d7a4f12719afe6324735cbd4f338145e4.png[/img]

I wrote a lot about the accomplishments of the past year and leaving you all with quite a bit to enjoy for the holiday season, but I also do want to give you all a glimpse into 2024.  

With our next release in 7.4.1, we are doing something pretty cool in Galactic Seasons 6. The story and primary reward of the season will take you back to a location that you haven’t been to in quite some time, and it has quite a view.

As we look beyond 7.4.1 and into 7.5, we have some new things planned for our players. I checked in with Lane Vizla, and she thinks that her steady progress on the Basilisk War Droid Prototype could come to a meaningful conclusion (or new beginning?) around that time. I have so many more things I want to tell you about with the upcoming releases, and everything else we have planned for next year with story and events, but alas today is a celebration of our 12th anniversary. I wanted to make sure to leave you with a few nuggets to chew on over the holidays. When we get back from the holiday break, we’ll be preparing for a 7.4.1 livestream that we are tentatively scheduling for February 14th! 

This livestream will focus mostly on 7.4.1, where we will give you a glimpse of everything that is coming in that update. We’ll also share an early sneak peek of Game Update 7.5 as well.

As I said in the 7.4 dev stream, there’s more to come, and we’re looking forward to announcing further details in due time. 

Before I head out, just a reminder of some things to enjoy during the holiday break. 
[list]
[*] We are running a 50% off Collection Unlock sale from now until January 9, 2024
[*] Life Day is active and will run until January 9, 2024
[*] The Double XP Event begins December 24 and will run until January 4, 2024
[*] The Coruscant and Kaas City Strongholds are discounted to 12 credits (down from 5000) until the next game update 
[/list]
We’re doing something a little different with the Cartel Market sales this year! Right now the following are on sale at a discounted price: 
[list]
[*] Featured Anniversary sales until January 4, 2024
[*] 5-pack: Major Experience Boost
[*] Commander's Compendium - 3 Pack
[*] Master’s Datacron and Equipment Bundle
[*] Thexan's Armor Set
[*] Satele Shan's Dualsaber
[*] Darth Nul's Lightsaber
[*] Tulak Hord's Lightsaber 
[/list]
Daily sales are starting tomorrow and running until January 4, 2024
[list]
[*] Elite Mandalorian Bundle (Dec 21)
[*] Executioner Lightning Weapon Tuning (Dec 22)
[*] Mischief & Anarchy Blaster Pistols (Dec 23)
[*] Tau's Lightsaber (Dec 24)
[*] Armor of Darth Revan Set (Dec 25)
[*] Onderon Guardian Bundle (Dec 26)
[*] Dark Side Hssiss Mount (Dec 27)
[*] Zakuul Knight Armor Set (Dec 28)
[*] Stronghold Cantina Decoration Bundle (Dec 29)
[*] Sensuous Dress Armor Set (Dec 30)
[*] Heartless Pursuer Armor Set (Dec 31)
[*] Imperial Reaper's Armor Set (Jan 1)
[*] Incinerator Weapon Tuning (Jan 2)
[*] Twisted Fang Lightsaber (Jan 3)
[/list]

I am genuinely thankful that I get to work with such incredible teams and partners who are both committed to creating the best content possible for SWTOR and working toward improving the tech and platform that runs the game. Of course, I want to send a heartfelt thank you to all of our players who play this wonderful game with us. We wish you all a happy holiday and new year. 

May the Force be with you. 

-Keith

notes.title: Game Update 7.4 "Chains in the Dark" is now live!
notes.content:
With Game Update 7.4, players will experience a never before seen area on Ord Mantell called Kessan’s Landing, obtain new Achievements and Reputation rewards in the Daily Area, take on the FR3-D0M World Boss, and more! Details on what players can expect from this new update are below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/db83fd3d7a4f12719afe6324735cbd4f338145e4.png[/img]

[b][u]“Chain in the Dark” storyline[/u][/b]

Kessan’s Landing is a new Daily Area on Ord Mantell. Players will find that they can complete repeatable missions, and obtain new Achievements and Reputation rewards. There will also be a chain of side missions that will take players all over the galaxy, allowing them to assemble a piece of tech that will be very useful on Kessan’s Landing.

[u][b]Lane Vizla’s storyline continues on![/b][/u]

Lane Vizla’s story continues in Game Update 7.4 in a series of missions that follows the events of Showdown on Ruhnuk (Game Update 7.2). Throughout these missions, players will be meeting up Lane Vizla herself, an expert in droid history called The Curator, and an assassin droid HK-24 unit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/146567827362cd48d80d0357d509cf5fb097be5f.jpg[/img]

[u][b]New World Boss[/b][/u]

Players are encouraged to mind their feet and keep an eye out for burning patches of plasma that FR3-D0M tends to leave on the ground during combat. There is a chance that FR3-D0M will drop a unique mount called the Mantellian Separatist Hover Turret.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/50569d684caec9e696630b3831a91f4d680a132b.png[/img]

[u][b]Galactic Trade Network Overhaul[/b][/u]

The GTN is completely rebuilt, making it more accessible but also familiar to players. Players will see a new advanced search section, and a more streamlined flow for claiming and selling items. More information can be found [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/931783-74-gtn-preview-live-on-pts/]here[/url]. 

[u][b]Gearing Changes[/b][/u]

All the changes coming to 7.4, can be found in [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/931765-gearing-feedback-pts-thread/]this forum post! [/url]

[u][b]Cinematic Lighting updates[/b][/u]

We are activating a new character lighting tool for all cinematic content. Any cinematic content in the game currently - from class stories to world arcs to more recent expansions - will employ this new character lighting system. Some of the highlights of this system include using environment lighting for more accurate shadows, detailed self shadowing on characters, and more custom lighting control in cinematics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/50e2a93cd13f0bd7937d6dad481c41c419bf8e95.png[/img]


[u][b]New to the Cartel Market[/b][/u]

Many offerings are coming to the Cartel Market with Game Update 7.4. Some of which are the Defiant Maverick Armor set (inspired by Sabine Wren) and the Darth Nul Dualsaber. We will be rolling out the new items on a weekly basis, so be sure to check out the Cartel Market to see what new items are available. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d3dd938e0aa7571a05a89391165d17d7d24b3947.png[/img]
(Defiant Maverick Armor inspired by Sabine Wren)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/a7ade6185aaf5cc19975d7c9783c6484a093e579.png[/img]
(Darth Nul Dualsaber)

New enhanced dye packs that utilize specularity (how reflections are used to make a surface appear metallic, pearlescent, or matte) will also be released over time beginning 7.4 launch and these dyes specifically will only be available for a limited time. These dyes will be rotated out on a weekly basis from now until January 6, 2024. They can still be obtained through hypercrates beyond that date. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/1c5576309b67e35df9360c07ef17d3c5fc4576d2.png[/img]
(Various specular dyes on Suppression Trooper Armor set. 
From left to right - default Metallic Black/Pearlescent Red, Metallic Gold / Chrome White, Chrome White / Metallic Gold, Matte Black / Metallic Black)

A full list of Cartel Market items will be posted soon!

[u][b]Life Day[/b][/u]

Life Day is returning and will begin December 12th! Players will be able to obtain a new outfit called the Life Day Officer Armor. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/2bffd352a350bba304b35565c71f57fcc9ebe635.png[/img]

Be sure to also check out all the other[url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20231129] in-game events, including Double XP, happening in December! [/url]

We'll see you all in game!

notes.title: Game Update 7.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Chains in the Dark Storyline[/b]

Following the showdown between Shae Vizla and Heta Kol in Game Update 7.2, players will be returning to Ord Mantell to explore a small, provincial island called Kessan’s Landing to face the Hidden Chain strike team head on.

[b]New Daily Area[/b]

Kessan’s Landing is a new Daily Area on Ord Mantell. Players will find that they can complete repeatable missions, and obtain new Achievements and Reputation rewards. There will also be a chain of side missions that will take players all over the galaxy, allowing them to assemble a piece of tech that will be very useful on Kessan’s Landing.

[b]New World Boss[/b]

Players are encouraged to mind their feet and keep an eye out for burning patches of plasma that FR3-D0M tends to leave on the ground during combat. There is a chance that FR3-D0M will drop a unique mount called the Mantellian Separatist Hover Turret.

[b]Cinematic Lighting Update[/b]

Beginning in 7.4, we are activating a new character lighting tool for all cinematic content. Any cinematic content in the game currently - from class stories to world arcs to more recent expansions - will employ this new character lighting system. Some of the highlights of this system include using environment lighting for more accurate shadows, detailed self shadowing on characters, and more custom lighting control in cinematics.

[b]Life Day[/b]

The annual celebration is back! Life Day will be celebrated from December 12, 2023 - January 09, 2024 so make sure you hug a Wookiee in celebration!

[b]Galactic Trade Network (GTN)Revamp[/b]

The GTN is completely rebuilt, making it more accessible but also familiar to players. Players will see a new advanced search section, and a more streamlined flow for claiming and selling items. More information can be found here. [url=https://www.google.com/url?q=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/931783-74-gtn-preview-live-on-pts/&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1701712408135619&usg=AOvVaw1W8Sr5HU88XxgzDA1Ne6Mz]Forums Link[/url]

[b]Gearing Changes[/b]

The maximum for Item Ratings for gear has been increased. More details can be found here. [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/931765-gearing-feedback-pts-thread/?do=findComment&comment=9785568]Forums Link[/url]

[b]Quick Travel Map[/b]

Multiple fixes were applied to the Quick Travel map including: 
[list]    [*]The quick travel points now appear on the map after the discovery of the area they reside in. The Corellia Tears of Taris, 2 points on Balmorra, the Voss Cantina and the Belsavis Cantina which were previously missing are now visible.[/*]    [*]All quick travel points are accessible after unlocking them.[/*]    [*]All quick travel points will now show on the world map, regardless of location- like behind an elevator.[/*]    [*]Objective tracking is listed on the quest breadcrumbs on the map[/*]    [*]Interacting with NPC vendors no longer shows their name as "Undefined" on the map[/*]    [*]World Map coordinates will now show properly when reaching 4 digits[/*][/list]
[b]Class Balance Changes[/b]
[list]    [*]Sniper / Gunslinger[list]            [*]Engineering / Saboteur[/*]            [*]Reduced the critical damage bonus given to Explosive Probe / Explosive Charge from the Laser Targeting / Sequential Targeting mod to 20% (from 25%).[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Juggernaut / Guardian[list]            [*]Vengeance / Vigilance[list]                    [*]Removing the cooldown reduction from Major Fracture / Cauterizing Brand[/*]                    [*]Fixed an issue with Deep Cuts where it wasn't properly increasing periodic damage critical hit chance[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Powertech / Vanguard[list]            [*]Pyrotech / Plasmatech[list]                    [*]Superheated Fuel now increases Flame attack critical chance and critical hit damage by 25%.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]



[b]General Updates and Fixes[/b]

Corrected an issue preventing SCORPIO from being granted as a companion in KotFE Chapter VII: Lady of Sorrows. We also fixed an issue that would prevent the next chapter from starting automatically.

Commando/Mercenary
[list]    [*]When using a Regeneration toy, Supercharge building stops when the Rest & Recharge abilities are canceled.[/*][/list]
Sentinel/Marauder
[list]    [*]When using a Regeneration toy, Centering/Fury building stops when the Rest & recharge is canceled.[/*][/list]
Meridat Stato (Imperial Fleet Vendor), Nelva Stato (Republic Fleet Vendor) and Felusia Stato (Stronghold Vendor) are now selling the “Simple Merchant Rug” decoration again.

The vendors are now selling only one copy of the Basic Junker's Light.

Players who received the incorrectly named Elite Tactician Blaster Pistol will now be able to use it to unlock the Hermit's Vigil in Collections. To trigger the Collection unlock, players will need to equip the weapon or move it to the cargo hold storage and BACK into their inventory.

PvP Season 2 and 3 items are now properly showing in Giradda the Hutt’s inventory, the PvP Classic vendor.

The Burning Rampage Chestplate will no longer stretch when the character moves their head.

The Empire Director Mantle’s cape will no longer clip with the male body type 4 characters or players’ hands in combat stance

The map notes for the “Hidden Signals” bonus mission now appear properly on the minimap.

The Player can no longer accept both "Peace is a Lie" and "Power through Strength" by claiming the missing mission items from the Collection. Only one of the two missions can exist in the player log at one time.

The words "Weapon Tuning" are added to "Festive Snow Fall" in order to be easier to find on the cartel market.

Loading screen tip has been updated to "A Broadsword or EA employee will never ask you for your password".

The "Advanced Orange-Yellow Crystals” required level to use is now 10, in line with the rest of the color crystals.

The mission-granting items from Galactic Season 5 can now be found in both the “All” category and their own category of the Galactic Season 5 section.

The codex entries for The True Anomaly, The Uxibeast and Weequay Species now have images.

Siege Skytrooper health has been reduced while morphed in a Walker in Season 2: Chapter VIII: End Times on Master Mode. 

The Collapsible Bowcaster Grek is categorized as a Blaster Rifle as per tooltip in Collections.

 Enhanced shadows no longer appears over solid objects such as grates and fences.

 Graphics quality levels adjusted to more closely match the coloration of Ultra.  Low quality level has improved lighting, emissive, and skin shaders and looks closer to the lighting seen in Ultra

 Enhanced shadows adjusted to reduce sparkles and dark halos seen around characters when viewed from a distance.

 NPC and Low graphics settings have improved skin shader and reduced compression artifacts in textures.

 Scrolling cloud shadows enabled in certain areas 

Lieutenant Xorem, the mission giver on Ord Mantell for the mission “Victims of War” is now always visible.

Killing the Geonosian Queen in her Operation also completes the quest associated with the task.

When sheathed the Classic Lightweight Vibrosword sits at the same height as other vibroswords, including the Classic Vibrosword.

Fixed an issue where Imperial characters using Male Body Type 3 could get stuck while completing the Galactic Season objective "Mousecapades" on Alderaan, Taris, and Hoth.

The collision on the stairway in the Cantina on Rishi is adjusted so that all characters of all body types can step over it without jumping.

There is no longer a floating bush in the Appearance Modification Station or anywhere else on the Imperial Fleet.

Plants no longer have unintended holes in their leaves on Alderaan, Hutta and Oricon.

The "Dathomir Rancor" now has a picture in the Cartel Market..

The Space Missions "[HEROIC] Thanium Disruption" and "[HEROIC] Cha Raaba Assault" are now giving credit towards the Galactic Season Objective "We're Not Out of This Yet".

The K-NorCo B5C now has the same flourish as the K-NorCo B5B mount.

There is no longer a difference in appearance of the Empire Director Cowl, Scorching Sands, Shadeveil Warrior and Shadeveil Assassin sets when viewed on your character vs other characters.

The Model Redeemer Starfighter can now be unlocked in Collections.

A few turrets in the Section X area of Belsavis are no longer floating in the air.

The Imperial Banner is no longer clipping with a Sith Statue on the Korriban Arrival Port, because it was removed.

Reduced the reflectivity on some Imperial Walls .

All listed Uprisings count towards the Galactic Season objective "Quelling the Uprising".

It is no longer possible to use a jump shortcut in the Flashpoint: Athiss.

Players can no longer fall through the floor and reach an unintended area in the R-4 Anomaly Operation.

Players who have destroyed the Galactic Season 5 Mission unlocks can now re-purchase them from Jaleit Nall, the Classic and Non-Seasonal Rewards vendor.".

The Hover Light Weapon Tuning now works correctly with Female Body Type 4.

The position of all Jetpack Mounts has been adjusted to fit the characters back on all body types.

Max Bet Chips can now be purchased with Collector's Edition access without needing to purchase the VIP Wristband.

Trees are no longer clipping through the bridge in Darth Baras's Secret Lair.

It is no longer possible to summon ineligible characters to the VIP area on the Fleet.

We are activating a new character lighting tool for all cinematic content. Any cinematic content in the game currently - from class stories to world arcs to more recent expansions - will employ this new character lighting system. Some of the highlights of this system include using environment lighting for more accurate shadows, detailed self shadowing on characters, and more custom lighting control in cinematics.

[u][b]New to the Cartel Market[/b][/u]

Many offerings are coming to the Cartel Market with Game Update 7.4. Some of which are the Defiant Maverick Armor set (inspired by Sabine Wren) and the Darth Nul Dualsaber. We will be rolling out the new items on a weekly basis, so be sure to check out the Cartel Market to see what new items are available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/a7ade6185aaf5cc19975d7c9783c6484a093e579.png[/img]
(Darth Nul Dualsaber)

New enhanced dye packs that utilize specularity (how reflections are used to make a surface appear metallic, pearlescent, or matte) will also be released over time beginning 7.4 launch and these dyes specifically will only be available for a limited time. These dyes will be rotated out on a weekly basis from now until January 6, 2024. They can still be obtained through hypercrates beyond that date. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/1c5576309b67e35df9360c07ef17d3c5fc4576d2.png[/img]
(Various specular dyes on Suppression Trooper Armor set. 
From left to right - default Metallic Black/Pearlescent Red, Metallic Gold / Chrome White, Chrome White / Metallic Gold, Matte Black / Metallic Black)

A full list of Cartel Market items that will be released over time will be available at launch. 

[u][b]Life Day[/b][/u]

Life Day is returning and will begin December 12th! Players will be able to obtain a new outfit called the Life Day Officer Armor.

Game Update 7.4 “Chains in the Dark” launches on December 5th!

notes.title: An exciting announcement from Executive Producer, Keith Kanneg!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b40d4b944f25764d13eed9498728f9bf52d28832.jpg[/img]

Hi folks!

I’m back again with more [i]Star Wars[/i]™: The Old Republic news to share with our players! Let’s get right into it. If you recall, back in April, we tested a new cloud server in the Asia–Pacific (APAC) region which was called Shae Vizla. 

[b]I am thrilled to announce the Shae Vizla server launches November 16, 2023 for early access![/b]

We have been wanting to spin up a server in this region for quite some time now, and with our recent technological upgrades, it is now possible to make this a reality. Over the last year, we’ve updated our launcher, upgraded the game client to 64-bit, and recently we’ve migrated all of our game servers to the cloud. All of these are a huge win for us as we continue to modernize our infrastructure enabling us to open up new areas, improve performance, and make it easier to deliver new content and manage the overall game. 

This is an exciting opportunity for all players in the APAC region, whether you’re current, returning, or brand new! Shae Vizla will be a new server with no transfers available at launch. This will allow us to monitor the health of the server’s economy and simultaneously provide a space for players who want to start on a clean slate or who have never played before. In essence, opening a new server this way will feel like a new launch. Our established players can enjoy the nostalgia of the game, build new communities within APAC, and offer guidance to new players. Those who will be starting their adventure for the first time will have over 12 years of content, stories, and fun to enjoy in their [i]Star Wars[/i]™ journey.   

Now onto the launch details for Shae Vizla: 

[list]
[*] The new server launches for [b]Subscribers on November 16th at 1pm CT / November 17th at 6am AEDT. [/b]
[*] Subscribers will have exclusive access to the server for 24 hours before it is opened to all players. 
[*] We are offering early access to subscribed players so they have the first chance to obtain their preferred character and Guild names.
[*] Players looking for an opportunity to subscribe can take advantage of our new Join the Fight bundle that includes 60 days sub, 2400 Cartel Coins, and the exclusive K-NoCo B5C mount that is rideable at level 1!
[*] The server will be open to [b]all players on November 17th at 1pm CT / November 18th at 6am AEDT[/b]
[*] Devs will be out and about on the server alongside everyone!
[/list]

I’m very pleased that we can open a server in the APAC region and work towards creating other opportunities for more players to experience a game we all love. I look forward to seeing you all on the Shae Vizla server when we go live! 

-Keith Kanneg, Executive Producer of [i]Star Wars[/i]™: The Old Republic 

[u]APAC Server FAQ is below. An FAQ for new players is also provided following the APAC list. [/u]

[b]Where is the Shae Vizla APAC server located? [/b]

It is located in Sydney AU, same as when we opened it for testing earlier this year.

[b]If I already created a character, can I transfer it over to the new Shae Vizla server? [/b]

Transfers will not be available at launch. Players can choose to create a new character and start from level 1 or use a level boost. We will be monitoring and observing how the community establishes its own identity, Guilds, and economy. We intend to open transfers at a later time. Timing is dependent upon our overall status review of the server at that time.

[b]Will players be able to boost their characters to 70 or 80?[/b]

Yes. We are not removing that existing functionality from the server. The following boosts can be used:
[list]
[*] Master’s Datacron and Equipment 
[*] Commander’s Character Token
[*] Commander’s Compendium (for companions)
[/list]

[b]How will Galactic Seasons work on the new server? [/b]

Players will find that Galactic Seasons 5 “Confidence in Power'' will be active on Shae Vizla until January 24, 2024. It will have the same end date as the other live servers, but will run for a shorter period of time. 

[b]Will my Legacy be available on the new server?[/b]

No, as that requires a character transfer, but players can use the same Legacy name. 

[b]Will I have to purchase all the perks again?[/b]

Any unlock that is an ACCOUNT WIDE unlock will be available on the Shae Vizla server, consistent with how the rest of the game works today. 

[b]How will Strongholds work?[/b]

If Strongholds were purchased with Cartel Coins, they will need to be unlocked on the new server, however, the price will be 0 credits and no additional Cartel Coins. If a Stronghold was purchased with credits, they will need to be repurchased with credits. In both cases, players will be unlocking or repurchasing a brand new Stronghold.

[u]New to SWTOR? [/u]

[i]Star Wars[/i]™: The Old Republic™ is the only massively-multiplayer online game with a[url=https://account.swtor.com/play-for-free] Free-to-Play option[/url] that puts you at the center of your own story-driven Star Wars™ saga. you create your own hero based on the classic Star Wars roles, including Jedi Knights, Sith Lords, Bounty Hunters, Smugglers, and more.

SWTOR offers both solo and grouped content, main storyline, class and planetary specific missions, Guilds, Strongholds that can be decorated, a Players vs. Player (PvP) mode, and six expansions of content that extends beyond your class storyline.

There is over a decade of content to enjoy and experience, and we are thrilled you want to begin your journey in a galaxy far, far away.  

[b]How do I create an account? [/b]

If you do not already have an account, you can create one [url=https://account.swtor.com/play-for-free]here[/url]! 

[b]How can I download the game? [/b]

SWTOR can be downloaded using [url=https://www.swtor.com/game/download]our own launcher [/url]or via Steam.

[b]What are the system requirements?[/b] 
[list]
[*] Operating System: Windows 10 or later – 64-bit
[*] Processor: AMD: AMD Athlon 64 X2 Dual-Core 4000+ or better
[*] Intel: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.0GHz or better
[*] Memory: 6 GB VRAM
[*] Graphics: Star Wars™: The Old Republic requires a video card that has a minimum of 1 GB of on-board RAM as well as support for Shader 3.0 or better. )Examples include:Intel HD 3000 or better/AMD Radeon HD 7450/Nvidia GeForce 610)
[*] Storage: 75 GB available space
[*] Internet connection: Required to play
[/list]

[b]What Origin Stories (classes) are available? [/b]

There are eight Origin Stories that players can choose to play between the Republic and Empire factions. 

Republic 
[list]
[*] Jedi Knight
[*] Jedi Consular 
[*] Trooper
[*] Smuggler
[/list]
Empire
[list]
[*] Sith Warrior
[*] Sith Inquisitor
[*] Bounty Hunter
[*] Imperial Agent
[/list]

Each Origin Story has its own storyline and group of unique companions associated with it. Players can create their own custom characters and choose from a variety of Combat Styles to suit their playstyle before embarking onto their adventures. 

[b]What group content is available in SWTOR?   [/b]

Players can group up with friends or other players who can become friends to take on the challenges of Flashpoints, Uprisings, and Operations. 

Flashpoints are stand-alone, story-driven missions that call on a group of players to band together to complete them.

Uprisings are fast paced, high-action, repeatable group missions that are much like regular Flashpoints, although generally more compact in scope.

Operations are large-scale multi-group missions where you will join your Republic or Imperial allies to confront the most dangerous threats in the galaxy. Each story-driven Operation is available to both allegiances and is designed to challenge groups of either eight or sixteen players to use their skills, wits, and teamwork to ensure that they successfully complete the mission while still being accessible to newcomers to the genre.

[b]Are there difficulty modes available? [/b]

Yes! SWTOR has three modes that players can choose from to experience story and grouped content. 

[u]Story Mode[/u]
Story Mode is the easiest difficulty level and is the fastest way to experience the story. 

[u]Veteran Mode[/u]
Designed for players looking for more of a challenge. The enemies will be tougher, but the rewards will be greater as you work as a team to come out victorious.

[u]Master Mode[/u]
Requiring both patience and skill, Master Mode will need a balanced group of players with powerful gear and require players to have reached max level to complete.

[b]Is there a PvP mode in SWTOR?[/b]

There is! Players can join PvP Arena, Warzone, or Galactic Starfighter queues.   

8v8 Warzones make up the majority of player vs. player matches. Victory is achieved by completing various objectives.

4v4 Arenas are a Last Team Standing Warzone in which you have only one goal: to eliminate all players on the opposing team.

Galactic Starfighter lets players take part in flight PvP matches. Players can take part in a variety of roles with different Starfighter ships, each with their own advantages and disadvantages. As players progress they’ll earn upgrades and customization options for each of their ships to build the ultimate Starfighter.

[b]You mentioned Guilds? [/b]

Players can join an existing Guild or start their own! Guilds are a fantastic way to experience group content, socialize with and learn from other players, and receive a boost to the amount of experience points you earn while leveling. Each Guild can have their own Flagship, participate in Conquest, and decorate their very own Stronghold.  

[b]What are Strongholds? [/b]

Your personal home in the Star Wars™ galaxy. Players can purchase a variety of Strongholds with credits, Cartel Coins, or Galactic Seasons tokens. Each Stronghold is unique in design and can be decorated with thousands of items that can be purchased, earned, or found out in the universe. 

[b]What does Legacy mean? [/b]

Players can create their own family dynasty through the Legacy System, unlocking new skills, items, and other character options that were previously unavailable. As players progress through the game, there are a variety of achievements, titles, class and companion unlocks and much more that become accessible to all of your characters once obtained.

notes.title: Game Update 7.4 Livestream Recap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/3e000c5a3a560b11ab17cd8ec753ea96fe508698.png[/img]

If you were unable to watch-or if you want a recap of everything we showed during our Game Update 7.4 Livestream-we’ve got you covered! Below is a breakdown of what we showed, including timestamps for the different segments of our livestream.

Watch the full video [url=https://youtu.be/dkZZZe5IB78]here[/url]. 

[u]Timestamp 00:00[/u]
Keith Kanneg, Executive Producer of SWTOR opens the stream!

[u]Timestamp 03:55[/u]
Eric Musco, Lead Game Producer, and Jackie Ko, Community Manager go over the the topics of discussion for the stream.

[u]Timestamp 08:46[/u]
Redeem code LotSVizla [url=https://www.swtor.com/redeem-code]on this page[/url] to get a Shae Vizla Stronghold decoration. Players who have not previously obtained the Heta Kol decoration will also get this deco with the code.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b6768a5b39ed1e3620a7c08cae72a7d571c3fa13.png[/img]

[u]Timestamp 12:05[/u]
Ashley Ruhl, Narrative Director, and Caitlin Sullivan Kelly, Lead Writer go over the story content, characters, Daily Area, World Boss, and Cinematic Lighting improvements coming in 7.4. Game Update 7.4’s storyline is called "Chains in the Dark". Following the showdown between Shae Vizla and Heta Kol in Game Update 7.2, players will be returning to Ord Mantell to explore a small, provincial island called Kessan’s Landing to face the Hidden Chain strike team head on.

[u]Timestamp 16:18[/u]
Kessan’s Landing is a new Daily Area on Ord Mantell. Players will find that they can complete repeatable missions, and obtain new Achievements and Reputation rewards. There will also be a chain of side missions that will take players all over the galaxy, allowing them to assemble a piece of tech that will be very useful on Kessan’s Landing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b9c9915ee86cf10e137270a7d3d7c59525c354ef.png[/img]

[u]Timestamp 18:13[/u]
Players will be meeting some familiar faces and be introduced to a new character in their journey on Kessan’s Landing. Rass Ordo, Arn Peralun, Captain Blyes, Gizmel Gam, and Darth Krovos will be returning in 7.4 and players will be meeting Petra Nihrum, a citizen of Kessan’s Landing.

[u]Timestamp 21:10[/u]
A new world boss is coming in 7.4! FR3-D0M will definitely keep players on their toes. Players are encouraged to mind their feet and keep an eye out for burning patches of plasma that FR3-D0M tends to leave on the ground during combat. There is a chance that FR3-D0M will drop a unique mount called the Mantellian Separatist Hover Turret.

[u]Timestamp 22:10[/u]
Lane Vizla’s story continues in Game Update 7.4 in a series of missions that follows the events of Showdown on Ruhnuk (Game Update 7.2). Throughout these missions, players will be meeting up Lane Vizla herself, an expert in droid history called The Curator, and an assassin droid HK-24 unit.

[u]Timestamp 25:53[/u]
Beginning in 7.4, we are activating a new character lighting tool for all cinematic content. Any cinematic content in the game currently - from class stories to world arcs to more recent expansions - will employ this new character lighting system. Some of the highlights of this system include using environment lighting for more accurate shadows, detailed self shadowing on characters, and more custom lighting control in cinematics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/50e2a93cd13f0bd7937d6dad481c41c419bf8e95.png[/img]

[u]Timestamp 29:10[/u]
Joe Stramaglia, Systems Designer, discusses the Galactic Trade Network overhaul. The GTN is completely rebuilt, making it more accessible but also familiar to players. Players will see a new advanced search section, and a more streamlined flow for claiming and selling items.

[u]Timestamp 35:11[/u]
Bryant Wood, Systems Designer, gives a breakdown of gearing changes coming in 7.4

[u]Timestamp 41:26[/u]
Life Day will be coming in 7.4. It is our seasonal holiday event where players can hug Wookiees, throw snowballs at other players, enjoy festive decorations on the Fleet and earn new rewards. This year, we are adding the Life Day Officer armor set.

[u]Timestamp 42:17[/u]
Specularity tech is coming to SWTOR! This new tech will allow colors in the game to look more metallic or matte. New chrome and metallic dyes will be added in 7.4. The new Suppression Trooper armor will be one of the first sets to show off the metallic black and pearlescent red dye pack that uses specularity. These dye packs can be applied to new and legacy armor sets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/663d47aa4c6f553a68aaf9956f4b9f2d66258f1f.png[/img]
(Suppression Trooper armor set - default Metallic Black / Pearlescent Red)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/939417903cc431b2b617fd3f3cbb6eaea00c4462.png[/img]
(Suppression Trooper armor set - Pearlescent Red / Metallic Black dye)

Other offerings coming to the Cartel Market are the Darth Nul Dualsaber, Westar 19 weapon sets, and the Defiant Maverick Armor set (inspired by Sabine Wren).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d3dd938e0aa7571a05a89391165d17d7d24b3947.png[/img]

[u]Timestamp 49:40[/u]
We showcased the Best View in SWTOR 2023 contest finalists during the stream. Winners will be announced in the near future. As a reminder, winners will have their screenshot turned into a Stronghold decoration that will be added to the Anniversary vendor when 7.4 goes live.

Players should expect the Public Test Server to open soon!

We look forward to sharing Game Update 7.4 ‘Chains in the Dark’ with all our players soon! Keep an eye on swtor.com and our social channels for future updates!

notes.title: An introduction from Rob Denton + Game Update 7.4 Livestream announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/76c6ac0d84081c83689e32a77816ada1ddbf5fdf.png[/img]

Hi everyone - Rob Denton here, President of Broadsword Online Games. Now that some time has passed, I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself and share some details on Star Wars™: The Old Republic and Broadsword. First off, I'm thrilled that the SWTOR team has joined Broadsword. During my time at BioWare, I worked on the game (and closely with the team) for several years and helped support the 2011 launch, so it's very near to my heart.
 
Keith Kanneg, as the Executive Producer, sets the vision for the game, and he’ll continue to maintain the relationship with Lucasfilm Games and Electronic Arts. Keith and I will work closely together to ensure that SWTOR continues to grow, thrive and be the amazing game that you all love.

I’ll let Keith say more about Game Update 7.4, but I see a very bright future for SWTOR and our plans are already starting to take shape for new and exciting things. I have always been fond of SWTOR, and I look forward to seeing what this amazing team will create and continue to build upon in the years to come.
 
-Rob

Hey folks!

I couldn’t be more pleased working with Rob and the team at Broadsword on and building out future plans for SWTOR and our players. I wanted to take the opportunity to check in with all of you and give an update on where we are with Game Update 7.4. The last couple of months has been incredibly busy with us launching 7.3: Old Wounds and 7.3.1 alongside technology improvements including our migration to cloud game servers. The team has been hard at work getting Game Update 7.4 out the door, and I cannot wait for players to experience the content in it.

I’m pleased to announce that we will be hosting a livestream going over the finer details of the update on October 18th at 1:30pm CT / 6:30pm UTC over on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/swtor]our streaming channel[/url]. During the stream, players will be hearing from a variety of voices, including myself, and will be getting a sneak peek into everything coming in 7.4. 

Very excited for the team to show off what they’ve been working on, and I’m looking forward to seeing all of you very soon. 

May the Force be with you!

-Keith Kanneg, Executive Producer of Star Wars: The Old Republic

notes.title: Check out the in-game events for October 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d49e114a8ac56a033d7fe9919d107e72eb5c429d.png[/img]

The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally

[b]Date[/b]: October 3 - October 10 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 12:00PM GMT)

[b]Requirement[/b]: Level 20+

In the growing shadow of war, swoop fans across the galaxy descend on Dantooine, Tatooine, and even Onderon for the sport’s biggest spectacle—The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally! They’re packing the stands, eager to take their minds off their troubles and cheer their favorite swoop gangs. The bikers are here to take on dangerous challenge courses, show off their piloting skills, and flaunt their souped-up swoop bikes. The thunder of the engines, the deafening applause from the fans, the wind battering their helmets… there’s no bigger rush for these thrill seekers.

Despite their reputation as wild rebels whose makeshift courses disregard local districting restrictions, swoop gangs aren’t a serious threat to anyone--something all true swoop fans know! They just love adrenaline-pounding speed, sweet jumps, and big explosions, and the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally combines all three in one crowd-pleasing package. The biggest gangs on the circuit — Horizon’s Razor, the Pit Screamers, and the Blatant Beks — are ready to show their fans a great time.

FEATURED REWARDS:
[list]
[*] Swoop Rally Mounts (regular and gold versions)
[*] Swoop Gang Outfits
[*] Promotion Droid Mini-pets
[*] Various Stronghold Decorations
[*] …and more!
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f4940b3571f52e8003651148cc85d76aef996f23.png[/img]

[u][b]Feast of Prosperity[/b][/u]

[b]Date[/b]: October 10 - November 7 (BEGINS AND ENDS AT 5:00AM PST/12:00PM GMT)

[b]Requirement[/b]: Level 20+

Over the years, the Hutt Cartel’s reputation has taken a hit. The once powerful organization no longer instills respect and fear. To restore the Cartel’s influence, two up-and-coming Hutts, Gaboorga the Abundant and Duuba the Magnanimous, are throwing the most lavish “charitable banquet” in history for the galaxy’s underprivileged. And if the Cartel happens to advance their business interests during the Feast, everyone wins!

If Gaboorga and Duuba can cooperate, they could rocket the Cartel back into the upper echelons of the galactic underworld. But the Hutts’ conflicting priorities means they’re constantly undermining each other. Each week a new Story Mission will unlock to progress this storyline, leading to the climatic choice during the third and final week: Gaboorga or Duuba? Only one Hutt can win, and the fate of the Feast of Prosperity is at stake. Choose wisely!

For players that participated in the event when it previously ran, you'll be able to immediately jump into the Daily Missions and mini-games! If this will be your first time experiencing the event, each week a Story Mission will unlock - progressing the conflict between Gaboorga and Duuba.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/46b18f3d3e1d33b6a1826308ed8e17a325150533.jpg[/img]

The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization (T.H.O.R.N.) has issued an official level-2 emergency alert concerning an outbreak of the Rakghoul plague on Tatooine. Quarantines have been put in place to restrict traffic of the plague off-world, but exceptions will be made for individuals with priority clearance.

T.H.O.R.N. is recruiting qualified volunteer emergency responders to travel to affected areas to combat the spread of the Rakghoul plague. More information about the outbreak can be found by checking the News Terminals on the Republic or Imperial Fleet!

T.H.O.R.N. wishes to remind you that plague symptoms can be treated if they are identified in the early stages of infection. Whether or not you have travel plans, please consult your nearest trusted medical supply droid and get vaccinated!

notes.title: Satele Shan and Star Forge servers moving to the cloud
notes.content:
We are moving into the final stage of migrating the last two servers over to the cloud! Details below.

Date: September 20th
Time: 7am CT / 12pm UTC
Expected downtime: 6 hours

For this rollout, players should expect for all servers to remain offline for the duration of the maintenance window. This is to account for additional testing on every server to ensure that all servers behave and perform cohesively and there are no interruptions to the player experience.

notes.title: The Best View in SWTOR Contest is back!
notes.content:
We are back with our third Best View in [i]Star Wars:[/i] The Old Republic™ contest! We had a fantastic time seeing all of the entries that were submitted last time, so we’re looking forward to all the creative shots our players will be entering this year.

Starting today, players can submit screenshots taken anywhere on ten select planets. Take a screenshot of a scenic vista, a vibrant forest, a peaceful stream… and we’ll choose the screenshot that we feel captures the essence of that planet. One winner will be chosen per planet for a total of ten winning submissions. 

The winning submissions will then be turned into Stronghold decorations and distributed by the Anniversary event vendor in-game! The ten eligible planets for this contest are:

[list][*]Balmorra[/*]
[*]Belsavis[/*]
[*]Corellia[/*]
[*]Dantooine[/*]
[*]Ilum [/*]
[*]Nar Shaddaa[/*]
[*]Onderon[/*]
[*]Oricon[/*]
[*]Ruhnuk[/*]
[*]Voss[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/ce508b87160ddda7c72be5a2d81440f1d8662ad9.jpg[/img]
[i](Odessen 2022 winner)[/i]


[u][b]How to Enter[/b][/u]

If you’re interested in participating in this contest, you can enter by submitting your screenshots to contests@swtor.com. You’re more than welcome to submit a screenshot for multiple planets, but please limit all submissions to only one planet per email, and please only submit one image per planet. All image submissions must follow certain guidelines:

[list][*]No Player Characters in screenshot

[list][*]NPCs are allowed[/*][/list][/*]
[*]The in-game UI needs to be turned off.

[list][*]The default command for this is Alt+Z[/*]
[*]This includes having nameplates turned off.[/*][/list][/*]
[*]Screenshots of cinematics do [b]NOT[/b] qualify.[/*]
[*]No additional editing done to screenshots. For example, no filters added or editing done by external tools.[/*]
[*]Camera settings must be within intended in-game parameters.

[list][*]This means not using external tools or editing game files to exceed in-game settings.[/*][/list][/*]
[*]Graphics settings at [b]Very High[/b] or [b]Ultra[/b][/*]
[*]Image Size: 1920x1080 or higher resolution

[list][*]The team will crop the chosen screenshots to a 4:3 format.[/*][/list][/*]
[*]Image Format: JPG[/*][/list]

In addition to those image requirements, we ask that your email include the following information:

[list][*]Subject line clearly states the name of the contest and the specific planet where your screenshot submission was taken.[/*]
[list][*][b]Example: The Best View In SWTOR Contest - Balmorra Submission[/b][/*][/list]

[*]Account Name.[/*]
[*]Name of an existing character on the listed account.[/*]
[*]Server the listed character resides on.[/*]
[/list]

The account, character, and server names are crucial to give the winners a special prize, so please don’t forget to include that! This contest is open to everyone, regardless of account status, so whether you’re a Subscriber or Preferred/Free-to-Play status, you’re encouraged to enter!

[u][b]Rules and Regulation[/b]s[/u]

Players have from now until September 29th, 2023 to submit their screenshots! In addition to the above mentioned criteria and required information, there are a few additional rules players must follow in order for their submission to qualify:

[list]
[*]Qualifying accounts must have been created by August 15th, 2023.[/*]
[*]Accounts need to have a clean standing, both in-game and on the forum.
[list]
[*]No record of in-game suspension since September 1st, 2022.[/*]
[*]No forum suspensions since June 1st, 2023.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]Character names must abide by our ToS rules.[/*]
[*]Screenshot submissions without the required information (Account name, Character name, and Server name) provided in the same email as the screenshot will be rejected.[/*]
[*]Each account is limited to one submission per planet.

[list]
[*]If you want to submit a screenshot for each eligible planet, please send a separate submission per planet.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]Submission emails that have more than one image attached will be disqualified.[/*]
[*]Email subject lines must follow the “The Best View In SWTOR Contest - [insert planet name] Submission” format.[/*]
[/list]

Failure to adhere to the above guidelines will result in your submission being rejected. In the event that several people submit the same, or very similar, screenshots, the screenshot submitted first will be selected as the winner, so don’t wait to email us! 


[u][b]Results Announcement[/b][/u]

After the SWTOR team selects the winning submissions, we’ll publish an article announcing the winners before our upcoming 2023 Anniversary event. In this announcement, we’ll reveal the winning screenshots, and credit each player (Character Name / Server) who submitted a winning screenshot. 

While the winners are credited outside of the game, they will receive something special in SWTOR; a gilded version of the screenshot they submitted! While the normal versions will be available to everyone via the Anniversary event vendor as soon as the event starts in December, the gilded versions will be distributed shortly after the event starts.

We look forward to seeing what screenshots the community comes up with!

notes.title: Game Update 7.3.1a Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Players will no longer see map markers for Galactic Season 5 Missions that they are not currently on.
[*] The conversation in Galactic Season 5: Chains or Freedom with Lord Umbral will no longer reset itself in some cases.
[*] All mission items from the Galactic Season track are now Bound to Legacy (previously Bound to Character)
[*] All Galactic Season 5 Mission items have been added to Collections.
[*] Galactic Season 5 Mission items are now unlocked for purchase from the Galactic Season Rewards Vendor based on your Galactic Season level (previously was based on your Mission Progress).
[*] Players will now be unable to activate Galactic Season 5 Mission items when inside of Flashpoints and Operations.
[*] The Mandalorian Commander Helmet is no longer clipping with the Twi’lek’s lekku.
[*] The Mandalorian Commander Helmet no longer shows the neck when worn, as it now has a fashionable neck piece!
[*] Black Sun enemies in the Dockside Slums now respawn more quickly.
[*] Text for the intro conversation with S3T-BNS now correctly appears in French and German.
[*] Clipping issues with different body types have been resolved for the Emperor’s Chosen Mantle and Emperor’s Director Mantle Armor sets.
[*] Selecting "It was nothing I couldn't handle..." in conversation with Mendi Dian in Chains or Freedom if you are a Jedi Consular or Jedi Knight should no longer cause the conversation to end in an error.
[*] Players can now have multiple copies of "Brrazz's Gift: The Master's Top Secret Army" in their inventory and bank.
[*] Clicking on the "Launch" button for "Old Wounds" while on Odessen will no longer block the Mission from progressing.
[*] Corrected a rare instance where a dialog option during the mission Chains or Freedom would display as grayed out.
[*] Corrected a typo in the mouse droid ability "Relaxation Disruption Protocol" on the Peace is a Lie Galactic Season 5 Mission.
[*] The Unyielding Armasaur mount has been added to the Galactic Season vendor.
[/list]
 
[b]Quick Travel[/b]
[list]
[*] Using the quick travel ability will now always open the world map to display all potential quick travel/bind points
[*] The quick travel points will no longer show disabled when opening the map unless they truly are disabled.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update 7.3.1 is live!
notes.content:
With Game Update 7.3.1, players may begin earning rewards from the Galactic Season 5, “Confidence in Power” and will see UI/UX updates for our overlay and HUD maps.  Details on what players can expect from this new update are below!

[b]Galactic Seasons: Season 5, “Confidence in Power”[/b]

In previous seasons, players embarked on their storyline missions with a new companion. Season 5 introduces a new way to engage with the story told in Galactic Seasons, with story progression now a part of the Galactic Seasons rewards. Players will unlock new story missions as they progress through the reward track, with the final mission granted at Season Level 40. 

We are also adding new objectives that will involve companions being set to specific roles, Space Missions, and Operations. There are more objectives available for players who are Subscribers or have Preferred accounts. All the details can be found [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/20230901-0]here[/url].  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f28278afa594254f5b577e28b83baac777a813f9.png[/img]
[i](Decorationss that can be earned from the GS5 reward track or bought from the vendor. From top left to right - Dark Marauder Soldier, Imperial Lieutenant Officer, Wasteland Tech Crackshot, Imperial Reaper Combatant)
(Bottom left to right - Depository of Dark Wisdom, Outer Rim Drifter Gunslinger, 3V-1L, Resilient Warden Gladiator)	[/i]


[b]Mapping improvements[/b]

Players will see various UI/UX improvements to our in-game overlap and HUD maps including: 

[list]
[*] The Quick Travel Ability will no longer open a separate travel map but the world map instead and it will display the Quick Travel points next to your mission objectives. These icons will also be present on the HUD Overlay Map and the Minimap.  
[*] A magnifying cursor has been added 
[*] Travel abilities now show up at the bottom of the overlay map 
[*] Exploration missions have been added to Map Filters
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/2ab920e43f890170e65880250317031df9ed4649.png[/img]
For a full list of improvements, please see the 7.3.1 patch notes found [url=https://www.swtor.com/patchnotes]here.[/url]

[b]Balance Changes and Fixes[/b]

Players will also see multiple class changes and fixes across the board updating cooldowns, baseline abilities and more. Details can be found in the patch notes [url=https://www.swtor.com/patchnotes]here[/url]

[b]New to the Cartel Market[/b]

Lightsabers and armor sets inspired by Ahsoka and Grand Admiral Thrawn have been added to the Cartel Market, inspired by Star Wars: Ahsoka on Disney+! New “inspired by” tabs have been added to the Cartel Market window to make it easier for players to find these special items.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/7eeb538a1b63c511443ea08fa80c352f706c35f8.png[/img]
[i](Expatriate’s Armor, Lightsaber, and Shoto Lightsaber hilts inspired by Ahsoka. Note: The lightsabers are not exclusive to the main or offhand weapon slot.)[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6a3e8b9c07140252f58f39a903eabbf06b822aaa.png[/img]
[i](Elite Tactician Armor set inspired by Thrawn)[/i]


For a full list of patch notes for Game Update 7.3.1, [url=https://www.swtor.com/patchnotes]please visit this page[/url]. See you in game!

[b][u]HIGHLIGHTS[/u] [/b]

[b]Galactic Seasons 5 “Confidence in Power”[/b] - In this season’s story, “Confidence in Power”, players will meet an astromech named 3V-1L, a peculiar droid who serves a mysterious Master. 3V-1L will test the player through a series of trials, to see if they are worthy of the Master’s teachings of the “dark side”. notes.title: Galactic Season 5 “Confidence in Power”
notes.content:
Galactic Season 5 will begin with the launch of Game Update 7.3.1. Once the update goes live, players will be able to make progress through the Free Reward track or the Subscriber Reward track (both tracks are available to Subscribers!) and earn new rewards. Below are the details of what players can expect from this new season!

[u][b]New storytelling[/b][/u]

In previous seasons, players embarked on their storyline missions with a new companion. Season 5 introduces a new way to engage with the story told in Galactic Seasons, with story progression now a part of the Galactic Seasons rewards. Players will unlock new story missions as they progress through the reward track, with the final mission granted at Season Level 40. 

In this season’s story, “Confidence in Power”, players will meet an astromech named 3V-1L, a peculiar droid who serves a mysterious Master. 3V-1L will test the player through a series of trials, to see if they are worthy of the Master’s teachings of the “dark side”. Whether this is a prank or a serious threat, the player must decide how deeply they will commit to these “dark” trials to uncover the truth. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/cc707827044172cab787a51e5eb8a10d24196849.png[/img]
[i](3V-1L pictured above)[/i]

The story progresses through the use of special transmission items that are gained from the Seasonal Reward Track and mission completion, with each subsequent mission item granted as the player progresses through the Reward Track. If a player has completed the mission on any character, they will be able to re-acquire the mission items on other characters from the Galactic Seasons vendor, Jaliet Nall. Story missions are optional and the player can continue progress on the Reward Track regardless of story mission completion.

[u][b]Updating objectives[/b][/u]

We are adding new objectives that will involve companions being set to specific roles, Space Missions, and Operations. There are more objectives available for players who are Subscribers or have Preferred accounts. 

We have added a few new objectives with the goals of creating more variety in play, and making objectives easier to understand. 

Flashpoint and Uprising objectives will also be updated to make it clearer what requirements need to be satisfied in order to complete said objectives. Below is an example of how these objectives were displayed previously and how they will read once the season goes live.

Previous Seasons: Complete Flashpoints (1 point). Earn bonus progress for completing Depths of Manaan, Assault on Tython, Korriban Incursion, or Secrets of the Enclave (requires content) (4 points). Earn additional bonus progress for defeating their Bonus Bosses (3 points).

Will now read: Complete Flashpoints from the following list: Depths of Manaan, Assault on Tython, Korriban Incursion, or Secrets of the Enclave (requires content).

Lastly, more objectives will be added for Subscribers. The number of objectives will increase to 11 (up from 10) to allow for more options to be available to players. The maximum number of objectives allowed to be completed in a week will remain 7, however, this additional objective will create more opportunities for players to take part in grouped content including Uprisings, Operations, and Chapters. 

Further details on the new objectives can be found in this [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/930714-game-update-731-coming-soon/?do=findComment&comment=9774106]forum post! [/url]

notes.title: Game Update 7.3.1 coming soon!
notes.content:
With Game Update 7.3.1, players can expect the launch of Galactic Season 5, UI/UX updates for our HUD and world maps, and special weapons and armor sets coming to the Cartel Market. Below is a brief overview of the features coming with this update. More details will be provided at a later time. 

[u][b]Galactic Seasons: Season 5, “Confidence in Power”[/b][/u]

The new Galactic Season will begin with the launch of 7.3.1, so players will be able to immediately progress through the new reward track. Season 5 introduces a new way to engage with the story told in Galactic Seasons. Rather than tying narrative progression to companion influence, story progression is now part of the Galactic Seasons rewards track. Players will unlock new story missions as they progress through the reward track, with the final mission granted at Season Level 40. Additionally, instead of receiving a new companion, players will interact with several new characters, like an oddly enthusiastic astromech named 3V-1L, while making dialogue choices that affect gameplay. Under the command of a mysterious Master, 3V-1L will test the player through a series of trials, to see if they are worthy of the Master’s teachings of the “dark side”. Whether this is a prank or a serious threat, the player must decide how deeply they will commit to these “dark” trials to uncover the truth.

We are also adding new objectives that will involve companions being set to specific roles, Space Missions, and Operations. There are more objectives available for players who are Subscribers or have Preferred accounts. More details will be shared at a later time! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f62bf4ae69d044019d53f38608b0b6aa99b0a560.jpg[/img]
(3V-1L pictured above)

[u][b]Mapping improvements[/b][/u]

Players will see UI/UX improvements to our HUD and World Maps. Most notably, we’ve improved the quick travel (QT) flow to be more informative. The QT Ability will no longer open a separate travel map but the world map instead and it will display the QT points next to your mission objectives. These icons will also be present on the HUD Overlay Map and the Minimap.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/82860a3a78deef6f6bd8cd72518c17440d8baf4a.png[/img]

There are a number of other UI/UX improvements that were made and they will be covered when we publish the 7.3.1 patch notes! 
 
Additionally, we will be adding a host of exciting new offerings to the Cartel Market! Keep an eye out for more details in an upcoming Cartel Market article.

Game Update 7.3.1 will be launching late August/early September! More details on the content above and the exact release date will follow in the coming weeks, so stay informed by keeping an eye on our forums and social channels.

notes.title: SWTOR begins to move servers to the cloud!
notes.content:
Next week, we will be setting up our game servers to be moved over the cloud. This is an initiative we have been testing for months beginning with moving the Public Test Server over to the cloud last year, and testing a new server on AWS in April of this year. We are thrilled to announce the next steps in this journey with our players. 

We have been making strides in our efforts to modernize and update the game. Some of the benefits of this particular migration are:
[list]
[*] Backend updates that are crucial to the continued health and stability of the game can be streamlined more efficiently
[*] The resources required to maintain our current systems can be reallocated to focusing on enhancing the game experience
[*] We will be able to leverage and integrate updated tech such as newer hardware and software. Through cloud modernization, we can update numerous tools and automation workflows which will help us maintain the game for long term. 
[*] Once finalized, SWTOR may be capable to extend its servers capabilities to reach new players
[/list]
[u][b]When is this happening? [/b][/u]

We want to minimize long term impact on play time, so we will be moving servers over in small batches beginning with a single server first. 

We are targeting August 15th to migrate the Leviathan server over to the cloud. 

It is important to note that when we do the migration, we will have to bounce all the servers, meaning they will be taken down momentarily but brought back up immediately[u][b] save for the server(s) moving to the cloud.[/b][/u] On August 15th, players should expect the Satele Shan, Darth Malgus, Star Forge, and Tulak Hord servers to bounce; however, [b]Leviathan’s estimated downtime is expected to be 6 hours[/b]. Downtime will begin at [u][b]7am CT/12pm UTC[/b][/u].     

Upon successful completion of the initial migration, we will communicate out the next batch of servers that will be moved over and a timeline of when this will happen. We will follow the same migration process detailed above.  

As always, we will communicate additional details, or any timeline changes on our social channels and forums! Be sure to keep an eye on these spaces to stay up to date on everything happening with SWTOR!

In addition to the new rewards coming in Season 3, we’ve made  changes to the points players receive on several PvP Maps, including all Huttball  Maps. We’ve also adjusted the requirements for Arena Objectives and PvP Arena  Weekly Missions. Let’s dive into all the changes coming in Season 3!

[list]  [*]Defenders  will receive 700 defender points (up from 500) when guarding a bunker. [/*]  [*]Defenders  will receive 700 defender points when defeating an attacking player near the  bunker. [/*]  [*]Attackers who  actively capture the objective will receive 2000 attacker points (1000 for  actively capturing and 1000 for any assist work player may have contributed).[/*]  [*]Attackers  will receive 5000 attacker points when defeating a defending player near a  bunker. [/*][/list]

[list]  [*]Defending an  objective now grants 700 defender points.[/*]  [*]When  defeating an attacking player near the door, the player will now gain 500 defender  points.[/*]  [*]When an  attacking player defeats a defending player, they will receive 500 attacker  points.[/*][/list]

More details about these changes can  be found in this [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/929205-pts-pvp-map-changes-feedback/]forum post[/url] (only available in English).

notes.content:
The Nar Shaddaa Nightlife event begins today and will be available until August 22nd. During these six weeks, players can test their luck and earn new rewards inspired by the spectacular High Roller Shades! 

Players can also earn new rewards, including the High Roller Skiff Mount and the fashionable High Roller Armor Set in a tradeable crate. Both of these rewards can be obtained from the Emperor’s Grace Machines located in the main areas of the Star Cluster and Club Vertica Casinos.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/961ce5219ff12f37a3e53e39f86cc67e764e622e.png[/img]
[center][i]High Roller Skiff Mount[/i][/center]

In addition to these new rewards, players can also exchange their Golden Certificates for individual, untradeable pieces of the new High Roller Armor Set. Visit one of the Nar Shaddaa Nightlife vendors located at the back of the Star Cluster and Club Vertica casinos on Nar Shaddaa to get these pieces. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f3109a18074ded19358bfedd9ffa21e4ae3366ca.png[/img]
[center][i]High Roller Armor Set[/i][/center]

Starting today, grab your lucky charms and try your luck at one of the Nar Shaddaa Nightlife locations.

notes.title: Studio update on Star Wars: The Old Republic
notes.content:
Hi folks!

I’ve been a part of SWTOR since well before launch and it’s been an incredible journey. I ended up taking on many different roles on the team over that time, so I’ve seen this game from just about every different angle there is. And honestly, I absolutely love this game—not to mention the people who continue to make it fun. Even after almost 12 years, I see so much room for growth and so much potential in SWTOR.

I know decisions that impact our people are the hardest part of change and evolution, but I believe Broadsword is the right studio to continue to enhance and modernize our game—and also expand the number of people who can play it.

Of course, I’m also very glad that I’ll be moving over with key team leaders and continuing to work with most of our current team. This team has never stopped excelling, even proudly delivering an amazing update [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20221213-0]7.2 Showdown on Ruhnuk [/url]over the holiday break—along with technological improvements like our new fast launcher, [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20230328-0]64-bit client[/url] , and Cloud Game Servers. I can’t thank them enough for their passion and dedication in bringing these experiences to life for our players.

I also want to thank EA and BioWare for all they have done for me and this team, not to mention all our friends at Lucasfilm Games, whose support and collaboration have helped make all this happen for us. They’re the best, and I look forward to continuing to work with them.

We are excited about the future of SWTOR, and once we get our feet firmly planted at Broadsword, we look forward to sharing plans for game direction and improvements. Until then, rest assured that all the current plans are still in motion!

As examples, we just delivered our largest story update in months, and a new story flashpoint with [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20230613]Game Update 7.3: Old Wounds[/url], taking us back to the planet Voss, which we haven’t visited since our KOTET expansion back in 2016. We will also be rolling out Game Update 7.3.1, which will contain our next Galactic Season, in the coming months. And stay tuned for details on Game Update 7.4, where players will see the story continue following the events of Old Wounds. And there’s even more on the horizon. We will continue to publish communication on swtor.com and the SWTOR forums, as we always have, so you will be hearing from me again soon.

No change is easy, but it certainly helps that we’re all excited about the future of this very special game. We look forward to seeing that vision become reality alongside all our players and fans.

May the Force be with you,

Keith Kanneg
Executive Producer, Star Wars™: The Old Republic™
